地市 Regions
建筑结构 · Structure (12)
燕尾脊
Swallow-Tail Ridge (Yanweiji)

中文释义：燕尾脊是闽南建筑最具标志性的屋顶形式，屋脊两端向上翘起，形似燕子尾巴，曲线优美流畅。燕尾脊分为正脊和垂脊，正脊两端高高翘起，有的高达1米以上，装饰有剪粘、交趾陶等。燕尾脊在闽南、台湾、潮汕地区广泛使用，是闽南建筑区别于其他地区建筑的最显著特征，其翘起的弧度和高度有严格的等级规定。

English: The swallow-tail ridge (yanweiji) is the most iconic roof form of Minnan (southern Fujian) architecture, with both ends of the ridge curving upward like a swallow's tail in graceful flowing lines. Divided into main and hip ridges, the main ridge ends rise high, sometimes over 1 meter, decorated with jianzhan (cut-and-paste porcelain) and cochin pottery. Widely used in southern Fujian, Taiwan, and Chaoshan, it is the most distinctive feature distinguishing Minnan architecture, with strict hierarchical regulations on the curvature and height of its upturned ends.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、厦门南普陀、漳州南山寺 | 关联 Related: 马鞍脊, 剪粘, 交趾陶, 红砖厝
马鞍脊
Saddle Ridge (Maanji)

中文释义：马鞍脊是福州地区传统建筑的典型屋顶形式，屋脊两端呈马鞍形曲线，中间低两端高，形似马鞍。与闽南燕尾脊的张扬不同，马鞍脊造型内敛稳重，是福州民居和三坊七巷建筑的标志性特征。马鞍脊的弧度和装饰有地域差异，福州地区多为素面或简单灰塑，闽东地区则装饰更为丰富。

English: The saddle ridge (maanji) is a typical roof form of traditional Fuzhou architecture, with both ends of the ridge curving in a saddle shape—low in the middle and high at both ends—resembling a saddle. Unlike the flamboyant Minnan swallow-tail ridge, the saddle ridge has a restrained and steady form, serving as the signature feature of Fuzhou residences and the Three Lanes and Seven Alleys. Its curvature and decoration vary by region: Fuzhou area features plain surfaces or simple gray plaster sculptures, while eastern Fujian has richer decoration.

实例 Examples: 福州三坊七巷、福州林觉民故居、闽清宏琳厝 | 关联 Related: 燕尾脊, 三坊七巷, 马鞍墙, 灰塑
马鞍墙
Saddle Wall (Maanqiang)

中文释义：马鞍墙是福州地区传统民居的封火墙形式，墙体随屋顶坡度呈马鞍形曲线，高出屋顶，既防火又装饰。马鞍墙是福州民居最显著的外部特征，与徽派马头墙的阶梯状不同，马鞍墙呈连续的波浪形曲线。墙顶通常有灰塑装饰，墙面粉刷白灰，与青瓦形成对比。

English: The saddle wall (maanqiang) is a fire wall form in traditional Fuzhou residences, following the roof slope in a saddle-shaped curve, rising above the roof to serve both fire-prevention and decorative purposes. The most distinctive external feature of Fuzhou residences, unlike the stepped horse-head walls of the Huizhou style, saddle walls form continuous wavy curves. The wall tops usually have gray plaster decorations, and the walls are whitewashed, contrasting with dark tiles.

实例 Examples: 福州三坊七巷、福州严复故居、闽清宏琳厝 | 关联 Related: 马鞍脊, 马头墙, 封火墙, 三坊七巷
出砖入石
Brick-and-Stone Wall (Chuzhuan Rushi)

中文释义：出砖入石是闽南地区独特的墙体砌筑工艺，将红砖和花岗岩石块交错砌筑，砖块凸出、石块凹入，形成富有肌理感的墙面。这种工艺利用废旧材料，经济实用，同时具有独特的装饰效果。出砖入石墙面在泉州、厦门、漳州等地的传统民居中广泛使用，是闽南建筑的标志性元素之一。

English: Brick-and-stone wall (chuzhuan rushi) is a unique wall masonry technique in southern Fujian, laying red bricks and granite blocks in an alternating pattern with bricks protruding and stones recessed, creating a textured wall surface. This technique uses recycled materials, making it economical and practical while achieving a unique decorative effect. Widely used in traditional residences in Quanzhou, Xiamen, and Zhangzhou, it is one of the signature elements of Minnan architecture.

实例 Examples: 泉州蔡氏古民居、厦门鼓浪屿老别墅、漳州古城 | 关联 Related: 红砖厝, 蚵壳厝, 镜面墙, 闽南建筑
镜面墙
Mirror Wall (Jingmianqiang)

中文释义：镜面墙是闽南传统建筑的正面墙体，以红砖或白石砌筑，表面平整光滑如镜面，故名。镜面墙通常是建筑的正立面，装饰精美，墙顶有水车堵、规带等装饰，墙面上常有匾额、对联。镜面墙是闽南大厝的标志性元素，体现了闽南人对建筑正面的重视和对红砖文化的崇尚。

English: The mirror wall (jingmianqiang) is the front wall of traditional Minnan architecture, built with red bricks or white stone with a smooth surface like a mirror, hence the name. Usually the main facade of a building, it is exquisitely decorated with water-wheel blocks and gui bands at the top, and often bears inscribed plaques and couplets. The mirror wall is a signature element of Minnan grand residences, reflecting the importance Minnan people place on a building's front and their reverence for red-brick culture.

实例 Examples: 泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第、漳州官园大厝 | 关联 Related: 红砖厝, 水车堵, 出砖入石, 燕尾脊
水车堵
Water-Wheel Block (Shuichedu)

中文释义：水车堵是闽南传统建筑屋脊下方的水平装饰带，因形似水车而得名。水车堵通常以灰塑、剪粘、交趾陶等工艺装饰，内容包括人物故事、花鸟虫鱼、博古图案等，色彩绚丽，是闽南建筑装饰最集中的部位。水车堵的工艺水平直接反映了建筑的等级和主人的财力。

English: The water-wheel block (shuichedu) is a horizontal decorative band below the roof ridge in traditional Minnan architecture, named for its resemblance to a water wheel. Usually decorated with gray plaster sculpture, cut-and-paste porcelain, and cochin pottery, its content includes figure stories, flowers, birds, insects, fish, and antique patterns in brilliant colors—it is the most concentrated area of decoration in Minnan architecture. The craftsmanship of the water-wheel block directly reflects the building's grade and the owner's wealth.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、厦门青礁慈济宫、漳州白礁慈济宫 | 关联 Related: 剪粘, 交趾陶, 燕尾脊, 镜面墙
剪粘
Cut-and-Paste Porcelain (Jianzhan)

中文释义：剪粘是闽南地区独特的建筑装饰工艺，将彩色瓷碗、瓷盘剪碎后，用糯米灰浆粘贴在建筑表面，形成各种图案。剪粘工艺精细，色彩鲜艳持久，多用于屋脊、水车堵、照壁等部位。剪粘题材丰富，包括龙凤、人物、花鸟、瑞兽等，是闽南寺庙和大厝装饰的标志性工艺。

English: Cut-and-paste porcelain (jianzhan) is a unique architectural decorative craft in southern Fujian, cutting colored porcelain bowls and plates into pieces and pasting them on building surfaces with glutinous rice mortar to form various patterns. With fine craftsmanship and bright lasting colors, it is mostly used on ridges, water-wheel blocks, and screen walls. With rich subjects including dragons, phoenixes, figures, flowers, birds, and auspicious animals, it is the signature decorative craft of Minnan temples and grand residences.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、厦门南普陀、漳州白礁慈济宫 | 关联 Related: 交趾陶, 灰塑, 水车堵, 燕尾脊
交趾陶
Cochin Pottery (Jiaozhitao)

中文释义：交趾陶是闽南地区独特的低温釉陶工艺，因源自越南交趾（今越南北部）而得名。交趾陶以陶土塑形，施低温釉烧制，色彩丰富，多用于建筑装饰和案头陈设。交趾陶工艺在清代传入闽南，与剪粘配合使用，共同装饰寺庙和大厝的屋脊、水车堵等部位，是闽南建筑装饰的重要组成部分。

English: Cochin pottery (jiaozhitao) is a unique low-temperature glazed pottery craft in southern Fujian, named for its origin in Cochin (northern Vietnam today). Shaped from clay and fired with low-temperature glaze in rich colors, it is used for architectural decoration and desk ornaments. Introduced to southern Fujian in the Qing dynasty, it is used together with cut-and-paste porcelain to decorate the ridges and water-wheel blocks of temples and grand residences, serving as an important component of Minnan architectural decoration.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、厦门青礁慈济宫、漳州南山寺 | 关联 Related: 剪粘, 灰塑, 水车堵, 闽南建筑
蚵壳厝
Oyster-Shell House (Keke Cuo)

中文释义：蚵壳厝是泉州沿海地区独特的民居建筑，以牡蛎壳（蚵壳）砌筑墙体，内外双层，中间填土，具有冬暖夏凉、防风耐碱的特点。蚵壳厝的蚵壳多为宋元时期海外贸易从东南亚运回的牡蛎壳，是海上丝绸之路的实物见证。蚵壳厝主要分布在泉州鲟埔、法石等地，是闽南海洋文化的独特建筑形式。

English: Oyster-shell house (keke cuo) is a unique residential architecture in the coastal areas of Quanzhou, building walls with oyster shells in double layers filled with earth, featuring warmth in winter, coolness in summer, wind resistance, and alkali tolerance. The oyster shells were mostly brought back from Southeast Asia during overseas trade in the Song-Yuan period, serving as material evidence of the Maritime Silk Road. Mainly distributed in Xunpu and Fashi in Quanzhou, oyster-shell houses are a unique architectural form of Minnan maritime culture.

实例 Examples: 泉州鲟埔蚵壳厝、泉州法石蚵壳厝 | 关联 Related: 红砖厝, 出砖入石, 海上丝绸之路, 闽南建筑
木拱廊桥
Timber Arch Lounge Bridge (Mugong Langqiao)

中文释义：木拱廊桥是闽东北和浙南地区独特的桥梁形式，以木材搭接成拱形结构，桥上建廊屋，可供行人避雨休息。木拱廊桥不用一钉一铆，完全靠木材的搭接和挤压形成稳定结构，是中国古代桥梁技术的杰出代表。福建宁德、南平地区保存有大量木拱廊桥，其中宁德屏南、寿宁的廊桥最为集中，被誉为'世界木拱廊桥之乡'。

English: Timber arch lounge bridges (mugong langqiao) are a unique bridge form in northeastern Fujian and southern Zhejiang, using timber joined into an arch structure with a covered corridor on top for pedestrians to shelter from rain and rest. Built without a single nail or rivet, relying entirely on timber joinery and compression for stability, they are outstanding representatives of ancient Chinese bridge technology. Ningde and Nanping in Fujian preserve numerous timber arch lounge bridges, with Pingnan and Shouning in Ningde having the highest concentration, known as the 'Hometown of World Timber Arch Lounge Bridges'.

实例 Examples: 屏南万安桥、寿宁升平桥、宁德金造桥 | 关联 Related: 廊桥, 虹梁, 闽东北建筑, 传统村落
虹梁
Rainbow Beam (Hongliang)

中文释义：虹梁是木拱廊桥的核心结构构件，由多根圆木搭接成拱形，形似彩虹。虹梁结构利用木材的抗压性能，通过'三节苗''五节苗'等搭接方式，形成跨越河流的拱形结构。虹梁是中国古代木构桥梁技术的精华，体现了古代工匠对材料力学的深刻理解。

English: The rainbow beam (hongliang) is the core structural component of timber arch lounge bridges, formed by multiple logs joined into an arch shape resembling a rainbow. Utilizing the compressive strength of timber through joining methods such as 'three-section seedlings' and 'five-section seedlings', it forms an arch structure spanning rivers. The rainbow beam represents the essence of ancient Chinese timber bridge technology, reflecting ancient craftsmen's deep understanding of material mechanics.

实例 Examples: 屏南万安桥、寿宁杨梅洲桥、政和后山桥 | 关联 Related: 木拱廊桥, 廊桥, 闽东北建筑, 传统村落
斗拱
Bracket Set (Dougong)

中文释义：斗拱是中国古代建筑中柱梁之间的承重构件，福建地区的斗拱在继承中原传统的基础上形成了地方特色。闽南寺庙的斗拱装饰华丽，常以象鼻、花鸟等造型替代标准斗拱；福州地区的斗拱则较为简洁，注重结构功能。福建宋代建筑如华林寺大殿、玄妙观三清殿的斗拱保留了宋代特征，是研究中国古代建筑的重要实物。

English: The bracket set (dougong) is a load-bearing component between columns and beams in ancient Chinese architecture. Fujian bracket sets developed local characteristics while inheriting Central Plains traditions. Minnan temple bracket sets are ornately decorated, often using elephant trunks, flowers, and birds in place of standard forms; Fuzhou bracket sets are simpler, emphasizing structural function. Fujian's Song dynasty buildings such as the Hualin Temple Main Hall and Xuanmiao Temple Sanqing Hall preserve Song dynasty bracket features, important artifacts for studying ancient Chinese architecture.

实例 Examples: 福州华林寺、泉州玄妙观、莆田元妙观 | 关联 Related: 燕尾脊, 减柱造, 叉手, 宋代建筑
建筑类型 · Building Type (13)
土楼
Earthen Roundhouse (Tulou)

中文释义：土楼是福建西南部客家和闽南地区独特的大型集体住宅建筑，以生土、砂石、竹木为主要材料，夯筑成圆形或方形的高大围墙，内部为多层环形或方形结构，可供数十户甚至上百户人家居住。土楼具有防御、居住、祭祀等多种功能，是中国古代民居建筑的奇葩。福建土楼主要分布在永定、南靖、华安等地，2008年被列入世界文化遗产名录。

English: Earthen roundhouses (tulou) are unique large-scale collective residential buildings in southwestern Fujian's Hakka and Minnan regions, using raw earth, sand, gravel, and bamboo as main materials, rammed into tall round or square enclosing walls with multi-story ring or square structures inside, housing dozens or even hundreds of households. Tulou serve multiple functions including defense, residence, and worship, representing a marvel of ancient Chinese residential architecture. Mainly distributed in Yongding, Nanjing, and Hua'an, Fujian tulou were listed as UNESCO World Heritage Sites in 2008.

实例 Examples: 永定承启楼、南靖田螺坑、华安二宜楼 | 关联 Related: 客家, 土堡, 围屋, 世界文化遗产
土堡
Earthen Fortress (Tubao)

中文释义：土堡是福建中部和西北部地区独特的防御性民居建筑，以生土夯筑高大围墙，内部建有住宅，兼具居住和防御功能。与土楼的圆形或方形不同，土堡多为不规则形状，依山就势而建，防御设施更为完善。福建土堡主要分布在三明、大田、尤溪、永安等地，其中大田土堡最为集中，是研究中国古代防御性民居的重要实物。

English: Earthen fortresses (tubao) are unique defensive residential buildings in central and northwestern Fujian, with tall walls rammed from raw earth and residences inside, combining residential and defensive functions. Unlike the round or square tulou, tubao are often irregularly shaped, built according to terrain with more complete defensive facilities. Mainly distributed in Sanming, Datian, Youxi, and Yong'an, with Datian having the highest concentration, Fujian tubao are important artifacts for studying ancient Chinese defensive residences.

实例 Examples: 大田安良堡、尤溪茂荆堡、永安安贞堡 | 关联 Related: 土楼, 客家, 围屋, 防御建筑
红砖厝
Red-Brick Residence (Hongzhuan Cuo)

中文释义：红砖厝是闽南地区最典型的传统民居，以红砖为主要建筑材料，红瓦红墙，色彩鲜艳。红砖厝多为合院式布局，有'三间张''五间张'等形制，正面为镜面墙，屋顶为燕尾脊，装饰有剪粘、交趾陶等。红砖厝体现了闽南人对红色的崇尚和对海洋文化的包容，是闽南文化的物质载体。泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第等是红砖厝的代表。

English: Red-brick residences (hongzhuan cuo) are the most typical traditional residences in southern Fujian, using red bricks as the main building material with red tiles and red walls in vivid colors. Usually courtyard-style layouts with forms such as 'three-bay' and 'five-bay', they feature mirror walls at the front, swallow-tail ridges on the roof, and decorations of cut-and-paste porcelain and cochin pottery. Red-brick residences embody the Minnan reverence for red and openness to maritime culture, serving as material carriers of Minnan culture. Representative examples include the Cai Family Ancient Residences in Quanzhou and Zhongxian Di in Nan'an.

实例 Examples: 泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第、漳州官园大厝 | 关联 Related: 燕尾脊, 镜面墙, 出砖入石, 剪粘
三坊七巷
Three Lanes and Seven Alleys (Sanfang Qixiang)

中文释义：三坊七巷位于福州市中心，是中国现存规模最大、保存最完整的历史文化街区之一，始建于西晋，唐代形成格局，明清时期达到鼎盛。街区由三个坊（衣锦坊、文儒坊、光禄坊）和七条巷（杨桥巷、郎官巷、塔巷、黄巷、安民巷、宫巷、吉庇巷）组成，占地面积约38公顷，保存有明清古建筑200余座。三坊七巷是福州历史文化的缩影，被誉为'中国城市里坊制度的活化石'。

English: Three Lanes and Seven Alleys (Sanfang Qixiang), located in central Fuzhou, is one of China's largest and best-preserved historical and cultural districts. Founded in the Western Jin, its layout took shape in the Tang and flourished in the Ming-Qing. Comprising three lanes (Yijin, Wenru, Guanglu) and seven alleys (Yangqiao, Langguan, Ta, Huang, Anmin, Gong, Jibi), it covers about 38 hectares with over 200 Ming-Qing ancient buildings. A microcosm of Fuzhou's history and culture, it is known as the 'living fossil of China's urban ward system'.

实例 Examples: 福州林觉民故居、严复故居、沈葆桢故居 | 关联 Related: 马鞍墙, 马鞍脊, 福州建筑, 历史街区
闽南大厝
Minnan Grand Residence (Minnan Dacuo)

中文释义：闽南大厝是闽南地区大型传统民居的统称，以红砖、白石、燕尾脊为主要特征，规模宏大，装饰精美。闽南大厝多为多进合院式布局，有'二落大厝''三落大厝''四落大厝'等形制，两侧常有护厝（护龙），形成完整的建筑群。大厝内部有厅堂、天井、厢房、榉头等空间，体现了闽南家族制度和居住文化。

English: Minnan grand residences (minnan dacuo) is a general term for large traditional residences in southern Fujian, characterized by red bricks, white stone, and swallow-tail ridges, with grand scale and exquisite decoration. Usually multi-courtyard layouts with forms such as 'two-court', 'three-court', and 'four-court' grand residences, they often have side wings (hucuo/hulong) forming complete building complexes. Interior spaces include halls, courtyards, wing rooms, and jutou, reflecting Minnan clan systems and residential culture.

实例 Examples: 泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第、晋江梧林传统村落 | 关联 Related: 红砖厝, 燕尾脊, 镜面墙, 护厝
护厝
Side Wing (Hucuo)

中文释义：护厝是闽南大厝两侧的附属建筑，又称'护龙'，沿纵向排列，与主体建筑平行，中间有天井相隔。护厝通常为厨房、储藏、仆役居住等辅助功能，其数量和规模反映了家族的大小和财力。护厝的屋顶低于主体建筑，形成主次分明的轮廓，是闽南大厝布局的重要组成部分。

English: Side wings (hucuo), also called 'hulong' (protecting dragons), are auxiliary buildings on both sides of a Minnan grand residence, arranged longitudinally parallel to the main building with courtyards between them. Usually serving auxiliary functions such as kitchens, storage, and servant quarters, their number and scale reflect the family's size and wealth. The side wing roofs are lower than the main building, creating a clear hierarchical silhouette—an important component of Minnan grand residence layout.

实例 Examples: 泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第 | 关联 Related: 闽南大厝, 红砖厝, 榉头, 天井
妈祖庙
Mazu Temple (Mazumiao)

中文释义：妈祖庙是祭祀海上保护神妈祖的庙宇，福建是妈祖信仰的发源地，湄洲妈祖庙为祖庙。妈祖庙多为闽南建筑风格，有燕尾脊、剪粘装饰，布局包括山门、戏台、拜亭、正殿、寝殿等。福建沿海地区妈祖庙众多，其中莆田湄洲妈祖庙、泉州天后宫、厦门青礁慈济宫等最为著名。妈祖信仰随福建移民传播到台湾、东南亚等地，妈祖庙成为海上丝绸之路文化交流的见证。

English: Mazu temples are temples dedicated to Mazu, the sea goddess. Fujian is the birthplace of Mazu worship, with the Meizhou Mazu Temple as the ancestral temple. Usually in Minnan architectural style with swallow-tail ridges and cut-and-paste porcelain decoration, their layouts include a gate, stage, worship pavilion, main hall, and sleeping hall. Numerous Mazu temples dot the Fujian coast, with the most famous being Meizhou Mazu Temple in Putian, Tianhou Palace in Quanzhou, and Qingjiao Ciji Palace in Xiamen. Mazu worship spread with Fujian immigrants to Taiwan and Southeast Asia, making Mazu temples witnesses to Maritime Silk Road cultural exchange.

实例 Examples: 莆田湄洲妈祖庙、泉州天后宫、厦门青礁慈济宫 | 关联 Related: 闽南建筑, 燕尾脊, 剪粘, 海上丝绸之路
骑楼
Arcade Building (Qilou)

中文释义：骑楼是近代闽南和华南地区独特的商住建筑形式，建筑底层沿街面后退，留出公共人行空间，上层悬挑在人行道上方，形似骑在人行道上，故名。骑楼适应南方炎热多雨的气候，既为行人遮阳避雨，又为商铺提供展示空间。福建骑楼主要分布在厦门、泉州、漳州、福州等城市的老城区，是近代福建城市建筑的重要特征，融合了中西建筑风格。

English: Arcade buildings (qilou) are a unique commercial-residential architectural form in modern southern Fujian and South China, with the ground floor set back from the street to create public pedestrian space, and the upper floor cantilevered above the sidewalk—like riding on the sidewalk, hence the name. Suited to the hot and rainy southern climate, arcades provide shade and rain shelter for pedestrians while offering display space for shops. Mainly found in old urban districts of Xiamen, Quanzhou, Zhangzhou, and Fuzhou, Fujian arcades are an important feature of modern Fujian urban architecture, blending Chinese and Western styles.

实例 Examples: 厦门中山路、泉州中山路、漳州台湾路 | 关联 Related: 近代建筑, 闽南建筑, 红砖厝, 海派文化
廊桥
Lounge Bridge (Langqiao)

中文释义：廊桥是桥上建有廊屋的桥梁，既可供行人通行，又可避雨休息，还具有祭祀、交易等功能。福建廊桥主要分布在闽东北的宁德、南平地区，以木拱廊桥最为著名，此外还有石拱廊桥、木平梁廊桥等。福建廊桥数量众多，仅寿宁县就有19座，被誉为'世界廊桥之乡'。廊桥是闽东北山区交通和社会生活的重要组成部分。

English: Lounge bridges (langqiao) are bridges with covered corridors, providing passage for pedestrians while offering rain shelter and rest, as well as serving worship and trade functions. Fujian lounge bridges are mainly distributed in northeastern Fujian's Ningde and Nanping regions, with timber arch lounge bridges being the most famous, in addition to stone arch and timber beam lounge bridges. Fujian has numerous lounge bridges—Shouning County alone has 19, known as the 'Hometown of World Lounge Bridges'. Lounge bridges are important components of transportation and social life in the mountainous regions of northeastern Fujian.

实例 Examples: 屏南万安桥、寿宁升平桥、政和后山桥 | 关联 Related: 木拱廊桥, 虹梁, 闽东北建筑, 传统村落
客家土楼
Hakka Tulou (Kejia Tulou)

中文释义：客家土楼是客家人在福建西南部建造的大型集体住宅，是土楼的主要类型。客家土楼以圆形和方形为主，外墙以生土夯筑，厚达1-2米，内部为木结构，有3-5层，每层有30-50个房间，可供一个宗族的数十户人家居住。客家土楼体现了客家人聚族而居的传统和强烈的防御意识，永定客家土楼是福建土楼的核心组成部分。

English: Hakka tulou are large collective residences built by the Hakka people in southwestern Fujian, the main type of tulou. Mostly round or square, with outer walls rammed from raw earth 1-2 meters thick and wooden interiors of 3-5 stories, each floor has 30-50 rooms housing dozens of households of a clan. Hakka tulou embody the Hakka tradition of clan living and strong defensive awareness; Yongding Hakka tulou are the core component of Fujian tulou.

实例 Examples: 永定承启楼、永定振成楼、南靖和贵楼 | 关联 Related: 土楼, 客家, 土堡, 世界文化遗产
寺庙
Buddhist/Taoist Temple (Simiao)

中文释义：福建寺庙建筑融合了中原传统与闽南地方特色，既有福州华林寺这样的宋代木构珍品，也有泉州开元寺这样的闽南建筑典范。福建寺庙多为合院式布局，有山门、天王殿、大雄宝殿、法堂等，屋顶多为燕尾脊或歇山顶，装饰有剪粘、交趾陶、灰塑等。福建还是多种宗教的传播地，佛教、道教、伊斯兰教、基督教等建筑并存，体现了福建文化的多元性。

English: Fujian temple architecture blends Central Plains traditions with Minnan local characteristics, ranging from Song dynasty wooden treasures like Fuzhou's Hualin Temple to Minnan architectural models like Quanzhou's Kaiyuan Temple. Usually courtyard-style layouts with a gate, Heavenly Kings Hall, Mahavira Hall, and Dharma Hall, their roofs are mostly swallow-tail ridges or hip-and-gable roofs, decorated with cut-and-paste porcelain, cochin pottery, and gray plaster sculpture. Fujian is also a propagation ground for multiple religions, with Buddhist, Taoist, Islamic, and Christian buildings coexisting, reflecting Fujian's cultural diversity.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、福州华林寺、厦门南普陀 | 关联 Related: 燕尾脊, 剪粘, 妈祖庙, 宋代建筑
古汉城遗址
Ancient Han City Site (Guhancheng Yizhi)

中文释义：古汉城遗址位于武夷山市兴田镇，是西汉时期闽越国的都城遗址，距今约2200年。遗址面积约48万平方米，发现有城墙、宫殿基址、作坊、墓葬等，出土有大量汉代陶器、铜器、铁器等。古汉城遗址是中国南方保存最完整的汉代城址之一，是研究闽越文化和汉代南方建筑的重要遗址。

English: The Ancient Han City Site, located in Xingtian Town, Wuyishan City, is the capital site of the Minyue Kingdom during the Western Han dynasty, dating back about 2,200 years. Covering about 480,000 square meters, the site contains city walls, palace foundations, workshops, and tombs, with numerous Han pottery, bronze, and iron artifacts excavated. One of the best-preserved Han city sites in southern China, it is important for studying Minyue culture and Han dynasty southern architecture.

实例 Examples: 武夷山城村汉城遗址 | 关联 Related: 闽越文化, 武夷山, 汉代建筑, 遗址
传统村落
Traditional Village (Chuantong Cunluo)

中文释义：福建传统村落数量众多，类型丰富，包括闽南红砖厝村落、客家土楼村落、闽东北廊桥村落、闽西北土堡村落、沿海渔村等。福建有中国历史文化名镇名村数十个，中国传统村落数百个。这些村落保存了完整的传统建筑、街巷格局和民俗文化，是福建地域文化的活态载体。著名的有晋江梧林、龙岩培田、南平下梅、宁德漈下等。

English: Fujian has numerous and diverse traditional villages, including Minnan red-brick villages, Hakka tulou villages, northeastern Fujian lounge-bridge villages, northwestern Fujian tubao villages, and coastal fishing villages. Fujian has dozens of Chinese Famous Historical and Cultural Towns/Villages and hundreds of Chinese Traditional Villages. These villages preserve complete traditional architecture, street patterns, and folk culture, serving as living carriers of Fujian regional culture. Famous ones include Wulin in Jinjiang, Peitian in Longyan, Xiamei in Nanping, and Jixia in Ningde.

实例 Examples: 龙岩培田古民居、晋江梧林、南平下梅 | 关联 Related: 红砖厝, 土楼, 廊桥, 客家
建筑装饰 · Decoration (10)
灰塑
Gray Plaster Sculpture (Huisu)

中文释义：灰塑是福建传统建筑中常见的装饰工艺，以石灰、贝壳灰为主要材料，掺入红糖、糯米汁等，在建筑表面塑造各种图案。灰塑多用于屋脊、山花、门楣、照壁等部位，题材包括人物故事、花鸟瑞兽、博古图案等。福建灰塑工艺精湛，色彩丰富，是闽南和福州传统建筑装饰的重要组成部分。

English: Gray plaster sculpture (huisu) is a common decorative craft in traditional Fujian architecture, using lime and shell ash as main materials mixed with brown sugar and glutinous rice juice to mold various patterns on building surfaces. Mostly used on ridges, gables, lintels, and screen walls, subjects include figure stories, flowers, birds, auspicious animals, and antique patterns. With exquisite craftsmanship and rich colors, Fujian gray plaster sculpture is an important component of traditional Minnan and Fuzhou architectural decoration.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、福州三坊七巷、漳州南山寺 | 关联 Related: 剪粘, 交趾陶, 水车堵, 燕尾脊
木雕
Wood Carving (Mudiao)

中文释义：福建木雕是中国木雕艺术的重要流派，以莆田木雕、福州木雕、泉州木雕最为著名。福建木雕多用于建筑的梁枋、雀替、门窗、神龛等部位，技法包括浮雕、透雕、圆雕、镂雕等，题材丰富，工艺精湛。莆田木雕以精细入微著称，福州木雕以龙眼木为材料，泉州木雕则融合了闽南建筑的装饰风格。

English: Fujian wood carving is an important school of Chinese wood carving art, with Putian, Fuzhou, and Quanzhou wood carvings being the most famous. Mostly used on beams, spandrels, doors, windows, and shrines in buildings, techniques include relief, openwork, round, and hollow carving with rich subjects and exquisite craftsmanship. Putian wood carving is known for fine detail, Fuzhou wood carving uses longan wood, and Quanzhou wood carving blends Minnan architectural decorative styles.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、莆田元妙观、福州三坊七巷 | 关联 Related: 砖雕, 石雕, 闽南建筑, 三坊七巷
石雕
Stone Carving (Shidiao)

中文释义：福建石雕历史悠久，以惠安石雕最为著名，被誉为'中国石雕之乡'。福建石雕多用于建筑的台基、栏杆、柱础、石狮、牌坊等部位，技法包括圆雕、浮雕、透雕、线刻等。惠安石雕以龙柱、石狮最为著名，泉州开元寺的宋代石塔、天后宫的石雕都是福建石雕艺术的精品。

English: Fujian stone carving has a long history, with Hui'an stone carving being the most famous, known as the 'Hometown of Chinese Stone Carving'. Mostly used on building pedestals, railings, column bases, stone lions, and memorial arches, techniques include round carving, relief, openwork, and line carving. Hui'an stone carving is most famous for dragon columns and stone lions; the Song stone pagodas at Quanzhou's Kaiyuan Temple and the carvings at Tianhou Palace are fine examples of Fujian stone carving art.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺东西塔、惠安崇武古城、莆田妈祖庙 | 关联 Related: 木雕, 砖雕, 闽南建筑, 牌坊
砖雕
Brick Carving (Zhuandiao)

中文释义：福建砖雕是在红砖或青砖上雕刻图案的装饰工艺，多用于门楣、窗楣、照壁、山墙等部位。福建砖雕以闽南地区最为发达，题材包括人物故事、花鸟虫鱼、博古图案等，工艺精细，层次丰富。闽南砖雕与红砖厝建筑结合，形成了独特的装饰效果，是闽南建筑装饰的重要组成部分。

English: Fujian brick carving is a decorative technique of carving patterns on red or grey bricks, mostly used on door and window lintels, screen walls, and gables. Most developed in southern Fujian, subjects include figure stories, flowers, birds, insects, fish, and antique patterns, with fine craftsmanship and rich layers. Minnan brick carving, combined with red-brick residence architecture, creates unique decorative effects and is an important component of Minnan architectural decoration.

实例 Examples: 泉州蔡氏古民居、厦门鼓浪屿、漳州古城 | 关联 Related: 木雕, 石雕, 红砖厝, 闽南建筑
琉璃瓦
Glazed Tile (Liuliwa)

中文释义：琉璃瓦是表面施釉的陶瓦，福建地区的琉璃瓦以闽南寺庙使用最为广泛，颜色有黄、绿、蓝等。福建琉璃瓦工艺在明清时期达到高峰，泉州、漳州等地有专门的琉璃窑。琉璃瓦多用于寺庙的屋顶，与燕尾脊、剪粘等装饰配合，形成了闽南寺庙绚丽多彩的屋顶景观。

English: Glazed tiles are ceramic tiles with a glazed surface, most widely used in Minnan temples in Fujian, in colors including yellow, green, and blue. Fujian glazed tile craftsmanship reached its peak in the Ming-Qing period, with specialized kilns in Quanzhou and Zhangzhou. Glazed tiles are mostly used on temple roofs, combined with swallow-tail ridges and cut-and-paste porcelain decoration to create the brilliantly colorful roofscapes of Minnan temples.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、厦门南普陀、莆田湄洲妈祖庙 | 关联 Related: 燕尾脊, 剪粘, 寺庙, 闽南建筑
壁画
Mural (Bihua)

中文释义：福建寺庙和民居中保存有大量古代壁画，题材包括佛教故事、道教神仙、历史人物、花鸟山水等。福建壁画以闽南寺庙的壁画最为著名，色彩鲜艳，线条流畅，具有浓厚的地方特色。泉州开元寺、厦门青礁慈济宫、漳州南山寺等都保存有精美的古代壁画，是研究福建古代绘画艺术的重要实物。

English: Numerous ancient murals survive in Fujian temples and residences, with subjects including Buddhist stories, Taoist immortals, historical figures, flowers, birds, and landscapes. The most famous are murals in Minnan temples, with vivid colors and flowing lines, strong local characteristics. Quanzhou's Kaiyuan Temple, Xiamen's Qingjiao Ciji Palace, and Zhangzhou's Nanshan Temple all preserve exquisite ancient murals, important artifacts for studying ancient Fujian painting art.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、厦门青礁慈济宫、漳州南山寺 | 关联 Related: 寺庙, 闽南建筑, 彩塑, 灰塑
彩塑
Painted Sculpture (Caisu)

中文释义：福建寺庙中保存有大量彩塑，包括佛像、菩萨像、罗汉像、神像等。福建彩塑以闽南寺庙的泥塑和脱胎漆器最为著名，工艺精湛，色彩绚丽。泉州开元寺的宋代石佛、福州西禅寺的五百罗汉、莆田妈祖庙的妈祖像等都是福建彩塑艺术的精品。脱胎漆器是福州特有的工艺，用于制作佛像和陈设品。

English: Numerous painted sculptures survive in Fujian temples, including Buddha, bodhisattva, arhat, and deity statues. Fujian painted sculpture is most famous for clay sculpture and bodiless lacquerware in Minnan temples, with exquisite craftsmanship and brilliant colors. The Song stone Buddhas at Quanzhou's Kaiyuan Temple, the Five Hundred Arhats at Fuzhou's Xichan Temple, and the Mazu statue at Putian's Mazu Temple are fine examples. Bodiless lacquerware is a Fuzhou-specific craft used for Buddhist statues and ornaments.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、福州西禅寺、莆田湄洲妈祖庙 | 关联 Related: 寺庙, 壁画, 脱胎漆器, 闽南建筑
藻井
Caisson Ceiling (Zaojing)

中文释义：藻井是中国古代建筑天花板上的装饰性凹面结构，福建地区的藻井以闽南寺庙和福州华林寺最为著名。福建藻井多为八角形或圆形，层层叠涩，中心雕刻或绘制龙凤、莲花等图案，工艺精湛。泉州开元寺大雄宝殿的藻井、福州华林寺大殿的藻井都是福建古代建筑装饰的精品。

English: The caisson ceiling (zaojing) is a decorative sunken structure in ancient Chinese ceilings, with Fujian's most famous examples in Minnan temples and Fuzhou's Hualin Temple. Mostly octagonal or round with stacked moldings, the center is carved or painted with dragons, phoenixes, or lotuses in exquisite craftsmanship. The caissons at Quanzhou's Kaiyuan Temple Mahavira Hall and Fuzhou's Hualin Temple Main Hall are fine examples of ancient Fujian architectural decoration.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、福州华林寺、莆田元妙观 | 关联 Related: 斗拱, 寺庙, 宋代建筑, 闽南建筑
悬鱼惹草
Hanging Fish and Grass (Xuanyu Recao)

中文释义：悬鱼惹草是中国古代建筑博风板下的装饰构件，悬鱼为鱼形，惹草为草形，具有装饰和防火的象征意义。福建地区的悬鱼惹草在继承中原传统的基础上形成了地方特色，闽南地区多为剪粘或灰塑制作，福州地区则多为木雕。福建悬鱼惹草造型丰富，是传统建筑山面装饰的重要组成部分。

English: Hanging fish and grass (xuanyu recao) are decorative components below the gable boards of ancient Chinese architecture—the hanging fish is fish-shaped and the grass is plant-shaped, with both decorative and fire-prevention symbolic meaning. Fujian's hanging fish and grass developed local characteristics while inheriting Central Plains traditions: in Minnan they are mostly made of cut-and-paste porcelain or gray plaster, while in Fuzhou they are mostly wood-carved. With rich forms, they are important components of traditional building gable decoration in Fujian.

实例 Examples: 泉州蔡氏古民居、福州三坊七巷、漳州古城 | 关联 Related: 燕尾脊, 灰塑, 剪粘, 闽南建筑
石敢当
Stone Tablet (Shigandang)

中文释义：石敢当是福建民间广泛使用的镇宅辟邪石刻，通常刻有'石敢当'或'泰山石敢当'字样，立于街巷口、宅门前或桥梁旁，具有辟邪镇宅的功能。福建石敢当分布广泛，造型多样，有的刻有狮首、八卦等图案。石敢当是福建民间信仰和建筑文化的独特现象，反映了福建人对居住环境的风水观念。

English: Stone tablets (shigandang) are widely used evil-warding stone carvings in Fujian folk culture, usually inscribed with 'Shigandang' or 'Taishan Shigandang', placed at street intersections, in front of residences, or beside bridges to ward off evil and protect the home. Widely distributed in Fujian with diverse forms, some are carved with lion heads or bagua patterns. Shigandang is a unique phenomenon of Fujian folk belief and architectural culture, reflecting Fujian people's fengshui concepts about living environments.

实例 Examples: 泉州古城、福州三坊七巷、漳州古城 | 关联 Related: 闽南建筑, 民间信仰, 传统村落, 风水
建筑材料 · Materials (5)
红砖
Red Brick (Hongzhuan)

中文释义：红砖是闽南地区最具特色的建筑材料，以当地黏土烧制而成，呈鲜艳的红色，质地坚硬。闽南红砖与北方青砖不同，其烧制温度更高，氧化铁含量高，呈现出独特的红色。红砖在闽南建筑中用于墙体、地面、装饰等各个部位，形成了'红砖文化'。闽南红砖的使用与福建人的海洋文化和对红色的崇尚密切相关。

English: Red brick is the most distinctive building material in southern Fujian, fired from local clay into vivid red, hard bricks. Unlike northern grey bricks, Minnan red bricks are fired at higher temperatures with high iron oxide content, producing their unique red color. Used in walls, floors, and decoration in Minnan architecture, red bricks formed the 'red-brick culture'. The use of red brick in Minnan is closely related to Fujian's maritime culture and reverence for the color red.

实例 Examples: 泉州蔡氏古民居、厦门鼓浪屿、漳州古城 | 关联 Related: 红砖厝, 出砖入石, 镜面墙, 闽南建筑
花岗岩
Granite (Huagangyan)

中文释义：福建是中国花岗岩资源最丰富的省份之一，花岗岩是福建传统建筑中最重要的石材。福建花岗岩质地坚硬，色泽丰富，广泛用于建筑的台基、柱子、栏杆、墙体、石狮等。闽南建筑中常见的'出砖入石'就是红砖与花岗岩的组合使用。惠安石雕以花岗岩为主要材料，是中国石雕艺术的重要流派。

English: Fujian is one of China's provinces richest in granite resources, and granite is the most important stone material in traditional Fujian architecture. Fujian granite is hard with rich colors, widely used for building pedestals, columns, railings, walls, and stone lions. The common 'brick-and-stone wall' (chuzhuan rushi) in Minnan architecture combines red brick with granite. Hui'an stone carving, using granite as its main material, is an important school of Chinese stone carving art.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、惠安崇武古城、厦门鼓浪屿 | 关联 Related: 出砖入石, 石雕, 红砖厝, 闽南建筑
生土
Raw Earth (Shengtu)

中文释义：生土是福建土楼和土堡的主要建筑材料，以当地黏土、砂石、石灰等混合，加入糯米汁、红糖等增强强度，分层夯筑而成。生土墙体厚达1-2米，具有良好的保温隔热性能和防御功能。福建生土建筑技术历史悠久，客家土楼是生土建筑的巅峰之作，2008年被列入世界文化遗产名录。

English: Raw earth is the main building material of Fujian tulou and tubao, mixed from local clay, sand, gravel, and lime, with glutinous rice juice and brown sugar added to enhance strength, rammed in layers. Raw earth walls are 1-2 meters thick, with excellent thermal insulation and defensive functions. Fujian raw earth building technology has a long history; Hakka tulou represent the pinnacle of raw earth architecture and were listed as UNESCO World Heritage Sites in 2008.

实例 Examples: 永定承启楼、南靖田螺坑、大田安良堡 | 关联 Related: 土楼, 土堡, 客家, 世界文化遗产
蚵壳
Oyster Shell (Keke)

中文释义：蚵壳（牡蛎壳）是泉州沿海地区独特的建筑材料，用于砌筑蚵壳厝的墙体。蚵壳多为宋元时期海外贸易从东南亚运回的牡蛎壳，体积大，质地轻，具有隔热、防碱、防风的特点。蚵壳厝是海上丝绸之路的实物见证，体现了福建海洋文化的独特性。蚵壳主要分布在泉州鲟埔、法石等沿海地区。

English: Oyster shells are a unique building material in coastal Quanzhou, used to build the walls of oyster-shell houses. Mostly brought back from Southeast Asia during Song-Yuan overseas trade, the shells are large and light, with thermal insulation, alkali resistance, and wind resistance. Oyster-shell houses are material evidence of the Maritime Silk Road, reflecting the uniqueness of Fujian maritime culture. Oyster shells are mainly distributed in coastal areas such as Xunpu and Fashi in Quanzhou.

实例 Examples: 泉州鲟埔蚵壳厝、泉州法石蚵壳厝 | 关联 Related: 蚵壳厝, 红砖, 海上丝绸之路, 闽南建筑
木材
Timber (Mucai)

中文释义：福建森林资源丰富，木材是传统建筑中最重要的材料之一。福建传统建筑以木结构为主，福州华林寺大殿、泉州玄妙观三清殿等宋代木构建筑是中国古代建筑的珍品。闽东北木拱廊桥完全以木材搭接而成，不用一钉一铆，体现了福建古代木构技术的高超水平。福建木材种类丰富，杉木、松木、楠木、樟木等都用于建筑。

English: Fujian is rich in forest resources, and timber is one of the most important materials in traditional architecture. Traditional Fujian architecture is mainly timber-framed; Song dynasty wooden buildings such as Fuzhou's Hualin Temple Main Hall and Quanzhou's Xuanmiao Temple Sanqing Hall are treasures of ancient Chinese architecture. Northeastern Fujian's timber arch lounge bridges are built entirely with timber joinery without a single nail or rivet, demonstrating the high level of ancient Fujian timber technology. Fujian has rich timber species including fir, pine, nanmu, and camphor, all used in construction.

实例 Examples: 福州华林寺、屏南万安桥、泉州玄妙观 | 关联 Related: 木拱廊桥, 斗拱, 宋代建筑, 闽东北建筑
文化背景 · Cultural Context (10)
世界文化遗产
World Cultural Heritage

中文释义：福建拥有多项世界文化遗产：福建土楼（2008年，永定、南靖、华安）、鼓浪屿（2017年，厦门）、泉州：宋元中国的世界海洋商贸中心（2021年，包括22处遗产点）。此外，武夷山（1999年，文化与自然双重遗产）也包含丰富的古建筑。这些遗产是福建古建筑和文化景观的精华，体现了福建作为海上丝绸之路起点的历史地位。

English: Fujian has multiple UNESCO World Cultural Heritage sites: Fujian Tulou (2008, Yongding, Nanjing, Hua'an), Gulangyu (2017, Xiamen), and 'Quanzhou: Emporium of the World in Song-Yuan China' (2021, including 22 heritage sites). In addition, Wuyi Mountain (1999, mixed cultural and natural heritage) contains rich ancient architecture. These heritage sites represent the essence of Fujian's ancient architecture and cultural landscapes, reflecting Fujian's historical position as the starting point of the Maritime Silk Road.

实例 Examples: 福建土楼、鼓浪屿、泉州宋元海洋商贸中心 | 关联 Related: 土楼, 闽南建筑, 海上丝绸之路, 客家
海上丝绸之路
Maritime Silk Road (Haihang Sichouzhilu)

中文释义：福建是海上丝绸之路的重要起点和核心区域，泉州在宋元时期是世界第一大港，与世界100多个国家和地区有贸易往来。海上丝绸之路对福建建筑产生了深远影响：蚵壳厝使用了海外贸易运回的牡蛎壳，闽南建筑中的伊斯兰元素、印度教元素、佛教元素都体现了文化交流。泉州开元寺、清净寺、天后宫等都是海上丝绸之路的建筑见证。

English: Fujian is an important starting point and core region of the Maritime Silk Road. Quanzhou was the world's largest port in the Song-Yuan period, trading with over 100 countries and regions. The Maritime Silk Road profoundly influenced Fujian architecture: oyster-shell houses used shells brought back from overseas trade, and Islamic, Hindu, and Buddhist elements in Minnan architecture reflect cultural exchange. Quanzhou's Kaiyuan Temple, Qingjing Mosque, and Tianhou Palace are all architectural witnesses of the Maritime Silk Road.

实例 Examples: 泉州开元寺、泉州清净寺、泉州天后宫 | 关联 Related: 闽南建筑, 蚵壳厝, 妈祖庙, 世界文化遗产
客家文化
Hakka Culture (Kejia Wenhua)

中文释义：客家是汉民族的重要支系，福建西部是客家民系的形成地和主要聚居地。客家人在迁徙过程中创造了独特的建筑文化，以土楼、围屋、土堡为代表，体现了客家人聚族而居、崇文重教、坚韧不拔的精神。福建客家建筑主要分布在龙岩、三明等地，永定客家土楼是客家建筑的巅峰之作，2008年被列入世界文化遗产名录。

English: The Hakka are an important branch of the Han Chinese, and western Fujian is the formation place and main settlement of the Hakka people. During their migrations, the Hakka created a unique architectural culture represented by tulou, weiwu (enclosed houses), and tubao, reflecting the Hakka spirit of clan living, reverence for education, and resilience. Fujian Hakka architecture is mainly distributed in Longyan and Sanming; Yongding Hakka tulou represent the pinnacle of Hakka architecture and were listed as UNESCO World Heritage Sites in 2008.

实例 Examples: 永定承启楼、永定振成楼、龙岩培田古民居 | 关联 Related: 土楼, 客家土楼, 土堡, 传统村落
闽南文化
Minnan Culture (Minnan Wenhua)

中文释义：闽南文化是福建南部地区形成的地域文化，以泉州、厦门、漳州为核心，以闽南语为载体，以海洋文化和商业文化为特色。闽南文化在建筑上体现为红砖厝、燕尾脊、剪粘、交趾陶、出砖入石等独特元素，以及妈祖信仰、保生大帝信仰等民间宗教。闽南文化随移民传播到台湾、东南亚等地，对当地建筑产生了深远影响。

English: Minnan culture is a regional culture formed in southern Fujian, centered on Quanzhou, Xiamen, and Zhangzhou, with the Minnan language as its carrier and maritime and commercial culture as its characteristics. In architecture, Minnan culture manifests as unique elements including red-brick residences, swallow-tail ridges, cut-and-paste porcelain, cochin pottery, and brick-and-stone walls, as well as folk religions such as Mazu and Baosheng Dadi worship. Minnan culture spread with immigrants to Taiwan and Southeast Asia, profoundly influencing local architecture.

实例 Examples: 泉州蔡氏古民居、厦门鼓浪屿、漳州古城 | 关联 Related: 红砖厝, 燕尾脊, 剪粘, 妈祖庙
闽越文化
Minyue Culture (Minyue Wenhua)

中文释义：闽越文化是先秦至汉代福建地区闽越族创造的地域文化，是福建文化的源头之一。闽越人擅长造船和航海，创造了独特的干栏式建筑和悬棺葬俗。武夷山城村汉城遗址是闽越国的都城遗址，出土有大量闽越文化遗物。闽越文化后来与中原文化融合，形成了福建文化的基础，对福建建筑的干栏式、巢居式传统有深远影响。

English: Minyue culture is a regional culture created by the Minyue people in Fujian from the pre-Qin to Han periods, one of the sources of Fujian culture. The Minyue were skilled at shipbuilding and navigation, creating unique stilt-style architecture and cliff burial customs. the Ancient Han City Site at Chengcun, Wuyishan, was the capital of the Minyue Kingdom, yielding numerous Minyue cultural relics. Minyue culture later merged with Central Plains culture to form the foundation of Fujian culture, profoundly influencing Fujian's stilt and nest-style architectural traditions.

实例 Examples: 武夷山城村汉城遗址、闽侯昙石山遗址 | 关联 Related: 古汉城遗址, 武夷山, 干栏式建筑, 汉代建筑
妈祖信仰
Mazu Belief (Mazu Xinyang)

中文释义：妈祖信仰起源于福建莆田湄洲岛，妈祖（林默娘）是宋代莆田的一位女子，因救助海难而被尊为海上保护神。妈祖信仰随福建移民传播到中国沿海、台湾、东南亚等地，成为全球华人最重要的民间信仰之一。福建有妈祖庙数千座，湄洲妈祖庙为祖庙。妈祖信仰对福建建筑产生了深远影响，妈祖庙的建筑风格和装饰成为闽南建筑的重要组成部分。

English: Mazu belief originated on Meizhou Island, Putian, Fujian. Mazu (Lin Moniang) was a Song dynasty woman from Putian who was revered as a sea goddess after dying while rescuing people from shipwrecks. Mazu belief spread with Fujian immigrants to China's coasts, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia, becoming one of the most important folk beliefs of Chinese people worldwide. Fujian has thousands of Mazu temples, with Meizhou Mazu Temple as the ancestral temple. Mazu belief profoundly influenced Fujian architecture, with the architectural style and decoration of Mazu temples becoming important components of Minnan architecture.

实例 Examples: 莆田湄洲妈祖庙、泉州天后宫、厦门青礁慈济宫 | 关联 Related: 妈祖庙, 闽南建筑, 海上丝绸之路, 民间信仰
福州文化
Fuzhou Culture (Fuzhou Wenhua)

中文释义：福州文化是以福州为中心的闽东地域文化，以福州语为载体，具有深厚的历史文化底蕴。福州是福建省会，有2200多年建城史，三坊七巷是福州文化的集中体现。福州建筑以马鞍墙、马鞍脊为标志，与闽南燕尾脊形成鲜明对比。福州还是脱胎漆器、寿山石雕、软木画等传统工艺的发源地，这些工艺广泛用于建筑装饰。

English: Fuzhou culture is the eastern Fujian regional culture centered on Fuzhou, with the Fuzhou dialect as its carrier and profound historical heritage. Fuzhou, the provincial capital, has over 2,200 years of city history, with Three Lanes and Seven Alleys as the concentrated embodiment of Fuzhou culture. Fuzhou architecture is marked by saddle walls and saddle ridges, contrasting sharply with Minnan's swallow-tail ridges. Fuzhou is also the birthplace of traditional crafts including bodiless lacquerware, Shoushan stone carving, and cork painting, widely used in architectural decoration.

实例 Examples: 福州三坊七巷、福州华林寺、闽清宏琳厝 | 关联 Related: 三坊七巷, 马鞍墙, 马鞍脊, 脱胎漆器
闽东北文化
Northeastern Fujian Culture (Mindongbei Wenhua)

中文释义：闽东北文化是以宁德、南平为中心的山区地域文化，以木拱廊桥、传统村落、畲族文化为特色。闽东北山区交通不便，保留了大量传统建筑和民俗文化。木拱廊桥是闽东北最具代表性的建筑，屏南、寿宁等地被誉为'世界廊桥之乡'。宁德还是畲族的主要聚居地，畲族建筑和文化是闽东北文化的重要组成部分。

English: Northeastern Fujian culture is a mountainous regional culture centered on Ningde and Nanping, characterized by timber arch lounge bridges, traditional villages, and She ethnic culture. Due to inconvenient transportation, the mountainous regions of northeastern Fujian preserve numerous traditional buildings and folk culture. Timber arch lounge bridges are the most representative architecture of northeastern Fujian, with Pingnan and Shouning known as the 'Hometown of World Lounge Bridges'. Ningde is also the main settlement of the She ethnic group, whose architecture and culture are important components of northeastern Fujian culture.

实例 Examples: 屏南万安桥、寿宁升平桥、宁德漈下村 | 关联 Related: 木拱廊桥, 廊桥, 虹梁, 传统村落
近代建筑
Modern Architecture (Jindai Jianzhu)

中文释义：福建近代建筑融合了中西建筑风格，以厦门鼓浪屿、福州仓山、泉州中山路等最为著名。鼓浪屿是近代万国建筑博览会，保存有1000多栋近代建筑，包括英式、法式、德式、日式、闽南式等多种风格，2017年被列入世界文化遗产名录。福建近代建筑体现了福建作为沿海开放地区的文化交流和融合，是中国近代建筑史的重要组成部分。

English: Modern Fujian architecture blends Chinese and Western styles, with the most famous examples on Xiamen's Gulangyu Island, Fuzhou's Cangshan, and Quanzhou's Zhongshan Road. Gulangyu is a modern international architecture expo, preserving over 1,000 modern buildings in British, French, German, Japanese, and Minnan styles, listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2017. Modern Fujian architecture reflects cultural exchange and fusion in Fujian as a coastal open region, serving as an important component of modern Chinese architectural history.

实例 Examples: 厦门鼓浪屿、福州仓山老洋房、泉州中山路骑楼 | 关联 Related: 骑楼, 鼓浪屿, 海派文化, 世界文化遗产
脱胎漆器
Bodiless Lacquerware (Tuotai Qiqi)

中文释义：脱胎漆器是福州特有的传统工艺，与景德镇瓷器、北京景泰蓝并称中国传统工艺三宝。脱胎漆器以泥土或石膏为胎，裱以夏布或绸布，涂漆后去掉内胎，形成轻巧坚固的漆器。脱胎漆器工艺精湛，色彩绚丽，广泛用于佛像、陈设品和建筑装饰。福州脱胎漆器始于清代乾隆年间，至今已有200多年历史。

English: Bodiless lacquerware is a Fuzhou-specific traditional craft, ranked with Jingdezhen porcelain and Beijing cloisonné as one of the Three Treasures of traditional Chinese crafts. Using clay or plaster as a core, wrapped with linen or silk cloth, lacquered, and then removing the inner core to form light and sturdy lacquerware. With exquisite craftsmanship and brilliant colors, it is widely used for Buddhist statues, ornaments, and architectural decoration. Fuzhou bodiless lacquerware began in the Qianlong era of the Qing dynasty, with a history of over 200 years.

实例 Examples: 福州脱胎漆器厂、福州西禅寺佛像 | 关联 Related: 彩塑, 福州文化, 三坊七巷, 传统工艺

1
塔与桥梁 Pagodas and Bridges
石塔
Stone Pagoda (Shita)
以石材建造的佛塔或风水塔，福建地区保存了大量唐宋时期的石塔，多为仿木结构楼阁式塔，雕刻精美，是研究古代建筑和佛教艺术的重要实物。
Buddhist or feng shui pagodas built of stone; the Fujian region preserves a large number of stone pagodas from the Tang and Song dynasties, mostly timber-structure-imitating pavilion-style pagodas with exquisite carvings, important physical evidence for studying ancient architecture and Buddhist art.
典型实例 Examples
泉州东西塔、莆田无尘塔、云霄石矾塔、厦门婆罗门教塔
楼阁式塔
Pavilion-Style Pagoda (Lougeshi Ta)
中国佛塔的主要类型之一，模仿中国传统楼阁建筑形式，分层设塔身、塔檐、平座，可登临眺望，泉州开元寺东西塔是中国现存最高的一对石构楼阁式塔。
One of the main types of Chinese Buddhist pagodas, imitating the form of traditional Chinese pavilion architecture, with layered tower bodies, eaves and flat seats, accessible for viewing; the East and West Pagodas of Quanzhou Kaiyuan Temple are the tallest existing pair of stone pavilion-style pagodas in China.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺东西塔、莆田东岩山报恩寺塔、厦门婆罗门教塔、云霄石矾塔
宝箧印经塔
Sutra-Printing Stupa (Baoqie Yinjing Ta)
佛塔的一种形式，模仿古印度宝箧（藏经匣）形状，塔身方形，四角立柱，塔顶为塔刹，莆田天中万寿塔是中国现存最大的宝箧印经塔实例。
A type of Buddhist pagoda, imitating the shape of ancient Indian treasure boxes (sutra storage boxes), with a square tower body, columns at the four corners, and a spire at the top; the Tianzhong Wanshou Pagoda in Putian is the largest existing example of a sutra-printing stupa in China.
典型实例 Examples
莆田天中万寿塔、泉州开元寺阿育王塔、厦门婆罗门教塔
石梁桥
Stone Beam Bridge (Shiliangqiao)
以巨大石梁横跨桥墩的桥梁形式，福建沿海地区保存了多座宋代石梁桥，泉州洛阳桥、安平桥是中国古代石梁桥的杰出代表。
A bridge form with huge stone beams spanning bridge piers; the coastal region of Fujian preserves multiple Song dynasty stone beam bridges, and Quanzhou Luoyang Bridge and Anping Bridge are outstanding representatives of ancient Chinese stone beam bridges.
典型实例 Examples
泉州洛阳桥、晋江安平桥、莆田宁海桥、龙海江东桥
筏形基础
Raft Foundation (Faxing Jichu)
泉州洛阳桥首创的桥梁基础形式，在江底沿桥梁中线抛置大量石块，形成一条横跨江底的矮石堤，再在其上建造桥墩，是世界上最早的筏形基础工程。
A bridge foundation form pioneered by Quanzhou Luoyang Bridge, where a large number of stones are thrown along the bridge centerline at the river bottom, forming a low stone embankment across the river bottom, on which bridge piers are then built; it is the world's earliest raft foundation engineering.
典型实例 Examples
泉州洛阳桥、晋江安平桥
种蛎固基
Oyster-Cultivation Foundation (Zhongli Guji)
泉州洛阳桥首创的桥梁加固技术，在桥基和桥墩上养殖牡蛎，利用牡蛎外壳的附着力将桥基石块胶结成整体，是世界上最早将生物学应用于桥梁工程的创举。
A bridge reinforcement technology pioneered by Quanzhou Luoyang Bridge, where oysters are cultivated on the bridge foundation and piers, using the adhesion of oyster shells to cement the foundation stones into a whole; it is the world's earliest initiative to apply biology to bridge engineering.
典型实例 Examples
泉州洛阳桥
2
墙体与基础 Walls and Foundations
夯土墙
Rammed Earth Wall (Hangtuqiang)
以生土为主要材料，通过模板分层夯实而成的墙体，是福建土楼、土堡、庄寨等防御性建筑的主要外墙形式，具有保温隔热、防火抗震等优良性能。
Walls made mainly of raw earth, compacted layer by layer through formwork; they are the main outer wall form of defensive buildings such as Fujian tulou, earthen forts and fortified manors, with excellent properties including thermal insulation, fire resistance and earthquake resistance.
典型实例 Examples
永定土楼、南靖土楼、大田土堡、永泰庄寨
三合土
Three-in-One Soil (Sanhetu)
由石灰、黏土、沙子（或糯米浆、红糖等）按比例混合而成的建筑材料，强度高、耐久性好，常用于福建土楼的墙基、地面和屋面防水层。
A building material made by mixing lime, clay and sand (or glutinous rice paste, brown sugar, etc.) in proportion, with high strength and good durability; commonly used for the foundations, floors and roof waterproofing layers of Fujian tulou.
典型实例 Examples
赵家堡完璧楼、南靖怀远楼、华安二宜楼、平和庄上大楼
鹅卵石墙基
Cobblestone Foundation (Eluan Shi Qiangji)
福建土楼和民居中常见的基础形式，以河流中天然鹅卵石砌筑墙基，高出地面1-2米，既防潮又防洪水，上部再接夯土墙或砖墙。
A common foundation form in Fujian tulou and residences, using natural cobblestones from rivers to build the wall foundation, 1-2 meters above ground, both moisture-proof and flood-proof, with rammed earth or brick walls connected above.
典型实例 Examples
南靖河坑土楼群、平和绳武楼、华安大地土楼群、永泰庄寨
马鞍墙
Saddle Wall (Ma'anqiang)
福州及闽东地区民居中特有的山墙形式，墙顶呈马鞍形曲线，高出屋面，具有防火、防风功能，是福州三坊七巷等传统街区的标志性景观。
A distinctive gable wall form in residences of Fuzhou and eastern Fujian, with the wall top forming a saddle-shaped curve, rising above the roof, with fire-prevention and wind-protection functions; it is the iconic landscape of traditional districts such as Fuzhou's Three Lanes and Seven Alleys.
典型实例 Examples
福州三坊七巷、闽清宏琳厝、宁德民居、永泰庄寨
3
宗教与礼制建筑 Religious and Ritual Architecture
妈祖庙
Mazu Temple (Mazumiao)
供奉海神妈祖（林默娘）的庙宇，起源于福建莆田湄洲岛，是中国沿海地区最重要的民间信仰建筑之一，湄洲妈祖庙是全世界妈祖庙的祖庙。
Temples enshrining the sea goddess Mazu (Lin Moniang), originating from Meizhou Island in Putian, Fujian; one of the most important folk belief buildings in China's coastal regions, and Meizhou Mazu Temple is the ancestral temple of all Mazu temples worldwide.
典型实例 Examples
莆田湄洲妈祖庙、莆田平海天后宫、泉州天后宫、厦门顺济宫
慈济宫
Ciji Palace (Cijigong)
供奉保生大帝（吴夲）的庙宇，保生大帝是闽南地区最重要的医神信仰，厦门青礁慈济宫和漳州白礁慈济宫是慈济信仰的两大祖庙。
Temples enshrining the Great Emperor of Life Preservation (Wu Tao), the most important medical deity belief in the Minnan region; Xiamen Qingjiao Ciji Palace and Zhangzhou Baijiao Ciji Palace are the two ancestral temples of the Ciji belief.
典型实例 Examples
厦门青礁慈济祖宫、漳州白礁慈济宫、泉州花桥慈济宫
关帝庙
Guandi Temple (Guandimiao)
供奉三国蜀汉名将关羽的庙宇，关羽被尊为武圣、武财神，是中国民间信仰中最广泛的神祇之一，福建东山关帝庙是台湾关帝庙的祖庙。
Temples enshrining Guan Yu, the famous general of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period, revered as the Martial Sage and Martial God of Wealth, one of the most widely worshipped deities in Chinese folk belief; Dongshan Guandi Temple in Fujian is the ancestral temple of Taiwan's Guandi temples.
典型实例 Examples
东山关帝庙、泉州通淮关岳庙、诏安悬钟所关帝庙、平和城隍庙配殿
文庙
Confucian Temple (Wenmiao)
供奉孔子的礼制建筑，又称孔庙，是古代地方官学和祭祀孔子的场所，通常包括大成殿、明伦堂、泮池、棂星门等建筑，福建各地保存了多座明清时期的文庙。
Ritual buildings enshrining Confucius, also called Confucian temples, serving as ancient local government schools and places for sacrificing to Confucius, usually including the Dacheng Hall, Minglun Hall, Pan Pond and Lingxing Gate; multiple Ming and Qing dynasty Confucian temples are preserved throughout Fujian.
典型实例 Examples
泉州府文庙、漳州府文庙、福州文庙、莆田文庙
城隍庙
City God Temple (Chenghuangmiao)
供奉城隍神的庙宇，城隍是古代城市的保护神，城隍庙通常与县衙并设，是中国古代城市的重要标志建筑，福建平和城隍庙因王阳明奏建而具有特殊历史价值。
Temples enshrining the City God, the protective deity of ancient cities; City God Temples were usually established alongside county government offices, serving as important landmark buildings of ancient Chinese cities; Pinghe City God Temple in Fujian has special historical value due to being built by Wang Yangming's memorial request.
典型实例 Examples
平和城隍庙、诏安城隍庙、福州城隍庙、泉州城隍庙
石牌坊
Stone Archway (Shipaifang)
以石材建造的纪念性牌坊，用于表彰功德、科举、节孝等，福建地区保存了大量明清石牌坊，多为仿木结构，雕刻精美，长泰武安牌坊群、诏安南诏牌坊群是代表性实例。
Memorial archways built of stone, used to commend merits, imperial examinations, chastity and filial piety, etc.; the Fujian region preserves a large number of Ming and Qing stone archways, mostly imitating timber structures with exquisite carvings; Changtai Wu'an Archway Cluster and Zhao'an Nanzhao Archway Cluster are representative examples.
典型实例 Examples
长泰武安牌坊群、诏安南诏牌坊群、漳州石牌坊、仙游东门石坊
宗祠
Ancestral Hall (Zongci)
供奉祖先牌位、举行宗族祭祀活动的建筑，是中国宗法制度的物质载体，福建地区聚族而居的传统使得宗祠建筑特别发达，闽南宗祠装饰华丽，客家宗祠简朴庄重。
Buildings enshrining ancestral tablets and holding clan sacrificial activities, the material carrier of the Chinese patriarchal system; the tradition of clan-based living in the Fujian region makes ancestral hall architecture particularly developed, with Minnan ancestral halls gorgeously decorated and Hakka ancestral halls simple and solemn.
典型实例 Examples
泉州陈埭丁氏宗祠、晋江衙口施氏大宗祠、长泰杨氏宗祠、南靖塔下张氏家庙
书院
Academy (Shuyuan)
中国古代的教育机构，兼具教学、祭祀、藏书功能，福建是书院发达地区，漳州松州书院是中国最早的书院之一，创办于唐景龙二年（708年）。
Ancient Chinese educational institutions, combining teaching, sacrifice and book-collection functions; Fujian is a region with developed academies, and Zhangzhou Songzhou Academy is one of the earliest academies in China, founded in the second year of Jinglong reign of the Tang (708).
典型实例 Examples
漳州松州书院、漳州霞东书院、尤溪豫章书院、福州鳌峰书院
4
屋顶形式 Roof Forms
歇山顶
Hip-and-Gable Roof (Xieshan)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，又称九脊顶，由一条正脊、四条垂脊和四条戗脊组成，上半部为悬山式，下半部为庑殿式，常用于宫殿、寺庙、园林建筑中等级较高的建筑。福建地区寺庙大殿多采用此形式。
One of the traditional Chinese architectural roof forms, also called the nine-ridge roof, consisting of one main ridge, four vertical ridges and four diagonal ridges; the upper half is of the overhanging gable type and the lower half of the hip type, commonly used for higher-ranking buildings in palaces, temples and gardens. Temple main halls in Fujian often adopt this form.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺大雄宝殿、福州华林寺大殿、漳州南山寺、平和城隍庙大殿
燕尾脊
Swallowtail Ridge (Yanweiji)
闽南地区特有的屋脊形式，正脊两端向上翘起，形似燕尾分叉，曲线优美，是闽南红砖建筑的标志性特征。燕尾脊有单燕、双燕之分，常见于寺庙、祠堂和大型民居。
A distinctive ridge form unique to southern Fujian, where both ends of the main ridge curve upward and fork like a swallow's tail, with elegant curves; it is the iconic feature of Minnan red-brick architecture. Swallowtail ridges are divided into single-swallowtail and double-swallowtail types, commonly seen in temples, ancestral halls and large residences.
典型实例 Examples
泉州蔡氏古民居、厦门青礁慈济祖宫、漳州白礁慈济宫、南安中宪第
马鞍脊
Saddle Ridge (Ma'anji)
福建民居中常见的屋脊形式，山墙顶部呈马鞍形曲线，两端高中间低，形似马鞍。福州、闽东地区民居多用马鞍墙，具有防火、防风功能。
A common ridge form in Fujian vernacular architecture, where the top of the gable wall forms a saddle-shaped curve, high at both ends and low in the middle, resembling a saddle. Residences in Fuzhou and eastern Fujian often use saddle walls, with fire-prevention and wind-protection functions.
典型实例 Examples
福州三坊七巷民居、宁德廊桥、闽清宏琳厝、永泰庄寨
悬山顶
Overhanging Gable Roof (Xuanshan)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，又称挑山顶，两山屋顶伸出山墙之外，檩木暴露在外，是民间建筑中最常见的屋顶形式。福建土楼内环建筑多采用此形式。
A traditional Chinese roof form, also called the overhanging mountain roof, where the two gable roofs extend beyond the gable walls with exposed purlins, the most common roof form in vernacular architecture. The inner-ring buildings of Fujian tulou often adopt this form.
典型实例 Examples
永定土楼内环建筑、南靖云水谣民居、平和绳武楼、华安大地土楼群
硬山顶
Flush Gable Roof (Yingshan)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，山墙与屋顶齐平或高出屋顶，檩木不外露，防火性能较好。福建闽南红砖厝多采用硬山顶配合马鞍墙或出砖入石墙面。
A traditional Chinese roof form where the gable walls are flush with or rise above the roof, with no exposed purlins, with relatively good fire resistance. Minnan red-brick houses in Fujian often adopt flush gable roofs配合 saddle walls or brick-and-stone walls.
典型实例 Examples
泉州红砖厝、漳州古民居、厦门鼓浪屿老建筑、莆田大宗伯第
攒尖顶
Pyramidal Roof (Zanjian)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，屋顶为锥形，无正脊，顶部集中于一点（宝顶），有三角、四角、六角、八角、圆形等多种平面形式，常用于亭、阁、塔等建筑。福建廊桥桥亭多采用此形式。
A traditional Chinese roof form with a conical shape, no main ridge, and the top converging at a single point (finial), with various plan forms including triangular, quadrangular, hexagonal, octagonal and circular, commonly used for pavilions, towers and pagodas. The bridge pavilions of Fujian covered bridges often adopt this form.
典型实例 Examples
宁德木拱廊桥桥亭、泉州东西塔、莆田无尘塔、云霄石矾塔
重檐
Double Eaves (Zhongyan)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，在单檐屋顶下方再加一层屋檐，形成上下两层屋檐，显得建筑更加高大雄伟，常用于等级较高的宫殿、寺庙大殿。福建地区寺庙大殿和文庙大成殿常用重檐歇山顶。
A traditional Chinese roof form where an additional layer of eaves is added below a single-eave roof, forming upper and lower layers of eaves, making the building appear taller and more majestic; commonly used for higher-ranking palaces and temple main halls. Temple main halls and Confucian temple Dacheng Halls in Fujian often use double-eave hip-and-gable roofs.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺大雄宝殿、平和文庙大成殿、漳州府文庙、福州西禅寺
5
建筑典籍 Architectural Classics
营造法式
Yingzao Fashi (State Building Standards)
北宋李诫编修的建筑技术专著，是中国古代最完整的建筑技术书籍，确立了材分制、斗拱等级等建筑规范，对后世建筑影响深远，福建宋代建筑多遵循其规制。
An architectural technical monograph compiled by Li Jie in the Northern Song Dynasty, the most complete architectural technical book in ancient China, establishing architectural standards such as the cai-fen system and bracket set grades, with profound influence on later architecture; Song dynasty buildings in Fujian mostly follow its regulations.
典型实例 Examples
福州华林寺大殿、莆田元妙观三清殿、泉州开元寺
6
建筑布局 Architectural Layout
中轴对称
Central-Axis Symmetry
中国古建筑的基本布局原则，建筑沿中轴线对称排列，体现礼制秩序和等级观念，福建文庙、寺庙、大型民居多遵循中轴对称布局。
The basic layout principle of traditional Chinese architecture, where buildings are arranged symmetrically along a central axis, reflecting ritual order and hierarchical concepts; Fujian Confucian temples, temples and large residences mostly follow a central-axis symmetric layout.
典型实例 Examples
泉州府文庙、漳州府文庙、福州华林寺、莆田大宗伯第
前堂后寝
Front Hall Rear Quarters
中国传统民居的基本布局模式，前部为厅堂用于会客和祭祀，后部为卧室用于居住，福建大型民居和土楼内部多遵循此布局。
The basic layout pattern of traditional Chinese residences, with the front part being halls for receiving guests and sacrifice, and the rear part being bedrooms for living; large residences and tulou interiors in Fujian mostly follow this layout.
典型实例 Examples
泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第、闽清宏琳厝、南靖怀远楼
7
建筑文化 Architectural Culture
风水
Feng Shui
中国古代关于建筑选址和环境规划的理论，强调人与自然的和谐，福建古建筑在选址、朝向、布局等方面深受风水理论影响，土楼、寺庙的选址尤其讲究。
An ancient Chinese theory about architectural site selection and environmental planning, emphasizing harmony between humans and nature; ancient Fujian architecture is deeply influenced by feng shui theory in site selection, orientation and layout, with the site selection of tulou and temples being particularly particular.
典型实例 Examples
南靖南薰楼、永定土楼群、泉州寺庙、福州三坊七巷
8
建筑等级 Architectural Grading
全国重点文物保护单位
National Key Cultural Heritage Site
中国文物保护的最高等级，由国务院核定公布，具有重大历史、艺术、科学价值，福建古建筑地图中收录的大量建筑被列为全国重点文物保护单位。
The highest level of cultural heritage protection in China, approved and announced by the State Council, with significant historical, artistic and scientific value; a large number of buildings included in the Historical Architectural Map of Fujian are listed as National Key Cultural Heritage Sites.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺、福州华林寺、漳州南山寺、永定土楼
省级文物保护单位
Provincial Cultural Heritage Site
由省级人民政府核定公布的文物保护等级，具有较高的历史、艺术、科学价值，福建各地保存了大量省级文物保护单位。
A cultural heritage protection level approved and announced by provincial-level people's governments, with relatively high historical, artistic and scientific value; a large number of Provincial Cultural Heritage Sites are preserved throughout Fujian.
典型实例 Examples
莆田大宗伯第、漳州威惠庙、南平宝峰寺、宁德廊桥
面阔
Building Width (Miankuo)
中国古建筑中建筑正面的宽度，以开间数计算，面阔间数越多等级越高，福建寺庙大殿多为五开间或七开间，民居多为三开间。
The width of the front face of traditional Chinese architecture, calculated by the number of bays; the more bays in width, the higher the rank; temple main halls in Fujian are mostly five or seven bays wide, while residences are mostly three bays wide.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺大雄宝殿、福州华林寺大殿、平和城隍庙大殿、泉州蔡氏古民居
进深
Building Depth (Jinshen)
中国古建筑中建筑前后的深度，以檩数或开间数计算，进深越大建筑规模越大，福建寺庙大殿进深多为十檩以上。
The front-to-back depth of traditional Chinese architecture, calculated by the number of purlins or bays; the greater the depth, the larger the building scale; temple main halls in Fujian mostly have a depth of over ten purlins.
典型实例 Examples
福州华林寺大殿、泉州开元寺大雄宝殿、华安南山宫、平和城隍庙
世界文化遗产
World Cultural Heritage
由联合国教科文组织认定的具有突出普遍价值的文化遗产，福建土楼于2008年列入世界文化遗产名录，泉州宋元中国的世界海洋商贸中心于2021年列入。
Cultural heritage with outstanding universal value recognized by UNESCO; Fujian Tulou was inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List in 2008, and Quanzhou: Emporium of the World in Song-Yuan China was inscribed in 2021.
典型实例 Examples
福建土楼、泉州开元寺、泉州清净寺、泉州六胜塔
9
建筑部件 Architectural Components
柱础
Column Base (Zhuchu)
柱子底部的承重构件，多为石质，具有防潮、承重和装饰作用，福建古建筑中柱础形式多样，有鼓形、覆盆形、莲花形等。
Load-bearing components at the bottom of columns, mostly stone, with moisture-proof, load-bearing and decorative functions; column bases in Fujian ancient architecture have diverse forms, including drum-shaped, inverted-basin-shaped and lotus-shaped.
典型实例 Examples
东山关帝庙、泉州开元寺、福州华林寺、漳州南山寺
额枋
Architrave (Efang)
中国古建筑中柱子之间的横向联系构件，位于柱头之上，用于拉结柱子和承托斗拱，福建闽南建筑中额枋常施精美木雕和彩绘。
Horizontal connecting components between columns in traditional Chinese architecture, located above column tops, used to tie columns and support bracket sets; in Minnan architecture, architraves are often decorated with exquisite wood carvings and colored paintings.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺、东山关帝庙、漳州南山寺、平和绳武楼
雀替
Spandrel Bracket (Queti)
中国古建筑中位于梁枋与柱交接处的装饰构件，形似双翼，具有加固和装饰作用，福建建筑中雀替常雕刻成花草、鸟兽等形状。
Decorative components located at the junction of beams and columns in traditional Chinese architecture, shaped like two wings, with reinforcing and decorative functions; in Fujian architecture, spandrel brackets are often carved into flowers, plants, birds and beasts.
典型实例 Examples
泉州蔡氏古民居、东山关帝庙、长泰杨氏宗祠、平和绳武楼
照壁
Screen Wall (Zhaobi)
中国古建筑中位于大门内外的屏蔽墙，用于遮挡视线和装饰，福建寺庙、祠堂、大型民居中常见照壁，多以砖石砌筑并施装饰。
Screen walls located inside or outside the main gate in traditional Chinese architecture, used to block the view and decorate; screen walls are common in Fujian temples, ancestral halls and large residences, mostly built of brick and stone with decoration.
典型实例 Examples
云霄威惠庙、泉州开元寺、漳州南山寺、福州三坊七巷
门簪
Door Pin (Men Zan)
中国古建筑中固定大门上槛的构件，外露于门额上方，形似发簪，具有装饰和象征等级的作用，福建民居中门簪常雕刻成花卉形状。
Components fixing the upper door threshold in traditional Chinese architecture, exposed above the door lintel, shaped like hairpins, with decorative and rank-symbolizing functions; in Fujian residences, door pins are often carved into flower shapes.
典型实例 Examples
泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第、福州三坊七巷、闽清宏琳厝
门枕石
Door Bearing Stone (Men Zhenshi)
中国古建筑中承托大门转轴的石质构件，位于门框两侧下方，常雕刻成狮子、鼓等形状，福建闽南建筑中门枕石雕刻精美。
Stone components supporting the door pivot in traditional Chinese architecture, located below both sides of the door frame, often carved into lions, drums and other shapes; in Minnan architecture, door bearing stones are exquisitely carved.
典型实例 Examples
泉州蔡氏古民居、厦门鼓浪屿老建筑、漳州古民居、南安中宪第
10
木构体系 Timber Frame System
斗拱
Bracket Set (Dougong)
中国古建筑特有的构件，由方形的斗、升和弓形的拱、斜向的昂组成，位于柱顶、额枋与屋顶之间，起承托屋檐、传递荷载和装饰作用，是中国古建筑的标志性元素。福建华林寺大殿保留了宋代斗拱的典型做法。
A unique component of traditional Chinese architecture, consisting of square blocks (dou/sheng), bow-shaped arms (gong) and inclined ang (lever arms), located between column tops, architraves and the roof, serving to support eaves, transfer loads and decorate, and is the iconic element of traditional Chinese architecture. The main hall of Fuzhou Hualin Temple preserves the typical Song dynasty bracket set method.
典型实例 Examples
福州华林寺大殿、泉州开元寺、浦城云峰寺、华安南山宫
丁头拱
Corbel Bracket (Dingtougong)
福建古建筑中常见的斗拱形式，从柱身或梁架侧面伸出的短拱，形似丁字头，用于承托挑檐枋或梁架，是闽南建筑中简化斗拱的典型做法，装饰性强。
A common bracket set form in Fujian ancient architecture, a short bracket protruding from the column body or side of the beam frame, shaped like the character 'ding' (T), used to support the eave lintel or beam frame; it is a typical simplified bracket set method in Minnan architecture, with strong decorative qualities.
典型实例 Examples
漳州威惠庙、东山关帝庙、长泰杨氏宗祠、诏安城隍庙
连珠斗
Connected-Bead Dou (Lianzhudou)
福建古建筑中斗拱的一种做法，多个斗上下叠置如连珠，用于襻间或梁架之间，具有装饰和结构双重作用，常见于闽南和闽东地区的寺庙、祠堂建筑。
A bracket set method in Fujian ancient architecture, where multiple dou (blocks) are stacked vertically like connected beads, used between inter-columnar spaces or beam frames, with both decorative and structural functions; commonly seen in temples and ancestral halls in southern and eastern Fujian.
典型实例 Examples
诏安南诏牌坊群、长泰杨氏宗祠、东山关帝庙、漳州南山寺
抬梁式
Beam-Lifting Frame (Tailiangshi)
中国古建筑木构架体系之一，又称叠梁式，柱上搁置梁头，梁头上搁置檩条，梁上再用矮柱支起较短的梁，如此层叠而上，形成屋架。福建寺庙大殿多采用抬梁式构架。
One of the traditional Chinese timber frame systems, also called the stacked-beam system, where beam heads rest on columns, purlins rest on beam heads, and shorter beams are supported by short columns on the beams, stacking upward to form the roof frame. Temple main halls in Fujian mostly adopt the beam-lifting frame.
典型实例 Examples
福州华林寺大殿、泉州开元寺大雄宝殿、华安南山宫、平和城隍庙
穿斗式
Column-and-Tie Frame (Chuandoushi)
中国古建筑木构架体系之一，又称立帖式，用穿枋把柱子串联起来形成房架，檩条直接搁置在柱头上，沿檩条方向再用斗枋把柱子串联起来。福建民居和土楼内部多采用穿斗式构架。
One of the traditional Chinese timber frame systems, also called the post-and-lintel system, where columns are connected by tie beams to form the frame, purlins rest directly on column tops, and columns are further connected by bracket beams along the purlin direction. The interiors of Fujian residences and tulou mostly adopt the column-and-tie frame.
典型实例 Examples
永定土楼、南靖土楼、福州三坊七巷民居、闽清宏琳厝
插梁式
Inserted-Beam Frame (Chaliangshi)
福建地区特有的木构架形式，梁头直接插入柱身而非搁置在柱顶，结合了抬梁式和穿斗式的特点，是闽地建筑木作的重要特色，华林寺大殿即采用此做法。
A timber frame form unique to the Fujian region, where beam heads are directly inserted into the column body rather than resting on column tops, combining features of both beam-lifting and column-and-tie systems; it is an important feature of Fujian architectural timber work, and the main hall of Hualin Temple adopts this method.
典型实例 Examples
福州华林寺大殿、宁德廊桥、莆田元妙观三清殿、泉州开元寺
梭柱
Shuttle-Shaped Column (Suozhu)
中国古建筑中柱子的一种形式，柱子上下两端收窄、中部饱满，形似织布梭子，具有古朴的美感，常见于宋代及以前的建筑。福建东山关帝庙、漳州威惠庙保留了梭形石柱。
A column form in traditional Chinese architecture, where the column narrows at both upper and lower ends and is full in the middle, resembling a weaving shuttle, with an ancient aesthetic; commonly seen in buildings from the Song dynasty and earlier. Dongshan Guandi Temple and Zhangzhou Weihui Temple in Fujian preserve shuttle-shaped stone columns.
典型实例 Examples
东山关帝庙、漳州威惠庙、福州华林寺、莆田元妙观
月梁
Crescent Beam (Yueliang)
中国古建筑中梁的一种形式，梁身中部微微拱起，两端收窄，形似新月，具有结构和装饰双重作用，常见于江南和福建地区的寺庙、祠堂建筑。
A beam form in traditional Chinese architecture, where the beam body slightly arches in the middle and narrows at both ends, resembling a crescent moon, with both structural and decorative functions; commonly seen in temples and ancestral halls in the Jiangnan and Fujian regions.
典型实例 Examples
诏安南诏牌坊群、泉州开元寺、漳州南山寺、福州西禅寺
藻井
Caisson Ceiling (Zaojing)
中国古建筑中天花板上的装饰性凹面结构，多位于室内明间顶部，呈方形、多边形或圆形，层层叠涩收进，中心常饰以莲花、龙凤等图案，具有神圣象征意义。华安南山宫保留了螺旋式鸡笼藻井。
A decorative concave structure on the ceiling of traditional Chinese architecture, mostly located at the top of the central bay indoors, in square, polygonal or circular forms, with layered corbelling receding inward, the center often decorated with lotus, dragon and phoenix patterns, with sacred symbolic meaning. Nanshan Palace in Hua'an preserves a spiral 'chicken coop' caisson ceiling.
典型实例 Examples
华安南山宫、泉州开元寺、福州华林寺、漳州南山寺
11
材料与工艺 Materials and Crafts
花岗岩
Granite (Huagangyan)
福建地区最丰富的建筑石材，质地坚硬，色泽灰白，广泛用于建筑的墙基、柱、梁、牌坊、桥梁等部位，惠安石雕即以花岗岩为主要材料。
The most abundant building stone in the Fujian region, with hard texture and grayish-white color, widely used for wall foundations, columns, beams, archways and bridges; Hui'an stone carving uses granite as the main material.
典型实例 Examples
泉州东西塔、厦门胡里山炮台、漳州石牌坊、惠安崇武古城
红砖
Red Brick (Hongzhuan)
闽南地区特有的建筑材料，以当地黏土烧制而成，色泽鲜红，规格统一，是闽南红砖厝的主要建筑材料，形成了闽南建筑独特的红色基调。
A distinctive building material in the Minnan region, fired from local clay, with bright red color and uniform specifications; it is the main building material of Minnan red-brick houses, forming the unique red tone of Minnan architecture.
典型实例 Examples
泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第、漳州杨阿苗民居、厦门鼓浪屿老建筑
琉璃瓦
Glazed Tile (Liuliwa)
表面施釉的陶质瓦件，色彩鲜艳，防水性好，常用于宫殿、寺庙等高等级建筑的屋面，福建寺庙建筑中常见黄、绿、蓝等色琉璃瓦。
Ceramic tile pieces with glazed surfaces, with bright colors and good waterproofing, commonly used for the roofs of high-ranking buildings such as palaces and temples; yellow, green, blue and other colored glazed tiles are common in Fujian temple architecture.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺、福州西禅寺、厦门南普陀寺、莆田湄洲妈祖庙
灰塑
Lime Sculpture (Huisu)
以石灰为主要材料的建筑装饰工艺，在屋脊、檐口、山墙等部位塑造各种图案，福建闽南建筑中灰塑常与剪瓷雕配合使用。
An architectural decorative craft using lime as the main material, shaping various patterns on ridges, eaves, gable walls and other parts; in Minnan architecture, lime sculpture is often used in combination with porcelain-cut sculpture.
典型实例 Examples
东山关帝庙、泉州开元寺、漳州南山寺、厦门青礁慈济宫
木雕
Wood Carving (Mudiao)
以木材为材料的雕刻工艺，福建木雕工艺发达，闽南木雕华丽精细，闽东木雕古朴典雅，广泛应用于建筑的梁、枋、门窗、神龛等部位。
A carving craft using wood as material; Fujian has a developed wood carving craft, with Minnan wood carving gorgeous and refined, and eastern Fujian wood carving simple and elegant, widely applied to building beams, lintels, doors and windows, shrines and other parts.
典型实例 Examples
平和绳武楼、泉州蔡氏古民居、长泰杨氏宗祠、南靖怀远楼
彩绘
Colored Painting (Caihui)
在建筑木构件表面绘制的装饰图案，福建寺庙建筑中彩绘题材丰富，色彩绚丽，华安南山宫保留了明末清初的彩绘做法。
Decorative patterns painted on the surface of building timber components; in Fujian temple architecture, colored paintings have rich themes and gorgeous colors, and Nanshan Palace in Hua'an preserves the colored painting methods of the late Ming and early Qing periods.
典型实例 Examples
华安南山宫、泉州开元寺、漳州南山寺、福州华林寺
12
民居与聚落 Residences and Settlements
大夫第
Grand Official's Residence (Dafudi)
对有功名或官宦人家宅第的尊称，福建地区保存了多座大夫第，多为大型合院式民居，建筑规模宏大，装饰精美，体现了主人的社会地位和经济实力。
An honorific title for the residences of families with academic degrees or official positions; the Fujian region preserves multiple 'Dafudi', mostly large courtyard-style residences with grand scale and exquisite decoration, reflecting the owner's social status and economic strength.
典型实例 Examples
莆田大宗伯第、南安中宪第、龙海石码杨氏大夫第、漳浦蓝廷珍府第
百廿间大厝
120-Room Mansion (Bainian Jian Da Cuo)
闽南地区对大型民居的俗称，因房屋数量多达一百二十间而得名，莆田大宗伯第是典型的百廿间大厝，为明万历年间礼部尚书陈经邦的府第。
A colloquial term for large residences in the Minnan region, named for having as many as 120 rooms; Putian Dazongbo Di is a typical 120-room mansion, the residence of Chen Jingbang, Minister of Rites during the Wanli reign of the Ming.
典型实例 Examples
莆田大宗伯第、南安中宪第、漳浦蓝廷珍府第
护厝
Side Wing (Hucuo)
闽南民居中主体建筑两侧的纵向附属建筑，与主体建筑平行排列，之间以天井相隔，用于居住、厨房、储藏等功能，是闽南大厝的重要组成部分。
Longitudinal auxiliary buildings on both sides of the main building in Minnan residences, arranged parallel to the main building and separated by courtyards, used for residence, kitchens, storage and other functions; an important component of Minnan large houses.
典型实例 Examples
泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第、华安东阳楼、南靖河坑绳庆楼
天井
Courtyard Skylight (Tianjing)
中国传统民居中建筑围合的露天空间，用于采光、通风、排水和晾晒，福建民居中天井尺度较小，深度较大，适应南方炎热多雨的气候。
Open-air spaces enclosed by buildings in traditional Chinese residences, used for lighting, ventilation, drainage and drying; the courtyards in Fujian residences are relatively small in scale and deep in depth, adapting to the hot and rainy climate of southern China.
典型实例 Examples
福州三坊七巷民居、泉州红砖厝、闽清宏琳厝、土楼内院
古城墙
Ancient City Wall (Guchengqiang)
古代城市的防御设施，福建地区保存了多座明清时期的所城、卫城城墙，多以花岗岩条石砌筑，是研究古代军事防御体系的重要实物。
Defensive facilities of ancient cities; the Fujian region preserves multiple Ming and Qing dynasty fortress and guard city walls, mostly built of granite strip stones, important physical evidence for studying ancient military defense systems.
典型实例 Examples
惠安崇武古城、漳浦六鳌城、龙海镇海卫、诏安悬钟千户所城墙
千户所城
Thousand-Household Fortress City (Qianhusuo Cheng)
明代卫所制度下的军事驻防城市，每所驻军约1120人，福建沿海地区为防御倭寇设置了大量千户所城，诏安悬钟千户所城是保存较好的实例。
Military garrison cities under the Ming dynasty guard-battalion system, with each battalion stationing about 1,120 soldiers; the coastal region of Fujian established numerous thousand-household fortress cities to defend against Japanese pirates, and Zhao'an Xuanzhong Thousand-Household Fortress City is a well-preserved example.
典型实例 Examples
诏安悬钟千户所城、惠安崇武所城、龙海镇海卫城、漳浦六鳌所城
瓮城
Barbican (Wengcheng)
古代城门外的防御设施，为半圆形或方形的护门小城，与城墙连为一体，可增强城门的防御能力，福建所城、土堡中常见瓮城设置。
Defensive facilities outside ancient city gates, a semicircular or square gate-protecting small city integrated with the city wall, enhancing the defensive capability of the city gate; barbican settings are common in Fujian fortress cities and earthen forts.
典型实例 Examples
漳浦赵家堡北门、诏安悬钟所东门、惠安崇武古城、大田安良堡
13
福建历史文化 Fujian History and Culture
开漳圣王
Sacred King Who Opened Zhangzhou (Kaizhang Shengwang)
对唐代陈元光的尊称，陈元光于唐垂拱二年（686年）奏请设立漳州，被尊为'开漳圣王'，是闽南地区最重要的民间信仰之一，威惠庙是供奉开漳圣王的主要庙宇。
An honorific title for Chen Yuanguang of the Tang Dynasty, who memorialized to establish Zhangzhou in the second year of Chuigong reign of the Tang (686), revered as the 'Sacred King Who Opened Zhangzhou'; one of the most important folk beliefs in the Minnan region, and Weihui Temple is the main temple enshrining the Sacred King Who Opened Zhangzhou.
典型实例 Examples
云霄威惠庙、漳州路边威惠庙、漳浦威惠庙、华安威惠庙
朱熹
Zhu Xi
南宋著名理学家，曾任漳州知州、泉州同安县主簿，在福建多地讲学授徒，对福建文化教育影响深远，建阳考亭书院是其晚年讲学之所。
A famous Neo-Confucian philosopher of the Southern Song Dynasty, who served as Prefect of Zhangzhou and Registrar of Tong'an County in Quanzhou, teaching and taking disciples in many places in Fujian, with profound influence on Fujian's culture and education; Kouting Academy in Jianyang was where he taught in his later years.
典型实例 Examples
建阳考亭书院、漳州芝山书院、泉州小山丛竹书院、尤溪南溪书院
王阳明
Wang Yangming
明代著名思想家、军事家，于正德十二年（1517年）巡抚南赣，奏请设立平和县，平和城隍庙即为其奏准以府级规格建造，对福建南部地区的开发和治理影响深远。
A famous thinker and military strategist of the Ming Dynasty, who served as Grand Coordinator of Southern Jiangxi in the 12th year of Zhengde reign (1517), memorialized to establish Pinghe County, and Pinghe City God Temple was built at prefectural specifications by his approved memorial; he had profound influence on the development and governance of southern Fujian.
典型实例 Examples
平和城隍庙、平和文庙、平和王阳明纪念馆
闽南文化
Minnan Culture
以泉州、漳州、厦门为核心的地域文化，以闽南语为载体，融合了中原文化、海洋文化和外来文化，具有开放包容、重商崇教的特征，红砖厝、燕尾脊、妈祖信仰是其文化标志。
A regional culture centered on Quanzhou, Zhangzhou and Xiamen, using the Minnan language as its carrier, integrating Central Plains culture, maritime culture and foreign cultures, with characteristics of openness, inclusiveness, commerce emphasis and education reverence; red-brick houses, swallowtail ridges and Mazu belief are its cultural symbols.
典型实例 Examples
泉州红砖厝、漳州燕尾脊建筑、厦门鼓浪屿、莆田妈祖信仰
客家文化
Hakka Culture
客家人创造的地域文化，客家人是历史上从中原南迁的汉族民系，福建西部永定、南靖、上杭等地是客家聚居区，土楼是客家文化最具代表性的建筑形式。
A regional culture created by the Hakka people, who are a Han ethnic group that migrated south from the Central Plains in history; Yongding, Nanjing and Shanghang in western Fujian are Hakka settlement areas, and tulou is the most representative architectural form of Hakka culture.
典型实例 Examples
永定土楼、南靖土楼、上杭客家民居、宁化石壁客家祖地
海上丝绸之路
Maritime Silk Road
古代中国与世界进行贸易和文化交流的海上通道，泉州是宋元时期海上丝绸之路的起点，被誉为'东方第一大港'，保存了大量相关史迹。
The maritime route for trade and cultural exchange between ancient China and the world; Quanzhou was the starting point of the Maritime Silk Road during the Song and Yuan dynasties, known as the 'No. 1 Eastern Port', preserving a large number of related historical sites.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺、泉州清净寺、泉州伊斯兰教圣墓、泉州六胜塔
倭寇
Japanese Pirates (Wokou)
明代骚扰中国沿海的日本海盗集团，福建沿海是倭患重灾区，明代在福建沿海修建了大量卫所、城堡、烽火台等防御设施，俞大猷、戚继光等名将曾在此抗倭。
Japanese pirate groups that harassed China's coast during the Ming Dynasty; the Fujian coast was a heavily affected area of Japanese pirate raids, and the Ming Dynasty built numerous guard posts, castles and beacon towers along the Fujian coast, with famous generals Yu Dayou and Qi Jiguang once fighting Japanese pirates here.
典型实例 Examples
惠安崇武古城、诏安悬钟千户所、漳浦六鳌城、龙海镇海卫
14
福建地理区域 Fujian Geographical Regions
闽中
Central Fujian (Minzhong)
福建中部地区，以福州为中心，包括福州、莆田、宁德等地，是福建政治文化中心，建筑风格以马鞍墙、燕尾脊为特色，庄寨建筑发达。
The central region of Fujian, centered on Fuzhou, including Fuzhou, Putian and Ningde; it is the political and cultural center of Fujian, with architectural styles featuring saddle walls and swallowtail ridges, and developed fortified manor architecture.
典型实例 Examples
福州三坊七巷、莆田湄洲妈祖庙、宁德木拱廊桥、永泰庄寨
闽南
Southern Fujian (Minnan)
福建南部地区，以泉州、漳州、厦门为核心，是福建经济最发达的地区，建筑风格以红砖厝、燕尾脊、剪瓷雕为特色，海洋文化浓厚。
The southern region of Fujian, centered on Quanzhou, Zhangzhou and Xiamen; it is the most economically developed region of Fujian, with architectural styles featuring red-brick houses, swallowtail ridges and porcelain-cut sculpture, with a strong maritime culture.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺、漳州南山寺、厦门鼓浪屿、南安蔡氏古民居
闽西
Western Fujian (Minxi)
福建西部地区，以龙岩为中心，包括龙岩、三明部分地区，是客家聚居区，土楼、土堡建筑发达，客家文化浓厚。
The western region of Fujian, centered on Longyan, including Longyan and parts of Sanming; it is a Hakka settlement area with developed tulou and earthen fort architecture and a strong Hakka culture.
典型实例 Examples
永定土楼、南靖土楼、大田土堡、连城培田古民居
闽北
Northern Fujian (Minbei)
福建北部地区，以南平为中心，包括南平、三明部分地区，是福建文化发源地之一，朱熹理学发源地，保存了大量宋元时期的古建筑。
The northern region of Fujian, centered on Nanping, including Nanping and parts of Sanming; it is one of the birthplaces of Fujian culture and the birthplace of Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucianism, preserving a large number of ancient buildings from the Song and Yuan dynasties.
典型实例 Examples
南平宝峰寺、浦城云峰寺、建阳考亭书院、尤溪朱熹墓
闽东
Eastern Fujian (Mindong)
福建东部地区，以宁德为中心，是中国木拱廊桥最集中的分布区，被誉为'世界木拱廊桥之乡'，廊桥文化是其最显著的文化标志。
The eastern region of Fujian, centered on Ningde; it is the most concentrated distribution area of Chinese timber-arch covered bridges, known as the 'Hometown of World Timber-Arch Covered Bridges', and covered bridge culture is its most prominent cultural symbol.
典型实例 Examples
屏南万安桥、寿宁鸾峰桥、周宁登龙桥、古田临水宫
15
福建特色建筑 Fujian Distinctive Architecture
土楼
Earthen Building (Tulou)
福建西南部客家和闽南地区特有的大型集体民居建筑，以生土夯筑外墙，内部为木结构，平面有圆形、方形、五边形等多种形式，具有防御、居住、祭祀等多重功能，2008年列入世界文化遗产名录。
Large-scale collective residential buildings unique to the Hakka and Minnan regions of southwestern Fujian, with rammed earth outer walls and timber structure interiors, in various plan forms including circular, square and pentagonal, with multiple functions including defense, residence and sacrifice; inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List in 2008.
典型实例 Examples
永定土楼群、南靖田螺坑土楼群、华安大地土楼群、平和庄上大楼
圆楼
Round Tulou (Yuanlou)
土楼中最具代表性的形式，平面呈圆形，外墙环形夯筑，内部房间沿圆周均匀分布，中心为祖堂或天井，具有向心凝聚的空间特征，被誉为'东方古城堡'。
The most representative form of tulou, with a circular plan, ring-shaped rammed earth outer wall, interior rooms evenly distributed along the circumference, and an ancestral hall or courtyard in the center, with a centripetal and cohesive spatial character, known as the 'Eastern Ancient Castle'.
典型实例 Examples
华安二宜楼、南靖怀远楼、平和绳武楼、永定承启楼
方楼
Square Tulou (Fanglou)
土楼的主要形式之一，平面呈方形或长方形，四角设瞭望台，内部沿四壁布置居住单元，中心为祖堂和天井，是土楼中数量最多的形式。
One of the main forms of tulou, with a square or rectangular plan, observation platforms at the four corners, residential units arranged along the four walls inside, and an ancestral hall and courtyard in the center; it is the most numerous form of tulou.
典型实例 Examples
南靖和贵楼、平和裕昌楼、永定奎聚楼、南靖龙潭楼
五凤楼
Five-Phoenix Building (Wufenglou)
土楼的特殊形式之一，由前低后高的三堂或五堂建筑组成，屋顶层层叠落如凤凰展翅，强调中轴对称和等级秩序，常见于永定地区，是客家建筑中最具礼制特征的类型。
One of the special forms of tulou, composed of three or five hall buildings arranged from low in front to high in back, with roofs layered like a phoenix spreading its wings, emphasizing central-axis symmetry and hierarchical order; commonly seen in the Yongding region, it is the type with the most ritual characteristics in Hakka architecture.
典型实例 Examples
永定大夫第、永定福裕楼、永定奎聚楼
红砖厝
Red-Brick House (Hongzhuan Cuo)
闽南地区特有的传统民居形式，以红砖为主要建筑材料，配合白石基座、燕尾脊、出砖入石墙面，色彩鲜艳，装饰华丽，是泉州、漳州、厦门地区最具代表性的民居类型。
A traditional residential form unique to the Minnan region, using red bricks as the main building material,配合 white stone foundations, swallowtail ridges, and brick-and-stone walls, with bright colors and gorgeous decoration; it is the most representative residential type in the Quanzhou, Zhangzhou and Xiamen regions.
典型实例 Examples
泉州蔡氏古民居、南安中宪第、漳州杨阿苗民居、厦门鼓浪屿老建筑
骑楼
Arcade Building (Qilou)
闽南地区近代商住建筑形式，建筑底层沿街面后退留出公共人行空间，形成连续的廊道，可遮阳避雨，是东南亚建筑风格与中国传统建筑结合的产物，常见于泉州、漳州、厦门的老街。
A modern commercial-residential architectural form in the Minnan region, where the ground floor of buildings recedes along the street to leave a public pedestrian space, forming a continuous corridor that provides shade and shelter from rain; it is a product of the combination of Southeast Asian architectural styles and traditional Chinese architecture, commonly seen in the old streets of Quanzhou, Zhangzhou and Xiamen.
典型实例 Examples
泉州中山路骑楼、漳州台湾路骑楼、厦门中山路骑楼
廊桥
Covered Bridge (Langqiao)
在桥面上加盖廊屋、亭阁的桥梁，兼具交通、休憩、祭祀、交易等功能。福建宁德地区是中国木拱廊桥最集中的分布区，被誉为'世界木拱廊桥之乡'。
Bridges with covered corridors, pavilions and towers built on the bridge deck, serving multiple functions including transportation, rest, sacrifice and trade. The Ningde region of Fujian is the most concentrated distribution area of Chinese timber-arch covered bridges, known as the 'Hometown of World Timber-Arch Covered Bridges'.
典型实例 Examples
宁德万安桥、宁德鸾峰桥、宁德千乘桥、宁德龙江桥
木拱廊桥
Timber-Arch Covered Bridge (Mugong Langqiao)
廊桥中技术含量最高的类型，以短木料通过榫卯搭接形成拱形结构，不用一根铆钉，被誉为'世界桥梁史上的奇迹'。宁德屏南、寿宁、周宁三县保存最为集中。
The most technically advanced type of covered bridge, where short timber pieces are joined through mortise and tenon to form an arch structure without a single rivet, known as a 'miracle in the history of world bridges'. They are most concentrated in Pingnan, Shouning and Zhouning counties of Ningde.
典型实例 Examples
屏南万安桥、寿宁鸾峰桥、周宁登龙桥、古田沉字桥
庄寨
Fortified Manor (Zhuangzhai)
福建闽中地区特有的防御性民居建筑，结合了土楼的防御功能和民居的居住功能，多建于山坡之上，平面不规则，外墙高大厚实，内部院落层层递进，永泰县保存最为集中。
Defensive residential architecture unique to the central Fujian region, combining the defensive function of tulou with the residential function of houses, mostly built on hillsides with irregular plans, tall and thick outer walls, and progressively layered interior courtyards; they are most concentrated in Yongtai County.
典型实例 Examples
永泰爱荆庄、永泰嘉禄庄、永泰仁和庄、闽清宏琳厝
土堡
Earthen Fort (Tubao)
福建三明地区特有的防御性建筑，以生土夯筑外墙，内部为木结构，平面多为前方后圆或不规则形，具有强烈的军事防御色彩，与土楼相比更侧重防御功能。
Defensive architecture unique to the Sanming region of Fujian, with rammed earth outer walls and timber structure interiors, mostly with front-square-back-round or irregular plans, with strong military defensive characteristics; compared to tulou, they emphasize defensive functions more.
典型实例 Examples
大田安良堡、大田芳联堡、尤溪聚奎堡、永安安贞堡
16
装饰工艺 Decorative Crafts
剪瓷雕
Porcelain-Cut Sculpture (Jiancidiao)
闽南地区特有的建筑装饰工艺，将彩色瓷碗、瓷盘剪切成碎片，粘贴在屋脊、檐角等部位，塑造出人物、花鸟、龙凤等形象，色彩鲜艳，经久不褪，是闽南寺庙建筑的标志性装饰。
A distinctive architectural decorative craft in the Minnan region, where colored porcelain bowls and plates are cut into fragments and pasted on ridges, eaves corners and other parts, creating figures of people, flowers, birds, dragons and phoenixes, with bright colors that do not fade over time; it is the iconic decoration of Minnan temple architecture.
典型实例 Examples
东山关帝庙、泉州开元寺、厦门青礁慈济宫、漳州白礁慈济宫
惠安石雕
Hui'an Stone Carving
福建惠安地区传承千年的石雕工艺，以花岗岩为主要材料，技法包括圆雕、浮雕、透雕、线刻等，题材广泛，工艺精湛，被誉为'中国石雕之都'，广泛应用于闽南建筑的柱、础、栏、碑等部位。
A stone carving craft with a thousand-year heritage in the Hui'an region of Fujian, using granite as the main material, with techniques including round carving, relief, openwork carving and line carving, with a wide range of subjects and exquisite craftsmanship, known as the 'Capital of Chinese Stone Carving'; widely applied to columns, bases, railings and steles in Minnan architecture.
典型实例 Examples
泉州东西塔、厦门胡里山炮台、漳州石牌坊、惠安崇武古城
出砖入石
Brick-and-Stone Wall (Chuzhuan Rushi)
闽南地区特有的墙体砌筑工艺，将红砖和白色花岗岩块交错砌筑，形成红白相间的肌理效果，既美观又坚固，是闽南红砖建筑的标志性特征之一。
A distinctive wall masonry craft in the Minnan region, where red bricks and white granite blocks are alternately laid, forming a red-and-white textured effect, both beautiful and sturdy; it is one of the iconic features of Minnan red-brick architecture.
典型实例 Examples
泉州蔡氏古民居、厦门鼓浪屿老建筑、漳州古民居、南安中宪第
螭首
Chi-Dragon Head (Chishou)
中国古建筑中常见的石雕装饰，为传说中龙之九子之一的螭首形象，常用于台基、栏杆、柱础等部位，具有排水和装饰双重功能。福建文庙、寺庙中常见螭首排水口。
A common stone carving decoration in traditional Chinese architecture, depicting the head of Chi, one of the nine sons of the dragon in legend, commonly used on platforms, railings and column bases, with both drainage and decorative functions. Chi-dragon head drainage outlets are common in Fujian Confucian temples and temples.
典型实例 Examples
泉州府文庙、漳州府文庙、福州孔庙、莆田文庙
盘龙石柱
Dragon-Coiled Stone Column (Panlong Shizhu)
闽南寺庙建筑中常见的石柱装饰，以整根花岗岩雕刻而成，龙身缠绕柱身，龙头探出，气势雄伟，是惠安石雕工艺的杰出代表，常见于寺庙大殿前廊。
A common stone column decoration in Minnan temple architecture, carved from a single piece of granite, with the dragon body coiling around the column and the dragon head protruding, with majestic momentum; it is an outstanding representative of Hui'an stone carving craft, commonly seen in the front corridors of temple main halls.
典型实例 Examples
泉州开元寺、厦门青礁慈济宫、东山关帝庙、平和城隍庙
垂花柱
Pendant Column Capital (Chuihuazhu)
中国古建筑中檐下的装饰构件，从梁枋下悬垂的短柱，柱头雕刻成莲花、花篮等形状，具有装饰和象征意义，福建闽南建筑中常用木雕垂花柱。
A decorative component under the eaves in traditional Chinese architecture, a short column hanging from below the beam lintel, with the column capital carved into lotus, flower basket and other shapes, with decorative and symbolic meanings; wood-carved pendant column capitals are commonly used in Minnan architecture.
典型实例 Examples
长泰杨氏宗祠、东山关帝庙、漳州威惠庙、泉州蔡氏古民居
