江南建筑密码

粉墙黛瓦间的千年诗意
The Living Architecture of Jiangnan

在长江下游的水乡泽国，江苏和上海保存了中国最精致的古代建筑。从苏州园林的曲径通幽到南京明孝陵的石像生，从扬州盐商的奢华园林到上海石库门的中西合璧，这里的每一座建筑都是一部凝固的江南文化史。

江苏被誉为"江南园林的故乡"——苏州9座古典园林被列入世界文化遗产，南京明孝陵开创了明清帝陵制度，大运河贯穿南北孕育了无数水乡古镇。本词典以50个核心术语为钥匙，带你走进江南建筑的深处。

建筑结构

Structural Elements
1斗拱
Bracket Set (Dougong)
斗拱是中国古代建筑中柱梁之间的承重构件，由方形的斗、升和弓形的拱、昂层层叠加而成，将屋檐重量均匀传递到柱子上。江苏地区的斗拱在明清时期逐渐装饰化，苏州园林建筑中的斗拱小巧精致，与北方雄浑的斗拱风格形成鲜明对比。
The bracket set (dougong) is a load-bearing component between columns and beams in ancient Chinese architecture, composed of square blocks (dou/sheng) and bow-shaped arms (gong/ang) stacked in layers, distributing eave weight evenly to columns. In Jiangsu, Ming-Qing bracket sets became increasingly decorative; those in Suzhou gardens are small and exquisite, contrasting with the robust northern style.
实例：苏州文庙、南京明孝陵、扬州个园
相关：叉手 · 托脚 · 卷棚顶 · 苏式彩画
2卷棚顶
Round Ridge Roof (Juanpengding)
卷棚顶是中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，没有正脊，屋顶前后坡相接处呈弧形曲面，以筒瓦覆盖。卷棚顶线条柔和优美，在江苏园林建筑中广泛使用，尤其适用于轩、榭、廊等小品建筑，与江南水乡的温婉气质相得益彰。
The round ridge roof (juanpengding) is a traditional Chinese roof form without a main ridge, where the front and rear slopes meet in a gentle arc covered with semi-cylindrical tiles. With soft, elegant lines, it is widely used in Jiangsu garden architecture, particularly for pavilions, terraces, and corridors, complementing the gentle character of Jiangnan water towns.
实例：拙政园梧竹幽居、留园明瑟楼、网师园濯缨水阁
相关：歇山顶 · 硬山顶 · 苏式彩画
3马头墙
Horse-Head Wall (Matouqiang)
马头墙是江南民居中高出屋顶的封火墙，因顶端形似马头而得名。其功能是在密集的民居中阻隔火势蔓延，同时具有强烈的装饰效果。江苏南部和上海地区的马头墙多为阶梯状，层层叠落，粉刷成白色，与青瓦形成鲜明对比，是江南水乡的标志性元素。
The horse-head wall (matouqiang) is a fire wall rising above the roof in Jiangnan residences, named for its horse-head-shaped top. It prevents fire spread in dense residential areas while serving as a strong decorative element. In southern Jiangsu and Shanghai, horse-head walls are typically stepped, layered, and whitewashed, contrasting sharply with dark tiles—a signature element of Jiangnan water towns.
实例：周庄古镇、同里古镇、上海朱家角古镇
相关：粉墙黛瓦 · 江南民居 · 水乡古镇
4粉墙黛瓦
White Walls and Black Tiles (Fenqiang Daiwa)
粉墙黛瓦是江南建筑最典型的外观特征：墙面以白灰粉刷，屋顶覆盖青黑色小瓦。黑白对比简洁素雅，与江南水乡的小桥流水共同构成诗意的画面。这种风格在江苏苏州、无锡、常州及上海地区的传统民居和园林中普遍存在。
White walls and black tiles (fenqiang daiwa) is the most typical visual feature of Jiangnan architecture: walls plastered white with lime, roofs covered with dark grey small tiles. The stark black-white contrast is simple and elegant, forming poetic scenes with the small bridges and flowing water of Jiangnan. This style is ubiquitous in traditional residences and gardens in Suzhou, Wuxi, Changzhou, and Shanghai.
实例：苏州平江路、无锡清名桥、上海新场古镇
相关：马头墙 · 江南民居 · 水乡古镇
5花窗
Ornamental Window (Huachuang)
花窗是江南园林和民居中具有装饰性的窗户，以砖、木、石等材料雕刻成各种图案，如冰裂纹、海棠纹、回纹、万字纹等。花窗既分隔空间又不隔绝视线，通过窗孔取景，形成'框景'效果。苏州园林中的花窗式样多达数百种，是江南建筑装饰艺术的精华。
Ornamental windows (huachuang) are decorative windows in Jiangnan gardens and residences, carved from brick, wood, or stone into patterns such as ice-crack, begonia, meander, and swastika motifs. They divide space without blocking views, creating 'framed scenery' through the openings. Suzhou gardens feature hundreds of window patterns, representing the essence of Jiangnan architectural decoration.
实例：拙政园、留园、网师园、沧浪亭
相关：漏窗 · 框景 · 借景 · 挂落
6漏窗
Lattice Window (Louchuang)
漏窗是一种镂空的花窗，窗洞内以砖瓦或木石构成各种几何图案和动植物纹样，光线和空气可以透过，同时起到装饰和框景作用。漏窗在苏州园林中运用最为广泛，沧浪亭的108式漏窗最为著名，被誉为'漏窗博物馆'。
Lattice windows (louchuang) are openwork ornamental windows with geometric, plant, or animal patterns formed by brick, tile, wood, or stone inside the opening, allowing light and air to pass through while serving decorative and framing purposes. Most extensively used in Suzhou gardens, the 108 lattice window patterns at Canglang Pavilion are renowned as a 'museum of lattice windows'.
实例：沧浪亭、狮子林、艺圃
相关：花窗 · 框景 · 借景
7挂落
Hanging Lattice (Gualuo)
挂落是中国传统建筑中檐柱之间悬挂的装饰性构件，通常为镂空木雕，安装在廊柱之间的上方，形如倒挂的楣子。挂落在江苏园林建筑中极为常见，图案多为万字纹、回纹、冰裂纹等，既装饰空间又不影响通行，是江南建筑精致工艺的体现。
Hanging lattice (gualuo) is a decorative component suspended between eaves columns in traditional Chinese architecture, usually an openwork wood carving installed above the passage between corridor columns, resembling an inverted lintel. Extremely common in Jiangsu garden architecture, its patterns include swastika, meander, and ice-crack motifs—decorating space without obstructing passage, embodying the exquisite craftsmanship of Jiangnan architecture.
实例：拙政园、留园、上海豫园
相关：花窗 · 美人靠 · 轩
8美人靠
Beauty's Rest (Meirenkao)
美人靠是江南园林中设置在廊、榭、阁外侧的弧形靠背坐凳，因形似美人倚靠而得名。通常用木材制成，靠背呈优雅的弧线，既可供人坐憩观景，又是优美的建筑装饰。美人靠与水面、花木配合，营造出江南园林特有的闲适意境。
Beauty's rest (meirenkao) is a curved backrest bench installed outside corridors, terraces, and pavilions in Jiangnan gardens, named for its resemblance to a leaning beauty. Usually made of wood with an elegantly curved backrest, it provides seating for viewing scenery while serving as graceful architectural decoration. Combined with water and plants, it creates the distinctive leisurely atmosphere of Jiangnan gardens.
实例：拙政园小飞虹、留园明瑟楼、网师园濯缨水阁
相关：轩 · 榭 · 廊 · 挂落
9须弥座
Sumeru Pedestal (Xumizuo)
须弥座是中国古代建筑和雕塑中常用的台基形式，源自佛教须弥山的意象，由多层线脚和束腰组成，造型庄重华丽。江苏地区的须弥座多见于寺庙佛塔、宫殿坛庙和重要建筑的台基，南京明孝陵的须弥座雕刻精美，是明初官式建筑的代表。
The Sumeru pedestal (xumizuo) is a common platform form in ancient Chinese architecture and sculpture, derived from the Buddhist Mount Sumeru, composed of multiple moldings and a constricted waist, with a solemn and ornate form. In Jiangsu, Sumeru pedestals are found in temple pagodas, palace temples, and important building foundations; the exquisitely carved pedestals at Ming Xiaoling in Nanjing represent early Ming official architecture.
实例：南京明孝陵、苏州云岩寺塔、扬州大明寺
相关：佛塔 · 宫殿建筑 · 台基
10苏式彩画
Suzhou-Style Painted Decoration (Sushi Caihua)
苏式彩画是中国古建筑彩画的三大流派之一，起源于苏州，流行于江南园林和民居。与北方和玺彩画、旋子彩画的庄重不同，苏式彩画题材丰富，包括山水、花鸟、人物、故事等，色彩柔和淡雅，构图灵活，多用于园林建筑的梁枋、挂落等处。
Suzhou-style painted decoration (sushi caihua) is one of the three major schools of ancient Chinese architectural painting, originating in Suzhou and popular in Jiangnan gardens and residences. Unlike the solemn imperial and revolving-flower paintings of the north, Suzhou-style painting features rich subjects including landscapes, flowers, birds, figures, and stories, with soft colors and flexible composition, used on beams, lintels, and hanging lattices in garden buildings.
实例：拙政园、留园、苏州狮子林
相关：和玺彩画 · 旋子彩画 · 挂落
11楠木厅
Nanmu Hall (Nanmu Ting)
楠木厅是全部或主要构件用金丝楠木建造的厅堂，是江南民居和园林中等级最高的建筑形式。楠木质地坚硬、纹理美观、有香气且防蛀，极为珍贵。江苏地区保存有多处楠木厅，如苏州网师园的万卷堂、南京朝天宫的敬一亭等，是研究江南建筑工艺的重要实物。
A nanmu hall is a hall built entirely or primarily with golden-thread nanmu wood, the highest-grade building form in Jiangnan residences and gardens. Nanmu is hard, beautifully grained, fragrant, and insect-resistant, making it extremely precious. Several nanmu halls survive in Jiangsu, including the Wanjuan Hall at Wangshi Garden in Suzhou and the Jingyi Pavilion at Chaotian Palace in Nanjing—important artifacts for studying Jiangnan building craftsmanship.
实例：网师园万卷堂、南京朝天宫、苏州东山雕花楼
相关：鸳鸯厅 · 四面厅 · 花篮厅
12叉手
Forked Hand (Chashou)
叉手是中国古代建筑梁架结构中的斜撑构件，呈人字形，支撑在平梁上方与脊槫之间，起固定脊槫的作用。叉手在唐宋建筑中普遍使用，明清时期逐渐被脊柱取代。江苏地区的宋代和元代建筑中仍可见叉手实例，如苏州虎丘塔、南京栖霞寺舍利塔等。
The forked hand (chashou) is a diagonal brace in ancient Chinese timber framing, V-shaped, supporting between the top of the flat beam and the ridge purlin to fix it in place. Common in Tang-Song architecture, it was gradually replaced by the ridge column in the Ming-Qing period. Surviving examples in Jiangsu include the Tiger Hill Pagoda in Suzhou and the Qixia Temple Stupa in Nanjing.
实例：苏州云岩寺塔、南京栖霞寺舍利塔、扬州大明寺
相关：托脚 · 驼峰 · 斗拱

建筑类型

Building Types
13江南园林
Jiangnan Garden (Jiangnan Yuanlin)
江南园林是中国古典园林的代表流派，主要分布在苏州、扬州、南京、无锡、上海等地，以私家园林为主。其特点是在有限空间内模拟自然山水，运用借景、对景、框景等手法，建筑与山水花木融为一体。苏州拙政园、留园、网师园、环秀山庄等9座园林被列入世界文化遗产。
Jiangnan gardens are the representative school of classical Chinese gardens, mainly distributed in Suzhou, Yangzhou, Nanjing, Wuxi, and Shanghai, primarily private gardens. They simulate natural landscapes within limited space using techniques such as borrowed scenery, opposite scenery, and framed scenery, integrating architecture with mountains, water, and plants. Nine Suzhou gardens including Humble Administrator's Garden, Lingering Garden, Master of Nets Garden, and Mountain Villa with Embracing Beauty are UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
实例：拙政园、留园、网师园、个园、豫园
相关：借景 · 对景 · 框景 · 叠山理水
14水乡古镇
Water Town (Shuixiang Guzhen)
水乡古镇是江南地区依水而建的传统城镇，以河成街、桥街相连、粉墙黛瓦为特征。江苏和上海地区保存有众多水乡古镇，如周庄、同里、甪直、木渎、朱家角、新场等。古镇内河道纵横，古桥众多，民居临水而建，是江南水乡文化的活态博物馆。
Water towns are traditional towns built along waterways in the Jiangnan region, characterized by streets along rivers, bridges connecting streets, and white walls with dark tiles. Numerous water towns survive in Jiangsu and Shanghai, including Zhouzhuang, Tongli, Luzhi, Mudu, Zhujiajiao, and Xinchang. With crisscrossing waterways, many ancient bridges, and waterside residences, they are living museums of Jiangnan water town culture.
实例：周庄、同里、甪直、朱家角、新场
相关：粉墙黛瓦 · 马头墙 · 古桥 · 江南民居
15江南民居
Jiangnan Residence (Jiangnan Minju)
江南民居是长江下游地区的传统居住建筑，多为砖木结构的二层楼房，布局紧凑，院落较小（称为'天井'），以利通风采光。外观粉墙黛瓦，内部雕刻精美，苏州的东山、西山和上海的陆家嘴等地保存有大量明清江南民居。江南民居体现了适应南方湿热气候的建筑智慧。
Jiangnan residences are traditional dwellings in the lower Yangtze region, mostly two-story brick-wood structures with compact layouts and small courtyards (called 'tianjing') for ventilation and light. With white walls, dark tiles, and exquisite interior carvings, numerous Ming-Qing Jiangnan residences survive in Suzhou's Dongshan and Xishan areas and Shanghai's Lujiazui. They embody architectural wisdom adapted to the humid southern climate.
实例：苏州东山陆巷古村、无锡严家桥、上海高桥古镇
相关：粉墙黛瓦 · 马头墙 · 天井 · 水乡古镇
16楼阁式塔
Pavilion-Style Pagoda (Lougeshi Ta)
楼阁式塔是中国佛塔的主要类型之一，源于印度窣堵坡与中国楼阁的结合，塔身多层，每层有门窗、斗拱、平座等，可登临远眺。江苏地区楼阁式塔数量众多，苏州云岩寺塔（虎丘塔）、报恩寺塔（北寺塔）、瑞光塔，南京鸡鸣寺塔，扬州大明寺栖灵塔等都是著名实例。
Pavilion-style pagodas are a major type of Chinese Buddhist pagoda, derived from the combination of Indian stupas and Chinese pavilions, with multiple stories featuring doors, windows, bracket sets, and balconies for climbing and viewing. Jiangsu has numerous pavilion-style pagodas, including the Tiger Hill Pagoda (Yunyan Temple Pagoda), North Temple Pagoda (Baoen Temple Pagoda), and Ruiguang Pagoda in Suzhou, Jiming Temple Pagoda in Nanjing, and Qiling Pagoda at Daming Temple in Yangzhou.
实例：苏州云岩寺塔、苏州报恩寺塔、南京鸡鸣寺塔
相关：密檐式塔 · 佛塔 · 砖木结构
17密檐式塔
Multi-Eaved Pagoda (Miyanshi Ta)
密檐式塔是中国佛塔的主要类型之一，第一层塔身较高，以上各层塔檐紧密重叠，多为实心，不可登临。江苏地区的密檐式塔以南京栖霞寺舍利塔最为著名，为五代南唐时期的石塔，雕刻精美。此外，苏州灵岩寺塔、镇江甘露寺铁塔等也属此类。
Multi-eaved pagodas are a major type of Chinese Buddhist pagoda, with a tall first story followed by closely stacked eaves above, usually solid and not climbable. The most famous in Jiangsu is the Qixia Temple Stupa in Nanjing, a stone pagoda from the Southern Tang period of the Five Dynasties with exquisite carvings. Others include the Lingyan Temple Pagoda in Suzhou and the Ganlu Temple Iron Pagoda in Zhenjiang.
实例：南京栖霞寺舍利塔、苏州灵岩寺塔、镇江甘露寺铁塔
相关：楼阁式塔 · 佛塔 · 石塔
18寺庙
Buddhist Temple (Simiao)
江苏地区佛教历史悠久，寺庙众多，著名的有苏州寒山寺、西园寺、灵岩山寺，南京栖霞寺、鸡鸣寺、灵谷寺，扬州大明寺、高旻寺，镇江金山寺、焦山定慧寺、隆昌寺，上海龙华寺、玉佛寺、沉香阁等。这些寺庙多为明清建筑，保存有佛像、经幢、碑刻等珍贵文物。
Jiangsu has a long Buddhist history with numerous temples, including Hanshan Temple, Xiyuan Temple, and Lingyanshan Temple in Suzhou; Qixia Temple, Jiming Temple, and Linggu Temple in Nanjing; Daming Temple and Gaomin Temple in Yangzhou; Jinshan Temple, Jiaoshan Dingshui Temple, and Longchang Temple in Zhenjiang; and Longhua Temple, Jade Buddha Temple, and Chenxiang Pavilion in Shanghai. Most are Ming-Qing buildings preserving precious artifacts such as Buddhist statues, scripture pillars, and steles.
实例：苏州寒山寺、南京栖霞寺、扬州大明寺、上海龙华寺
相关：佛塔 · 经幢 · 石窟 · 彩塑
19陵墓
Mausoleum (Lingmu)
江苏地区保存有多处重要古代陵墓，南京明孝陵是明太祖朱元璋的陵墓，2003年被列入世界文化遗产，其神道石刻和方城明楼是明代帝陵制度的开创者。此外还有南京南唐二陵、中山陵（近代）、镇江句容南朝陵墓石刻等，是研究中国古代陵寝制度的重要实物。
Jiangsu preserves several important ancient mausoleums. Ming Xiaoling in Nanjing, the tomb of the Hongwu Emperor (founder of the Ming dynasty), was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2003; its spirit way stone carvings and square city with Ming tower pioneered the Ming imperial mausoleum system. Others include the Two Mausoleums of the Southern Tang in Nanjing, Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum (modern), and the Southern Dynasties tomb stone carvings in Jurong, Zhenjiang—important artifacts for studying ancient Chinese mausoleum systems.
实例：南京明孝陵、南京南唐二陵、句容南朝陵墓石刻
相关：石像生 · 神道 · 须弥座 · 世界文化遗产
20城墙
City Wall (Chengqiang)
江苏地区保存有多处古代城墙，南京明城墙是世界上现存最长的砖石结构城墙，全长35.2公里，始建于1366年，中华门瓮城是中国现存最大的瓮城。苏州盘门是中国现存唯一的水陆并联城门。这些城墙是研究古代城市防御体系的重要实物。
Jiangsu preserves several ancient city walls. The Nanjing Ming City Wall is the world's longest surviving brick-stone city wall, 35.2 km long, begun in 1366; the Zhonghua Gate barbican is China's largest surviving barbican. Suzhou's Panmen is China's only surviving combined land-water gate. These walls are important artifacts for studying ancient urban defense systems.
实例：南京明城墙、中华门瓮城、苏州盘门
相关：瓮城 · 城门 · 古代城市
21会馆
Guild Hall (Huiguan)
会馆是明清时期同乡或同业在城市中建立的聚会场所，多为建筑精美、装饰华丽的院落。江苏地区的会馆以苏州全晋会馆（现苏州博物馆）、上海三山会馆、苏州潮州会馆等为代表，建筑融合了南北风格，砖雕、木雕、石雕精美，是研究明清商业和建筑文化的重要实物。
Guild halls were gathering places established by people from the same hometown or trade in cities during the Ming-Qing period, usually exquisitely built and decorated courtyards. Representative examples in Jiangsu include the Quanjin Guild Hall in Suzhou (now Suzhou Museum), the Sanshan Guild Hall in Shanghai, and the Chaozhou Guild Hall in Suzhou. Their architecture blends northern and southern styles with exquisite brick, wood, and stone carvings—important artifacts for studying Ming-Qing commerce and architectural culture.
实例：苏州全晋会馆、上海三山会馆、苏州潮州会馆
相关：戏台 · 砖雕 · 木雕 · 晋商
22古桥
Ancient Bridge (Guqiao)
江苏地区水网密布，古桥众多，形式多样，包括石拱桥、石梁桥、廊桥等。苏州宝带桥是中国现存最长的多孔石拱桥，全长317米，53孔；扬州五亭桥是中国园林桥的经典之作；周庄双桥、同里三桥等水乡古桥则与古镇融为一体。这些古桥是江南水乡文化的重要组成部分。
With its dense water network, Jiangsu has numerous ancient bridges in various forms including stone arch bridges, stone beam bridges, and covered bridges. Suzhou's Baodai Bridge is China's longest surviving multi-arch stone bridge, 317 meters long with 53 arches; Yangzhou's Five-Pavilion Bridge is a classic Chinese garden bridge; water town bridges like Zhouzhuang's Twin Bridges and Tongli's Three Bridges integrate with the ancient towns. These bridges are essential components of Jiangnan water town culture.
实例：苏州宝带桥、扬州五亭桥、周庄双桥
相关：水乡古镇 · 石拱桥 · 廊桥
23孔庙
Confucian Temple (Kongmiao)
孔庙（文庙）是祭祀孔子和地方教育中心的建筑，江苏地区保存有多处孔庙。南京夫子庙是中国四大文庙之一，现为著名的文化商业区；苏州文庙始建于北宋，保存有宋代石刻《天文图》《地理图》等珍贵文物；上海嘉定孔庙是江南地区保存最完整的孔庙之一。
Confucian temples (wenmiao) are buildings for worshipping Confucius and serving as local education centers. Several survive in Jiangsu. Nanjing's Fuzimiao is one of China's Four Great Confucian Temples, now a famous cultural and commercial district; Suzhou's Confucian Temple, founded in the Northern Song, preserves precious Song stone carvings including the 'Astronomical Chart' and 'Geographical Chart'; Shanghai's Jiading Confucian Temple is one of the best-preserved in Jiangnan.
实例：南京夫子庙、苏州文庙、上海嘉定孔庙
相关：学宫 · 牌坊 · 碑刻
24私家园林
Private Garden (Sijia Yuanlin)
私家园林是江南园林的主体，由文人、官僚、富商营建，追求'虽由人作，宛自天开'的意境。与皇家园林的宏大不同，私家园林小巧精致，注重空间层次和文化内涵。江苏私家园林以苏州为最，扬州个园以叠石闻名，上海豫园是明代私人园林的代表。
Private gardens are the main body of Jiangnan gardens, built by literati, officials, and wealthy merchants, pursuing the ideal of 'though made by man, looks like nature'. Unlike the grandeur of imperial gardens, private gardens are small and exquisite, emphasizing spatial layers and cultural meaning. Suzhou has the finest private gardens; Yangzhou's Ge Garden is famous for rockery piling; Shanghai's Yu Garden is a representative Ming private garden.
实例：拙政园、留园、个园、豫园、网师园
相关：江南园林 · 借景 · 叠山理水 · 文人园林
25楼阁
Tower-Pavilion (Louge)
楼阁是中国古代多层建筑的统称，在江苏地区多见于园林、寺庙和城市中。著名的有南京阅江楼、鼓楼，苏州钟楼、多宝楼，扬州文昌阁，上海大境阁等。楼阁多为砖木结构，造型优美，既是观景平台，又是城市地标。江苏的楼阁建筑体现了江南建筑精巧秀丽的风格。
Tower-pavilions are multi-story ancient Chinese buildings, found in gardens, temples, and cities throughout Jiangsu. Famous examples include Yuejiang Tower and the Drum Tower in Nanjing, the Bell Tower and Duobao Tower in Suzhou, Wenchang Pavilion in Yangzhou, and Dajing Pavilion in Shanghai. Mostly brick-wood structures with elegant forms, they serve as viewing platforms and city landmarks, embodying the delicate and graceful style of Jiangnan architecture.
实例：南京阅江楼、南京鼓楼、扬州文昌阁
相关：园林建筑 · 钟楼 · 鼓楼

建筑装饰

Decorative Arts
26砖雕
Brick Carving (Zhuandiao)
砖雕是在青砖上雕刻图案的建筑装饰工艺，江苏地区的砖雕以苏州、扬州、南京为代表，题材包括人物故事、花鸟虫鱼、山水楼阁等，工艺精细，层次丰富。苏州东山雕花楼的砖雕被誉为'江南第一砖雕'，是江南砖雕艺术的巅峰之作。
Brick carving is an architectural decorative technique of carving patterns on grey bricks, represented in Jiangsu by Suzhou, Yangzhou, and Nanjing. Subjects include figure stories, flowers, birds, insects, fish, landscapes, and pavilions, with fine craftsmanship and rich layers. The brick carvings at Suzhou's Dongshan Carved Building are known as the 'finest brick carvings in Jiangnan', representing the pinnacle of the art.
实例：苏州东山雕花楼、扬州个园、南京甘熙宅第
相关：木雕 · 石雕 · 苏式彩画
27木雕
Wood Carving (Mudiao)
木雕是江南建筑中最常见的装饰工艺，多用于梁枋、雀替、挂落、门窗等处。江苏木雕以苏州、扬州为中心，技法包括浮雕、透雕、圆雕等，题材丰富，工艺精湛。苏州网师园、拙政园的木雕，扬州个园、何园的木雕都是江南木雕艺术的精品。
Wood carving is the most common decorative technique in Jiangnan architecture, used on beams, spandrels, hanging lattices, doors, and windows. Centered in Suzhou and Yangzhou, Jiangsu wood carving employs relief, openwork, and round carving techniques with rich subjects and superb craftsmanship. The wood carvings at Suzhou's Wangshi Garden and Humble Administrator's Garden, and Yangzhou's Ge Garden and He Garden are fine examples of Jiangnan wood carving art.
实例：拙政园、网师园、扬州个园、苏州东山雕花楼
相关：砖雕 · 石雕 · 挂落 · 雀替
28石雕
Stone Carving (Shidiao)
石雕是在石材上雕刻图案的装饰工艺，江苏地区的石雕多见于牌坊、桥梁、台基、碑刻等处。南京明孝陵神道的石像生、苏州文庙的宋代石刻、扬州五亭桥的石雕栏板都是江南石雕艺术的代表。江苏石雕风格细腻，与北方的雄浑形成对比。
Stone carving is a decorative technique of carving patterns on stone, found in Jiangsu on memorial arches, bridges, pedestals, and steles. The spirit way stone statues at Ming Xiaoling in Nanjing, the Song stone carvings at Suzhou Confucian Temple, and the stone railings at Yangzhou's Five-Pavilion Bridge are representative of Jiangnan stone carving art. The style is delicate, contrasting with the robust northern tradition.
实例：南京明孝陵石像生、苏州文庙石刻、扬州五亭桥
相关：砖雕 · 木雕 · 牌坊 · 碑刻
29太湖石
Taihu Stone (Taihushi)
太湖石是江南园林中最重要的叠山材料，因产于太湖而得名，以'瘦、皱、漏、透'为审美标准。太湖石形态奇特，孔洞丰富，是模拟自然山景的最佳材料。苏州留园的冠云峰、上海豫园的玉玲珑、苏州环秀山庄的假山都是太湖石叠山的经典之作。
Taihu stone is the most important rockery material in Jiangnan gardens, named for its origin in Lake Taihu, judged by the aesthetic standards of 'thin, wrinkled, leaky, and transparent'. With bizarre shapes and abundant holes, it is ideal for simulating natural mountain scenery. The Guanyun Peak at Suzhou's Lingering Garden, the Yulinglong at Shanghai's Yu Garden, and the rockery at Suzhou's Mountain Villa with Embracing Beauty are classic Taihu stone rockeries.
实例：留园冠云峰、豫园玉玲珑、环秀山庄假山
相关：叠山理水 · 黄石 · 假山 · 江南园林
30黄石
Yellow Stone (Huangshi)
黄石是江南园林中另一种重要的叠山材料，颜色黄褐，质地坚硬，棱角分明，与太湖石的圆润玲珑形成对比。黄石叠山风格雄浑刚健，多用于表现北方山景。扬州个园的秋山以黄石叠成，是江南黄石假山的代表作。
Yellow stone is another important rockery material in Jiangnan gardens, yellowish-brown in color, hard in texture, with sharp edges—contrasting with the rounded and exquisite Taihu stone. Yellow stone rockeries have a vigorous and sturdy style, often used to represent northern mountain scenery. The Autumn Mountain at Yangzhou's Ge Garden, built with yellow stone, is a representative Jiangnan yellow stone rockery.
实例：扬州个园秋山、苏州耦园假山
相关：太湖石 · 叠山理水 · 假山
31叠山理水
Rockery and Water Management (Dieshan Lishui)
叠山理水是中国古典园林的核心造园手法，即人工堆叠假山和梳理水体，在有限空间内模拟自然山水。江南园林的叠山讲究'虽由人作，宛自天开'，理水讲究曲折自然。苏州环秀山庄的假山被陈从周誉为'江南园林假山之冠'，是叠山艺术的巅峰。
Rockery piling and water management are the core techniques of classical Chinese gardening—artificially stacking rockeries and arranging water to simulate natural landscapes within limited space. Jiangnan garden rockeries strive for 'though made by man, looks like nature', while water arrangement emphasizes winding naturalness. The rockery at Suzhou's Mountain Villa with Embracing Beauty was praised by Chen Congzhou as the 'finest rockery in Jiangnan gardens', representing the pinnacle of the art.
实例：环秀山庄、拙政园、个园、留园
相关：太湖石 · 黄石 · 借景 · 江南园林
32借景
Borrowed Scenery (Jiejing)
借景是中国古典园林的重要造园手法，即将园外的景色引入园内视线，扩大空间感。借景分为远借、邻借、仰借、俯借、应时而借等。江苏园林中借景运用极为精妙，如拙政园借景北寺塔，无锡寄畅园借景惠山，南京瞻园借景聚宝门等。
Borrowed scenery is an important classical Chinese gardening technique of bringing external scenery into the garden's views to expand spatial perception. It includes distant borrowing, adjacent borrowing, upward borrowing, downward borrowing, and seasonal borrowing. Jiangsu gardens use borrowed scenery exquisitely—for example, Humble Administrator's Garden borrows the North Temple Pagoda, Wuxi's Jichang Garden borrows Mount Hui, and Nanjing's Zhan Garden borrows the Jubao Gate.
实例：拙政园借北寺塔、寄畅园借惠山
相关：对景 · 框景 · 江南园林 · 造园手法
33框景
Framed Scenery (Kuangjing)
框景是中国古典园林的造园手法，利用门窗、洞口等将外部景色框入其中，形成如画的画面。江南园林中的花窗、漏窗、月洞门都是框景的常用手段。苏州拙政园的梧竹幽居、留园的揖峰轩都是框景的经典实例。
Framed scenery is a classical Chinese gardening technique of using doors, windows, and openings to frame external scenery like a painting. Ornamental windows, lattice windows, and moon gates in Jiangnan gardens are common framing devices. Suzhou's Humble Administrator's Garden (Wuzhu Youju Pavilion) and Lingering Garden (Yifeng Xuan) are classic examples of framed scenery.
实例：拙政园梧竹幽居、留园揖峰轩、网师园
相关：花窗 · 漏窗 · 借景 · 对景
34对景
Opposite Scenery (Duijing)
对景是中国古典园林的造园手法，即在轴线或视线的两端布置相互呼应的景点，使观者在任一位置都能看到优美的画面。江南园林中对景运用广泛，如拙政园的远香堂与雪香云蔚亭互为对景，留园的涵碧山房与明瑟楼互为对景。
Opposite scenery is a classical Chinese gardening technique of placing mutually echoing scenic spots at both ends of an axis or sightline, so viewers see beautiful compositions from either position. Widely used in Jiangnan gardens—for example, Humble Administrator's Garden's Yuanxiang Hall and Xuexiang Yunwei Pavilion face each other, as do Lingering Garden's Hanbi Shanfang and Mingse Tower.
实例：拙政园远香堂、留园涵碧山房
相关：借景 · 框景 · 江南园林 · 造园手法
35藻井
Caisson Ceiling (Zaojing)
藻井是中国古代建筑天花板上的装饰性凹面结构，通常为方形、多边形或圆形，层层叠涩，中心雕刻或绘制龙凤、莲花等图案。藻井具有神圣性，多用于宫殿、寺庙的重要殿堂。江苏地区的藻井以苏州玄妙观三清殿、南京朝天宫、上海沉香阁等为代表。
The caisson ceiling (zaojing) is a decorative sunken structure in ancient Chinese ceilings, usually square, polygonal, or circular, with stacked moldings and a center carved or painted with dragons, phoenixes, or lotuses. With sacred connotations, it is used in important halls of palaces and temples. Representative examples in Jiangsu include the Sanqing Hall at Suzhou's Xuanmiao Temple, Nanjing's Chaotian Palace, and Shanghai's Chenxiang Pavilion.
实例：苏州玄妙观三清殿、南京朝天宫、上海沉香阁
相关：天宫楼阁 · 斗拱 · 宫殿建筑

建筑材料

Materials
36金砖
Gold Brick (Jinzhuan)
金砖是苏州御窑烧制的优质铺地方砖，因质地细密、敲击有金属声而得名，并非真金。金砖制作工艺复杂，需经取土、炼泥、制坯、烧制等多道工序，专为皇家宫殿使用。北京故宫的地砖多为苏州御窑金砖，苏州陆慕御窑遗址是金砖的原产地。
Gold bricks (jinzhuan) are high-quality floor tiles fired at the imperial kilns in Suzhou, named for their fine texture and metallic sound when struck—not actual gold. The complex production process includes soil extraction, clay preparation, molding, and firing, made exclusively for imperial palaces. Most floor tiles in Beijing's Forbidden City are Suzhou imperial kiln gold bricks; the Lumu Imperial Kiln Site in Suzhou is their place of origin.
实例：苏州陆慕御窑遗址、北京故宫、苏州文庙
相关：御窑 · 砖瓦 · 官式建筑
37小青瓦
Small Grey Tile (Xiaoqingwa)
小青瓦是江南建筑最常用的屋面材料，以黏土烧制而成，呈青灰色，体积小巧，铺设灵活。小青瓦与白粉墙配合形成'粉墙黛瓦'的典型江南风貌。江苏地区的小青瓦制作历史悠久，苏州、无锡、宜兴等地都是传统产瓦区。
Small grey tiles are the most common roofing material in Jiangnan architecture, fired from clay into grey-blue, small, flexible tiles. Combined with white plastered walls, they create the typical 'white walls and dark tiles' Jiangnan aesthetic. Jiangsu has a long history of small grey tile production, with Suzhou, Wuxi, and Yixing as traditional tile-making centers.
实例：苏州平江路、周庄古镇、上海朱家角
相关：粉墙黛瓦 · 马头墙 · 江南民居
38金山石
Jinshan Stone (Jinshanshi)
金山石是苏州金山出产的花岗岩，质地坚硬，色泽青灰，是江南地区最常用的建筑石材，多用于台基、台阶、桥梁、牌坊等。苏州园林中的假山、石桥、石栏多采用金山石，苏州宝带桥、盘门等古建筑均大量使用金山石。
Jinshan stone is a granite quarried at Jinshan in Suzhou, hard and grey-blue in color, the most commonly used building stone in Jiangnan for pedestals, steps, bridges, and memorial arches. Rockeries, stone bridges, and stone railings in Suzhou gardens mostly use Jinshan stone; ancient buildings such as Suzhou's Baodai Bridge and Panmen Gate use it extensively.
实例：苏州宝带桥、苏州盘门、拙政园石桥
相关：石雕 · 台基 · 古桥
39琉璃瓦
Glazed Tile (Liuliwa)
琉璃瓦是表面施釉的陶瓦，色彩鲜艳，防水耐用，多用于宫殿、寺庙等高等级建筑。江苏地区的琉璃瓦以南京明孝陵、苏州文庙、扬州天宁寺等为代表。南京官窑曾是明代重要的琉璃烧制中心，大报恩寺琉璃塔（已毁）曾被誉为'天下第一塔'。
Glazed tiles are ceramic tiles with a glazed surface, brightly colored, waterproof, and durable, used in high-grade buildings such as palaces and temples. Representative examples in Jiangsu include Ming Xiaoling in Nanjing, Suzhou Confucian Temple, and Tianning Temple in Yangzhou. Nanjing's official kilns were an important Ming glazed tile center; the Porcelain Pagoda of Dabaoen Temple (destroyed) was once known as the 'finest tower under heaven'.
实例：南京明孝陵、苏州文庙、扬州天宁寺
相关：宫殿建筑 · 寺庙 · 琉璃塔
40楠木
Nanmu Wood (Nanmu)
楠木是中国最珍贵的建筑木材之一，质地坚硬，纹理美观，有香气，防蛀防腐。金丝楠木是楠木中的极品，因木纹中有金丝而得名。江苏地区的重要建筑多使用楠木，如苏州网师园万卷堂、南京朝天宫等，楠木厅是江南建筑中等级最高的厅堂。
Nanmu is one of China's most precious building timbers—hard, beautifully grained, fragrant, and insect- and rot-resistant. Golden-thread nanmu is the finest variety, named for golden threads in its grain. Important buildings in Jiangsu use nanmu, such as the Wanjuan Hall at Suzhou's Wangshi Garden and Nanjing's Chaotian Palace; nanmu halls are the highest-grade halls in Jiangnan architecture.
实例：网师园万卷堂、南京朝天宫、苏州东山雕花楼
相关：楠木厅 · 鸳鸯厅 · 四面厅

文化背景

Cultural Context
41世界文化遗产
World Cultural Heritage
江苏地区拥有多项世界文化遗产：苏州古典园林（1997年列入，9座园林）、南京明孝陵（2003年，作为明清皇家陵寝扩展项目）、中国大运河（2014年，江苏段沿线多处遗产点）、黄（渤）海候鸟栖息地（2019年，盐城）。这些遗产是江苏古建筑和文化景观的精华。
Jiangsu has multiple UNESCO World Cultural Heritage sites: Classical Gardens of Suzhou (listed 1997, 9 gardens), Ming Xiaoling in Nanjing (2003, as extension of Imperial Tombs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties), the Grand Canal of China (2014, with multiple heritage points along the Jiangsu section), and Migratory Bird Sanctuaries along the Coast of the Yellow Sea-Bohai Gulf (2019, Yancheng). These represent the essence of Jiangsu's ancient architecture and cultural landscapes.
实例：苏州古典园林、南京明孝陵、中国大运河江苏段
相关：江南园林 · 陵墓 · 大运河
42大运河
The Grand Canal (Da Yunhe)
中国大运河是世界上最长的人工运河，全长2700公里，2014年列入世界文化遗产。江苏段是大运河的核心区段，沿线保存有大量古建筑，如苏州盘门、山塘街，扬州瘦西湖、个园，镇江西津渡，无锡清名桥，常州青果巷等。大运河孕育了江苏的水乡文化和商业文明。
The Grand Canal of China is the world's longest artificial waterway, 2,700 km long, listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2014. The Jiangsu section is the core segment, preserving numerous ancient buildings along its banks, including Suzhou's Panmen Gate and Shantang Street, Yangzhou's Slender West Lake and Ge Garden, Zhenjiang's Xijin Ferry, Wuxi's Qingming Bridge, and Changzhou's Qingguo Lane. The Grand Canal nurtured Jiangsu's water town culture and commercial civilization.
实例：苏州山塘街、扬州瘦西湖、镇江西津渡、无锡清名桥
相关：水乡古镇 · 会馆 · 古桥 · 世界文化遗产
43文人园林
Literati Garden (Wenren Yuanlin)
文人园林是中国古典园林的重要类型，由文人、画家设计或参与营建，追求诗情画意和隐逸意境。江苏是文人园林的发源地和中心，苏州拙政园（王献臣）、网师园（史正志）、艺圃（文震孟）等都与文人密切相关。文人园林体现了中国文人'达则兼济天下，穷则独善其身'的人生哲学。
Literati gardens are an important type of classical Chinese garden, designed or built with participation from literati and painters, pursuing poetic, painterly, and reclusive aesthetics. Jiangsu is the birthplace and center of literati gardens—Suzhou's Humble Administrator's Garden (Wang Xianchen), Master of Nets Garden (Shi Zhengzhi), and Yi Garden (Wen Zhenmeng) are all closely associated with literati. They embody the Chinese literati philosophy of 'when successful, serve the world; when frustrated, cultivate oneself'.
实例：拙政园、网师园、艺圃、耦园
相关：江南园林 · 私家园林 · 借景 · 叠山理水
44江南文化
Jiangnan Culture (Jiangnan Wenhua)
江南文化是长江下游地区形成的地域文化，以崇文重教、精致典雅、工商并重为特征。江苏是江南文化的核心区域，苏州、扬州、南京、无锡等城市都是江南文化的代表。江南文化在建筑上体现为粉墙黛瓦、小桥流水、园林精巧，在文化上体现为诗词、书画、戏曲、工艺的繁荣。
Jiangnan culture is a regional culture formed in the lower Yangtze region, characterized by reverence for education, refinement and elegance, and a balance of commerce and industry. Jiangsu is the core region of Jiangnan culture, with Suzhou, Yangzhou, Nanjing, and Wuxi as representative cities. In architecture, Jiangnan culture manifests as white walls, dark tiles, small bridges, flowing water, and exquisite gardens; in culture, as prosperity in poetry, calligraphy, painting, opera, and crafts.
实例：苏州、扬州、南京、无锡
相关：江南园林 · 江南民居 · 水乡古镇 · 文人园林
45金陵文化
Jinling Culture (Jinling Wenhua)
金陵文化是以南京为中心的地域文化，南京古称金陵，是六朝古都、十朝都会。金陵文化兼具南北特色，既有江南的温婉，又有北方的雄浑。南京的古建筑体现了这种融合：明孝陵的规制宏大，夫子庙的市井繁华，栖霞寺的佛教传统，总统府的近代变革，都是金陵文化的物质载体。
Jinling culture is a regional culture centered on Nanjing, anciently called Jinling, capital of the Six Dynasties and capital of ten dynasties. Jinling culture blends northern and southern characteristics, combining Jiangnan gentleness with northern robustness. Nanjing's ancient architecture reflects this fusion: the grand scale of Ming Xiaoling, the bustling market of Fuzimiao, the Buddhist tradition of Qixia Temple, and the modern transformation of the Presidential Palace are all material carriers of Jinling culture.
实例：南京明孝陵、夫子庙、栖霞寺、总统府
相关：陵墓 · 孔庙 · 寺庙 · 城墙
46淮扬文化
Huaiyang Culture (Huaiyang Wenhua)
淮扬文化是以扬州为中心的地域文化，因地处淮河与长江之间而得名。扬州在唐代就是'扬一益二'的繁华都市，清代以盐商文化闻名。淮扬文化在建筑上体现为扬州园林的精巧奢华（个园、何园）、大运河的商业繁荣、扬州八怪的艺术创新。淮扬菜是中国四大菜系之一。
Huaiyang culture is a regional culture centered on Yangzhou, named for its location between the Huai River and Yangtze. Yangzhou was already a prosperous city in the Tang dynasty ('Yangzhou first, Yizhou second'), and in the Qing dynasty it was famous for salt merchant culture. In architecture, Huaiyang culture manifests as the exquisite luxury of Yangzhou gardens (Ge Garden, He Garden), the commercial prosperity of the Grand Canal, and the artistic innovation of the Eight Eccentrics of Yangzhou. Huaiyang cuisine is one of China's four major cuisines.
实例：扬州个园、何园、瘦西湖、大运河
相关：江南园林 · 大运河 · 盐商 · 会馆
47海派文化
Shanghai-Style Culture (Haipai Wenhua)
海派文化是上海开埠后形成的地域文化，以中西融合、兼收并蓄、创新求变为特征。上海的古建筑既保留了江南传统（豫园、龙华寺、朱家角古镇），又融合了西方元素（外滩建筑群、石库门里弄）。石库门是海派建筑的代表，将江南民居与西方联排住宅结合，是近代上海城市文化的象征。
Shanghai-style (haipai) culture is a regional culture formed after Shanghai's opening as a treaty port, characterized by East-West fusion, eclecticism, and innovation. Shanghai's ancient architecture preserves Jiangnan traditions (Yu Garden, Longhua Temple, Zhujiajiao Ancient Town) while integrating Western elements (the Bund buildings, shikumen lane houses). Shikumen, combining Jiangnan residences with Western row houses, is representative of haipai architecture and a symbol of modern Shanghai urban culture.
实例：上海豫园、龙华寺、石库门里弄、朱家角古镇
相关：江南民居 · 水乡古镇 · 会馆 · 近代建筑
48盐商建筑
Salt Merchant Architecture (Yanshang Jianzhu)
盐商建筑是明清时期扬州盐商营建的住宅和园林，以奢华精巧著称。清代扬州盐商富甲天下，他们营建的个园、何园、片石山房等园林，以及大量盐商住宅，代表了江南建筑的最高工艺水平。盐商建筑的特点是规模宏大、装饰精美、融合南北风格，是研究明清商业文化的重要实物。
Salt merchant architecture refers to residences and gardens built by Yangzhou salt merchants during the Ming-Qing period, known for luxury and refinement. Qing dynasty Yangzhou salt merchants were among the wealthiest in China; their gardens such as Ge Garden, He Garden, and Pianshi Shanfang, along with numerous salt merchant residences, represent the highest craftsmanship level of Jiangnan architecture. Characterized by large scale, exquisite decoration, and blended northern-southern styles, they are important artifacts for studying Ming-Qing commercial culture.
实例：扬州个园、何园、片石山房、卢氏盐商住宅
相关：江南园林 · 会馆 · 淮扬文化 · 砖雕
49经幢
Scripture Pillar (Jingchuang)
经幢是中国古代佛教石刻建筑，为八角形或圆形石柱，上刻佛经，多立于寺庙殿前。江苏地区保存有多处古代经幢，如南京栖霞寺的南唐经幢、苏州虎丘云岩寺的唐代经幢、镇江隆昌寺的明代经幢等。经幢是研究佛教传播和石刻艺术的重要实物。
Scripture pillars (jingchuang) are ancient Chinese Buddhist stone structures—octagonal or round stone pillars inscribed with Buddhist scriptures, usually erected in front of temple halls. Several ancient scripture pillars survive in Jiangsu, including the Southern Tang pillars at Nanjing's Qixia Temple, Tang pillars at Suzhou's Tiger Hill Yunyan Temple, and Ming pillars at Zhenjiang's Longchang Temple. They are important artifacts for studying Buddhist propagation and stone carving art.
实例：南京栖霞寺经幢、苏州虎丘经幢、镇江隆昌寺经幢
相关：寺庙 · 佛塔 · 石雕 · 石窟
50牌坊
Memorial Arch (Paifang)
牌坊是中国古代标志性建筑，多为石构或木构，用于表彰功德、标志空间。江苏地区牌坊众多，苏州文庙的牌坊群、南京夫子庙的天下文枢坊、扬州个园的汉学堂牌坊等都是代表。牌坊建筑融合了结构美与装饰美，是江南建筑艺术的重要组成部分。
Memorial arches (paifang) are landmark ancient Chinese structures, usually stone or wooden, used to commend merit and mark spaces. Jiangsu has numerous memorial arches, including the arch group at Suzhou Confucian Temple, the 'Tianxia Wenshu' Arch at Nanjing's Fuzimiao, and the Hanxuetang Arch at Yangzhou's Ge Garden. Combining structural and decorative beauty, memorial arches are an important component of Jiangnan architectural art.
实例：苏州文庙牌坊、南京夫子庙牌坊、扬州个园牌坊
相关：孔庙 · 石雕 · 门楼 · 古代城市

从南京的六朝烟水到上海的万国建筑，从苏州的园林雅韵到扬州的盐商繁华，江苏上海地区的古建筑承载着中国最丰富的建筑语言。本术语库收录90个核心建筑术语，为您深度解读这片土地上的木石诗篇。

Chapter 01

交通建筑

Transportation Architecture
码头
Wharf (Matou)
中国古代和近代江河海边供船只停靠、装卸货物和旅客上下的设施，是水运交通的节点。
Facilities along rivers, lakes and seas in ancient and modern China for ships to dock, load and unload cargo, and passengers to embark and disembark, nodes of water transportation.
代表建筑 / See Also
龙江宝船厂遗址、京杭大运河
桥梁
Bridge (Qiaoliang)
中国古代跨越河流沟壑的建筑，有梁桥、拱桥、索桥、浮桥等多种形式，是古代交通工程的杰出成就。
Buildings spanning rivers and gullies in ancient China, with various forms including beam bridges, arch bridges, suspension bridges and pontoon bridges, outstanding achievements of ancient transportation engineering.
代表建筑 / See Also
七桥瓮、赵州桥、宝带桥
Chapter 02

公共建筑

Public Architecture
会馆
Guild Hall (Huiguan)
中国古代旅居异地的同乡或同行设立的机构建筑，供集会、议事、祭祀、住宿之用，明清时期商业发达地区尤为兴盛。
Institutional buildings established in ancient China by fellow townsmen or colleagues living away from home, for gatherings, discussions, worship and lodging, especially flourishing in commercially developed areas during the Ming and Qing.
代表建筑 / See Also
三山会馆、全晋会馆、安徽会馆
戏台
Opera Stage (Xitai)
中国古建筑中供戏曲演出的建筑，常设于寺庙、会馆、园林中，有固定的形制，装饰华丽，是中国传统戏曲文化的物质载体。
Buildings in traditional Chinese architecture for opera performances, often set in temples, guild halls and gardens, with a fixed form and luxurious decoration, the material carrier of traditional Chinese opera culture.
代表建筑 / See Also
三山会馆戏台、全晋会馆戏台、常州古戏楼群
驿站
Post Station (Yizhan)
中国古代供传递公文的人或往来官员中途休息、换马的处所，是古代交通和通信体系的重要组成部分。
Places in ancient China for people transmitting official documents or traveling officials to rest and change horses midway, an important part of the ancient transportation and communication system.
代表建筑 / See Also
盂城驿、高邮当铺
当铺
Pawnshop (Dangpu)
中国古代收取衣物等动产作质押向放贷者放款的机构建筑，多为高墙深院，有坚固的库房。
Institutional buildings in ancient China that lent money to lenders by taking movable property such as clothing as collateral, mostly high-walled deep courtyards with sturdy warehouses.
代表建筑 / See Also
高邮当铺
Chapter 03

园林艺术

Garden Art
借景
Borrowed Scenery (Jiejing)
中国古典园林的重要造园手法，将园外的景色引入园内，扩大园林空间感，《园冶》将其列为造园诸法之首。
An important garden-making technique in classical Chinese gardens, introducing scenery outside the garden into the garden to expand the sense of space, listed by Yuanye (The Craft of Gardens) as the foremost of all garden-making methods.
代表建筑 / See Also
拙政园、留园、寄畅园
对景
Opposite Scenery (Duijing)
中国古典园林造园手法，在园林轴线或视线的两端设置景物，互相呼应，形成视觉焦点。
A garden-making technique in classical Chinese gardens, where scenery is set at both ends of a garden axis or sightline, echoing each other to form a visual focus.
代表建筑 / See Also
个园、何园、秋霞圃
框景
Framed Scenery (Kuangjing)
中国古典园林造园手法，利用门框、窗框、洞门等将园景框入其中，形成一幅立体的画。
A garden-making technique in classical Chinese gardens, using door frames, window frames and cave doors to frame garden scenery, forming a three-dimensional painting.
代表建筑 / See Also
拙政园、留园、网师园
障景
Obstructed Scenery (Zhangjing)
中国古典园林造园手法，在园林入口或视线前方设置假山、屏风、植物等遮挡景物，达到先抑后扬的效果。
A garden-making technique in classical Chinese gardens, where rockeries, screens and plants are set at the garden entrance or in front of the sightline to obstruct scenery, achieving the effect of first suppressing then releasing.
代表建筑 / See Also
拙政园、留园、个园
假山
Artificial Rockery (Jiashan)
中国古典园林中用天然石块堆叠而成的山，是园林的骨架，有土山、石山、土石山之分，追求透、漏、瘦、皱的审美标准。
Mountains piled from natural stones in classical Chinese gardens, the skeleton of the garden, divided into earth mountains, stone mountains and earth-stone mountains, pursuing the aesthetic standards of transparency, perforation, slenderness and wrinkling.
代表建筑 / See Also
个园四季假山、留园冠云峰、环秀山庄、秋霞圃
太湖石
Taihu Stone
中国古典园林中最常用的观赏石，产于太湖流域，经湖水长期侵蚀形成玲珑剔透的形态，以瘦、皱、漏、透为审美标准。
The most commonly used ornamental stone in classical Chinese gardens, produced in the Taihu Lake basin, formed into exquisite and perforated shapes by long-term lake water erosion, with slenderness, wrinkling, perforation and transparency as aesthetic standards.
代表建筑 / See Also
留园冠云峰、豫园玉玲珑、苏州园林
花街铺地
Patterned Paving (Huajie Pudi)
中国古典园林中用碎石、瓦片、瓷片等材料铺设成各种图案的地面，是江南园林的特色之一。
Ground paving in classical Chinese gardens using crushed stone, tiles and porcelain pieces to form various patterns, one of the features of Jiangnan gardens.
代表建筑 / See Also
苏州园林、扬州园林、豫园
旱院水做
Dry Courtyard with Water Illusion
中国古典园林造园手法，在无水的庭院中用铺地、石矶等手法模拟水景，创造出水的意境。
A garden-making technique in classical Chinese gardens, using paving and stone islets in a waterless courtyard to simulate water scenery, creating the artistic conception of water.
代表建筑 / See Also
秋霞圃凝霞阁前小院
Chapter 04

地方流派

Regional Schools
苏州园林
Suzhou Gardens
中国古典园林的代表流派，以私家园林为主，始于春秋，发展于唐宋，鼎盛于明清，以精致典雅、小中见大著称，拙政园、留园、网师园等为代表。
The representative school of classical Chinese gardens, dominated by private gardens, beginning in the Spring and Autumn period, developing in the Tang and Song, and reaching its peak in the Ming and Qing, known for refinement and elegance and achieving grandeur within small spaces, represented by the Humble Administrator's Garden, Lingering Garden and Master-of-Nets Garden.
代表建筑 / See Also
拙政园、留园、网师园、环秀山庄
扬州园林
Yangzhou Gardens
中国古典园林的重要流派，以盐商园林为特色，风格豪放大度，叠石艺术高超，个园、何园、小盘谷等为代表。
An important school of classical Chinese gardens, characterized by salt merchant gardens, with a bold and generous style and superb rock-piling art, represented by Ge Garden, He Garden and Xiaopangu.
代表建筑 / See Also
个园、何园、小盘谷、卢氏盐商住宅
金陵四十八景
Forty-Eight Scenes of Jinling
南京（金陵）地区的传统风景名胜集，始于明代，清代定型，涵盖南京地区的山水、古迹、园林等景观。
The collection of traditional scenic spots in Nanjing (Jinling), beginning in the Ming and finalized in the Qing, covering the mountains, waters, historical sites and gardens of the Nanjing area.
代表建筑 / See Also
栖霞寺、明孝陵、夫子庙
沪城八景
Eight Scenes of Shanghai City
上海地区的传统风景名胜集，明清时期形成，包括黄浦秋涛、龙华晚钟、江皋霁雪、吴淞烟雨等景观。
The collection of traditional scenic spots in the Shanghai area, formed during the Ming and Qing, including scenes such as Huangpu Autumn Waves, Longhua Evening Bell, River Bank Snow Clearing and Wusong Misty Rain.
代表建筑 / See Also
大境阁江皋霁雪、龙华寺龙华晚钟
吴门画派
Wu School of Painting
明代中期活跃于苏州（吴门）地区的绘画流派，以沈周、文徵明、唐寅、仇英为代表，主张文人画传统，对江南园林艺术影响深远。
A painting school active in the Suzhou (Wu) area in the mid-Ming, represented by Shen Zhou, Wen Zhengming, Tang Yin and Qiu Ying, advocating the literati painting tradition, with profound influence on Jiangnan garden art.
代表建筑 / See Also
苏州园林、文徵明手植紫藤
松江画派
Songjiang School of Painting
明代后期活跃于松江（今上海松江）地区的绘画流派，以董其昌为代表，主张南北宗论，对中国绘画史影响深远。
A painting school active in the Songjiang (now Songjiang, Shanghai) area in the late Ming, represented by Dong Qichang, advocating the Northern and Southern Schools theory, with profound influence on the history of Chinese painting.
代表建筑 / See Also
醉白池董其昌雕像、松江方塔园
Chapter 05

城市规划

Urban Planning
大上海计划
Greater Shanghai Plan
1929年国民政府上海市政府提出的城市建设计划，旨在绕开租界，在上海东北部建设新的市中心，包括市政府大楼、图书馆、博物馆、体育场等建筑。
An urban construction plan proposed by the Nationalist government's Shanghai Municipal Government in 1929, aiming to bypass the concessions and build a new city center in northeastern Shanghai, including the municipal government building, library, museum and stadium.
代表建筑 / See Also
旧上海特别市政府、旧上海市图书馆、旧上海市博物馆、江湾体育场
Chapter 06

塔幢建筑

Pagoda & Pillar Architecture
楼阁式塔
Pavilion-Style Pagoda
中国佛塔的主要类型之一，仿照中国传统楼阁建筑形式，每层有塔身、塔檐、平座，可登临，是中国古塔中数量最多的类型。
One of the main types of Chinese Buddhist pagodas, imitating the form of traditional Chinese pavilion buildings, with each story having a pagoda body, eave and flat seat, climbable, and the most numerous type of ancient Chinese pagodas.
代表建筑 / See Also
龙华塔、法华塔、兴圣教寺塔、海清寺塔、文通塔
密檐式塔
Multi-Eaved Pagoda
中国佛塔的主要类型之一，第一层塔身较高，以上各层塔檐紧密重叠，多为实心，不可登临，常见于北方地区。
One of the main types of Chinese Buddhist pagodas, with a tall first story and closely overlapping eaves above, mostly solid and not climbable, commonly found in northern China.
代表建筑 / See Also
南京南朝陵墓石刻附近
塔刹
Pagoda Finial (Tasha)
塔顶部的装饰性构件，由基座、覆钵、相轮、宝盖、宝珠等组成，是佛塔的标志性元素，象征佛的涅槃。
The decorative component at the top of a pagoda, consisting of a base, alms bowl, wheel discs, canopy and jewel, the iconic element of Buddhist pagodas, symbolizing the Buddha's nirvana.
代表建筑 / See Also
龙华塔、法华塔、兴圣教寺塔
相轮
Wheel Disc (Xianglun)
塔刹的组成部分，为多重圆环，套在刹杆上，是佛塔的重要装饰，相轮的数量代表塔的等级。
A component of the pagoda finial, consisting of multiple circular rings fitted on the finial pole, an important decoration of Buddhist pagodas, with the number of wheel discs representing the pagoda's rank.
代表建筑 / See Also
龙华塔、兴圣教寺塔
壶门
Pot Door (Humen)
塔、石窟、碑刻等建筑中常见的门形装饰，轮廓为尖拱形，形似壶（古代盛器），常用于塔身壁面。
A door-shaped decoration commonly found in pagodas, grottoes and steles, with a pointed arch outline resembling an ancient pot (hu), commonly used on pagoda body walls.
代表建筑 / See Also
龙华塔、兴圣教寺塔、南翔寺砖塔
腰檐
Waist Eave (Yaoyan)
楼阁式塔各层之间的短檐，形似腰带，是楼阁式塔的标志性特征，使塔身呈现明显的分层。
The short eaves between stories of pavilion-style pagodas, resembling a waist belt, the iconic feature of pavilion-style pagodas, giving the pagoda body distinct layering.
代表建筑 / See Also
龙华塔、法华塔、兴圣教寺塔
平座
Flat Seat (Pingzuo)
楼阁式塔各层塔檐上方的平台，由斗拱承托，外围有栏杆，可供登临眺望。
The platform above each eave of pavilion-style pagodas, supported by bracket sets, with railings around the perimeter, for climbing and viewing.
代表建筑 / See Also
龙华塔、兴圣教寺塔
地宫
Underground Palace (Digong)
佛塔塔基下的地下空间，用于埋藏舍利、佛经、宝物等，是佛塔的重要组成部分，考古价值极高。
The underground space beneath the foundation of a Buddhist pagoda, used to bury relics, sutras and treasures, an important component of Buddhist pagodas with high archaeological value.
代表建筑 / See Also
法华塔、兴圣教寺塔、阿育王寺
经幢
Sutra Pillar (Jingchuang)
中国古代佛教石刻建筑，由基座、幢身、幢顶三部分组成，幢身镌刻佛经（多为《佛顶尊胜陀罗尼经》），盛行于唐代，是佛教建筑的独特形式。
Ancient Chinese Buddhist stone-carved architecture, consisting of a base, pillar body and pillar top, with the pillar body engraved with Buddhist sutras (mostly the Buddha's Top Victorious Dharani Sutra), prevalent in the Tang dynasty, a unique form of Buddhist architecture.
代表建筑 / See Also
松江唐经幢、南翔古猗园唐经幢、太平兴国教寺大殿
须弥座
Sumeru Base (Xumizuo)
中国古建筑中高级建筑的台基形式，由多层线脚组成，中间束腰，形似佛教传说中的须弥山，常用于宫殿、寺庙、塔幢等建筑。
A high-grade platform form in traditional Chinese architecture, consisting of multiple layers of moldings with a waist in the middle, resembling Mount Sumeru in Buddhist legend, commonly used for palaces, temples, pagodas and pillars.
代表建筑 / See Also
松江唐经幢、南京明故宫遗址
叠涩
Corbel (Dieshe)
砖石结构中常见的砌筑方式，将砖石逐层向外挑出，形成支撑或装饰，常用于塔檐、经幢等建筑。
A common masonry method in brick-stone structures, where bricks or stones are projected outward layer by layer to form support or decoration, commonly used for pagoda eaves and sutra pillars.
代表建筑 / See Also
龙华塔、南翔寺砖塔、松江唐经幢
Chapter 07

宗教建筑

Religious Architecture
清真寺
Mosque (Qingzhensi)
伊斯兰教的宗教建筑，中国清真寺多采用中国传统建筑形式，有礼拜殿、邦克楼、水房等组成部分。
Religious buildings of Islam; Chinese mosques mostly adopt traditional Chinese architectural forms, consisting of prayer halls, minarets and ablution rooms.
代表建筑 / See Also
净觉寺、仙鹤寺、山巷清真寺
天主教堂
Catholic Church
天主教的宗教建筑，近代传入中国后多采用西方哥特式或罗马式建筑风格，有钟楼、玫瑰花窗、彩色玻璃等元素。
Religious buildings of Catholicism; after being introduced to China in modern times, they mostly adopt Western Gothic or Romanesque architectural styles, with elements such as bell towers, rose windows and stained glass.
代表建筑 / See Also
徐家汇天主教堂、耶稣圣心堂
基督教堂
Protestant Church
基督教新教的宗教建筑，近代传入中国，风格多样，有哥特式、罗马式、现代式等。
Religious buildings of Protestantism, introduced to China in modern times, with diverse styles including Gothic, Romanesque and modern.
代表建筑 / See Also
沐恩堂、国际礼拜堂
道观
Taoist Temple (Daoguan)
道教的宗教建筑，多采用中国传统宫殿式建筑布局，有山门、灵官殿、三清殿、玉皇殿等组成部分。
Religious buildings of Taoism, mostly adopting traditional Chinese palace-style layout, consisting of mountain gate, Lingguan Hall, Sanqing Hall and Jade Emperor Hall.
代表建筑 / See Also
大境道观、玄妙观
石窟
Grotto (Shiku)
在山崖上开凿的佛教建筑，内有佛像、壁画，是佛教艺术的重要形式，始于魏晋，盛于北朝至隋唐。
Buddhist buildings carved into cliffs, with Buddha statues and murals inside, an important form of Buddhist art, beginning in the Wei-Jin period and flourishing from the Northern Dynasties to the Sui-Tang.
代表建筑 / See Also
千佛崖石窟、孔望山摩崖造像
Chapter 08

屋顶形式

Roof Forms
歇山顶
Hip-and-Gable Roof (Xieshan)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，又称九脊顶，由一条正脊、四条垂脊和四条戗脊组成，上半部为悬山式，下半部为庑殿式，常用于宫殿、寺庙、园林建筑中等级较高的建筑。
One of the traditional Chinese architectural roof forms, also called the nine-ridge roof, consisting of one main ridge, four vertical ridges and four diagonal ridges; the upper half is of the overhanging gable type and the lower half of the hip type, commonly used for higher-ranking buildings in palaces, temples and gardens.
代表建筑 / See Also
朝天宫、灵谷寺无梁殿、真如寺大殿、龙华寺大雄宝殿
庑殿顶
Hip Roof (Wudian)
中国古建筑最高等级的屋顶形式，又称四阿顶，由一条正脊和四条垂脊组成，四面坡，常用于宫殿最高等级建筑，如北京故宫太和殿。
The highest-ranking traditional Chinese roof form, also called the four-slope roof, consisting of one main ridge and four vertical ridges with four sloping sides, commonly used for the highest-ranking palace buildings such as the Hall of Supreme Harmony in the Forbidden City.
代表建筑 / See Also
明孝陵、南京南朝陵墓石刻
攒尖顶
Pyramidal Roof (Zanjian)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，屋顶为锥形，无正脊，顶部集中于一点（宝顶），有三角、四角、六角、八角、圆形等多种平面形式，常用于亭、阁、塔等建筑。
A traditional Chinese roof form with a conical shape, no main ridge, and the top converging at a single point (finial), with various plan forms including triangular, quadrangular, hexagonal, octagonal and circular, commonly used for pavilions, towers and pagodas.
代表建筑 / See Also
苏州园林亭子、中国银行大楼顶部、七桥瓮
悬山顶
Overhanging Gable Roof (Xuanshan)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，又称挑山顶，两山屋顶伸出山墙之外，檩木暴露在外，是民间建筑中最常见的屋顶形式。
A traditional Chinese roof form, also called the overhanging mountain roof, where the two gable roofs extend beyond the gable walls with exposed purlins, the most common roof form in vernacular architecture.
代表建筑 / See Also
杨柳村古建筑群、荡口古镇
硬山顶
Flush Gable Roof (Yingshan)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，山墙与屋顶齐平或高出屋顶，檩木不外露，是江南民居中最常见的屋顶形式，防火性能较好。
A traditional Chinese roof form where the gable walls are flush with or rise above the roof, with no exposed purlins, the most common roof form in Jiangnan residences, with relatively good fire resistance.
代表建筑 / See Also
甘熙宅第、小娄巷民居群、上海石库门
卷棚顶
Round-Ridge Roof (Juanpeng)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，无正脊，屋顶前后坡相接处为弧形曲面，线条柔和，常用于园林建筑和民居，显得活泼雅致。
A traditional Chinese roof form with no main ridge, where the junction of the front and rear roof slopes is an arc-shaped curve with soft lines, commonly used in garden architecture and residences, appearing lively and elegant.
代表建筑 / See Also
苏州园林、扬州园林
盝顶
Flat-Top with Four Slopes (Luding)
中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，顶部为平顶，四周有坡，四角有短脊，形似盝（古代妆具），常用于楼阁和园林建筑。
A traditional Chinese roof form with a flat top and slopes on all four sides, with short ridges at the four corners, resembling an ancient cosmetic box (lu), commonly used for towers and garden buildings.
代表建筑 / See Also
北京故宫角楼
Chapter 09

建筑典籍

Architectural Texts
营造法式
Yingzao Fashi (State Building Standards)
北宋李诫编修的建筑技术专著，元符三年（1100年）编成，崇宁二年（1103年）刊行，是中国古代最完整的建筑技术书籍，确立了材分制的模数体系。
An architectural technical monograph compiled by Li Jie in the Northern Song, completed in 1100 and published in 1103, the most complete architectural technical book of ancient China, establishing the modular system of cai-fen (material-unit).
代表建筑 / See Also
真如寺大殿斗拱、保圣寺塔
清营造则例
Qing Yingzao Zeli (Qing Building Regulations)
清代官方颁布的建筑工程做法规范，梁思成根据清代工匠做法整理成书，是研究清代建筑的重要文献。
The official building engineering practice standards promulgated in the Qing dynasty, organized into a book by Liang Sicheng based on Qing craftsmen's practices, an important document for studying Qing architecture.
代表建筑 / See Also
真如寺大殿斗拱对比
Chapter 10

建筑制度

Architectural Systems
伽蓝七堂
Seven Halls of Sangharama
中国佛教寺院的标准布局，由山门、天王殿、大雄宝殿、后殿、法堂、伽蓝殿、祖师殿七座主要建筑组成，是禅宗寺院的典型格局。
The standard layout of Chinese Buddhist temples, consisting of seven main buildings: mountain gate, Hall of Heavenly Kings, Mahavira Hall, rear hall, Dharma hall, Sangharama Hall and Patriarch Hall, the typical layout of Chan Buddhist temples.
代表建筑 / See Also
龙华寺、栖霞寺、天宁寺
泮池
Pan Pool
孔庙（文庙）前的半圆形水池，是儒家礼制建筑的标志，象征儒学，池上常架泮桥。
The semicircular pool in front of Confucian temples (wenmiao), a symbol of Confucian ritual architecture, symbolizing Confucian learning, often with a Pan bridge over it.
代表建筑 / See Also
嘉定孔庙、南京夫子庙、江阴文庙
棂星门
Lingxing Gate
孔庙（文庙）的第一道门，原为古代祭天的灵星门，孔庙设棂星门象征尊孔如尊天，通常为三间四柱石牌坊式。
The first gate of Confucian temples (wenmiao), originally the Lingxing (Spirit Star) Gate for ancient heaven worship; setting a Lingxing Gate in Confucian temples symbolizes revering Confucius as revering heaven, usually in the form of a three-bay four-column stone paifang.
代表建筑 / See Also
嘉定孔庙、南京夫子庙
Chapter 11

教育建筑

Educational Architecture
书院
Academy (Shuyuan)
中国古代私人或官府设立的讲学、藏书、祭祀场所，是中国古代教育体系的重要组成部分，建筑多为院落式布局。
Institutions established privately or by the government in ancient China for lectures, book collection and worship, an important part of the ancient Chinese education system, mostly in courtyard-style layouts.
代表建筑 / See Also
东林书院、钟山书院、如皋公立简易师范学堂
学宫
School Palace (Xuegong)
中国古代地方官办学校，与孔庙合为一体，称庙学，是地方教育和祭祀孔子的中心。
Local government-run schools in ancient China, integrated with Confucian temples, called temple-schools, the center of local education and Confucius worship.
代表建筑 / See Also
嘉定孔庙、无锡县学旧址、江阴文庙
考棚
Examination Hall (Kaopeng)
中国古代科举考试的场所，有大量独立的号舍，是科举制度的物质见证。
Places for imperial examinations in ancient China, with a large number of independent examination cells, a material witness to the imperial examination system.
代表建筑 / See Also
学政试院、江南贡院
Chapter 12

木构体系

Timber Frame System
斗拱
Bracket Set (Dougong)
中国古建筑特有的构件，由方形的斗、升和弓形的拱、斜向的昂组成，位于柱顶、额枋与屋顶之间，起承托屋檐、传递荷载和装饰作用，是中国古建筑的标志性元素。
A unique component of traditional Chinese architecture, consisting of square blocks (dou/sheng), bow-shaped arms (gong) and inclined ang (lever arms), located between column tops, architraves and the roof, serving to support eaves, transfer loads and decorate, and is the iconic element of traditional Chinese architecture.
代表建筑 / See Also
保圣寺塔、南翔寺砖塔、兴圣教寺塔、真如寺大殿
五铺作
Five-Tier Bracket Set (Wupuzuo)
宋代《营造法式》中斗拱的等级之一，出跳数为两跳（华拱两跳或华拱一跳加昂一跳），是中等规格的斗拱做法，常用于寺庙大殿等建筑。
One of the bracket set grades in the Song dynasty Yingzao Fashi (State Building Standards), with two tiers of projections (either two hua-gong tiers or one hua-gong tier plus one ang tier), a medium-specification bracket set method commonly used for temple main halls.
代表建筑 / See Also
保圣寺塔、南翔寺砖塔
单杪单昂
Single Hua-Gong and Single Ang
斗拱出跳的一种组合方式，第一层出华拱（杪），第二层出昂，是五铺作斗拱的常见形式。
A combination of bracket set projections, with the first tier projecting a hua-gong (miao) and the second tier projecting an ang, a common form of five-tier bracket sets.
代表建筑 / See Also
南翔寺砖塔
补间铺作
Intermediate Bracket Set (Bujian Puzuo)
宋代斗拱的一种位置分类，位于两柱之间的额枋上，与柱头铺作（柱顶斗拱）和转角铺作（角柱斗拱）相对应。
A positional classification of Song-dynasty bracket sets, located on the architrave between two columns, corresponding to the column-top bracket set (zhutou puzuo) and corner bracket set (zhuanjiao puzuo).
代表建筑 / See Also
南翔寺砖塔、真如寺大殿
月梁
Crescent Beam (Yueliang)
中国古建筑梁架中的一种梁，梁背呈弧形隆起，梁底亦弧形上凹，形似新月，常用于江南建筑的厅堂中，造型优美。
A type of beam in traditional Chinese timber framing, with the top of the beam arched upward and the bottom also concavely curved, resembling a crescent moon, commonly used in the halls of Jiangnan architecture with an elegant form.
代表建筑 / See Also
苏州园林厅堂、扬州盐商住宅
梭柱
Spindle Column (Suozhu)
中国古建筑柱式之一，柱身上下两端收窄，中部微鼓，形似织布的梭子，是宋代以前常见的柱式，明清以后较少使用。
A traditional Chinese column type with both upper and lower ends tapered and the middle slightly bulging, resembling a weaving spindle, a common column type before the Song dynasty, less used after the Ming and Qing.
代表建筑 / See Also
保圣寺塔、南唐二陵
卷杀
Entasis (Juansha)
中国古建筑木构件端部的加工方式，将构件端部按比例逐渐切削成柔和的曲线，使构件轮廓富有弹性美感，常用于柱、梁、斗拱等构件。
A processing method for the ends of wooden components in traditional Chinese architecture, where the component ends are gradually cut into soft curves in proportion, giving the component outline an elastic aesthetic, commonly used for columns, beams and bracket sets.
代表建筑 / See Also
南翔寺砖塔、保圣寺塔
雀替
Sparrow Brace (Queti)
中国古建筑中位于柱与梁枋交接处的装饰性构件，形似双翼，起加固和装饰作用，明清时期装饰性增强，常雕刻精美图案。
A decorative component in traditional Chinese architecture located at the junction of columns and beams, resembling two wings, serving to reinforce and decorate; during the Ming and Qing, its decorative function increased, often with exquisitely carved patterns.
代表建筑 / See Also
甘熙宅第、薛福成故居、上海中国银行大楼
藻井
Caisson Ceiling (Zaojing)
中国古建筑室内顶棚的一种装饰性结构，位于建筑中心顶部，呈穹窿状，由多层斗拱和木雕组成，常用于宫殿、寺庙的重要建筑中，象征天宇。
A decorative structure of the interior ceiling in traditional Chinese architecture, located at the top center of the building, in a domed shape, composed of multiple layers of bracket sets and wood carvings, commonly used in important palace and temple buildings, symbolizing the celestial sphere.
代表建筑 / See Also
三山会馆戏台、朝天宫
草架
Rough Frame (Caojia)
中国古建筑中天花板以上的梁架部分，不做精细加工，与天花板以下经过精细加工的明袱相对，是江南建筑中常见的做法。
The part of the timber frame above the ceiling in traditional Chinese architecture, not finely processed, corresponding to the exposed and finely processed mingfu (visible beam) below the ceiling, a common practice in Jiangnan architecture.
代表建筑 / See Also
真如寺大殿
彻上明造
Exposed Frame Construction (Che Shang Ming Zao)
中国古建筑中不设天花板，梁架全部暴露可见的做法，使室内空间高大，常用于寺庙大殿等建筑。
A construction method in traditional Chinese architecture with no ceiling, where the entire timber frame is exposed and visible, creating a tall interior space, commonly used in temple main halls.
代表建筑 / See Also
真如寺大殿、保圣寺塔
Chapter 13

江南民居

Jiangnan Vernacular
天井
Courtyard (Tianjing)
江南民居中房屋之间的露天小院落，面积较小，起采光、通风、排水作用，是江南民居的核心空间。
The small open courtyard between buildings in Jiangnan residences, small in area, serving for lighting, ventilation and drainage, the core space of Jiangnan residences.
代表建筑 / See Also
甘熙宅第、三山会馆、上海石库门
马头墙
Horse-Head Wall (Matouqiang)
江南民居中高出屋顶的山墙，因形似马头而得名，起防火、防风作用，是徽派建筑和江南民居的标志性元素。
Gable walls rising above the roof in Jiangnan residences, named for their resemblance to horse heads, serving fire prevention and wind protection functions, the iconic element of Huizhou-style architecture and Jiangnan residences.
代表建筑 / See Also
杨柳村古建筑群、荡口古镇、徽州建筑
观音兜
Guanyin Hood (Guanyindou)
江南民居中山墙的一种形式，山墙顶部呈弧形隆起，形似观音菩萨的帽兜，是上海及苏南地区民居的特色。
A form of gable wall in Jiangnan residences, with the top of the gable wall arched upward, resembling the hood of Guanyin Bodhisattva, a feature of residences in Shanghai and southern Jiangsu.
代表建筑 / See Also
上海石库门、书隐楼
石库门
Shikumen (Stone Gate)
上海近代最具代表性的民居形式，因入口用石料做门框而得名，是中西合璧的里弄住宅，融合了江南民居和西方联排住宅的特点。
The most representative residential form in modern Shanghai, named for the stone door frames at the entrance, a Chinese-Western combined lane residence that merges the features of Jiangnan residences and Western townhouses.
代表建筑 / See Also
中共一大会址、上海新天地、步高里
砖雕门楼
Brick-Carved Gate Tower
江南民居中用砖雕刻而成的门楼，位于住宅入口，雕刻精美，常刻有题字和吉祥图案，是宅第等级的象征。
Gate towers carved from brick in Jiangnan residences, located at the residence entrance, exquisitely carved, often with inscriptions and auspicious patterns, a symbol of the residence's rank.
代表建筑 / See Also
网师园、个园、苏州古民居
备弄
Service Lane (Beinong)
江南大宅中位于住宅一侧的狭长通道，供仆役通行和搬运物品，避免干扰主院，是江南大宅的特色空间。
A narrow passage on one side of large Jiangnan residences, for servants to pass and carry goods, avoiding disturbance to the main courtyard, a characteristic space of large Jiangnan residences.
代表建筑 / See Also
甘熙宅第、薛福成故居
轿厅
Sedan Chair Hall (Jiaoting)
江南大宅中位于入口后的第二进建筑，用于停放轿子和接待宾客，是宅第礼仪空间的重要组成部分。
The second building after the entrance in large Jiangnan residences, used for parking sedan chairs and receiving guests, an important part of the residence's ceremonial space.
代表建筑 / See Also
甘熙宅第、薛福成故居
Chapter 14

特殊建筑

Special Architecture
无梁殿
Beamless Hall (Wuliangdian)
中国古建筑中不用木梁，全部用砖拱券结构建成的殿堂，又称无量殿，防火性能好，常用于寺庙藏经阁等。
A hall in traditional Chinese architecture built entirely with brick arch structures without wooden beams, also called the Wuliang (Immeasurable) Hall, with good fire resistance, commonly used for temple scripture libraries.
代表建筑 / See Also
灵谷寺无梁殿、隆昌寺铜殿无梁殿
铜殿
Bronze Hall
中国古建筑中全部用铜铸造的殿堂，是佛教建筑中的珍品，铸造工艺复杂，极为珍贵。
A hall in traditional Chinese architecture cast entirely in bronze, a treasure among Buddhist buildings, with a complex casting process and extremely precious.
代表建筑 / See Also
隆昌寺铜殿
Chapter 15

石窟艺术

Grotto Art
摩崖造像
Cliff Statues (Moya Zaoxiang)
在山崖石壁上雕刻的佛像，是中国佛教艺术的重要形式，始于东汉，盛于南北朝至唐宋。
Buddha statues carved on cliff walls, an important form of Chinese Buddhist art, beginning in the Eastern Han and flourishing from the Northern and Southern Dynasties to the Tang and Song.
代表建筑 / See Also
千佛崖石窟、孔望山摩崖造像、将军崖岩画
画像石
Pictorial Stone (Huaxiangshi)
汉代墓葬、祠堂中雕刻有图像的石材，内容丰富，是研究汉代社会生活的重要实物资料。
Stones carved with images in Han-dynasty tombs and shrines, with rich content, important physical materials for studying Han-dynasty social life.
代表建筑 / See Also
徐州汉画像石艺术馆、堂子街太平天国壁画
Chapter 16

祭祀建筑

Sacrificial Architecture
祠堂
Ancestral Hall (Citang)
中国古代祭祀祖先或先贤的建筑，是宗族制度的物质载体，有宗祠、家祠、先贤祠等类型。
Buildings for worshipping ancestors or worthy predecessors in ancient China, the material carrier of the clan system, with types including clan ancestral halls, family ancestral halls and worthy-person shrines.
代表建筑 / See Also
高淳周氏宗祠、惠山祠堂群、史可法墓祠
Chapter 17

纪念建筑

Memorial Architecture
牌坊
Paifang (Memorial Archway)
中国古代纪念性建筑，由柱子和横梁组成，多立于街道、路口、陵墓、寺庙前，起标识、纪念、装饰作用。
Ancient Chinese memorial architecture, consisting of columns and beams, often standing at streets, intersections, tombs and temples, serving identification, memorial and decorative functions.
代表建筑 / See Also
朝天宫牌坊、嘉定孔庙三坊、国际饭店大门
照壁
Screen Wall (Zhaobi)
中国古建筑中位于大门内外的独立墙体，起遮挡视线、装饰和风水作用，又称影壁。
An independent wall inside or outside the main gate in traditional Chinese architecture, serving to block the view, decorate and function in fengshui, also called a shadow wall.
代表建筑 / See Also
松江明代照壁、夫子庙大照壁
Chapter 18

考古遗存

Archaeological Remains
遗址
Ruins (Yizhi)
古代人类活动留下的遗迹，包括城址、宫殿址、作坊址、墓葬等，是考古学研究的重要对象。
Remains left by ancient human activities, including city sites, palace sites, workshop sites and tombs, important objects of archaeological research.
代表建筑 / See Also
明故宫遗址、淹城遗址、阖闾城遗址、扬州城遗址
汉墓
Han Tomb
汉代的墓葬，多为崖洞墓或砖石墓，规模宏大，随葬品丰富，是研究汉代社会的重要实物资料。
Tombs of the Han dynasty, mostly cliff caves or brick-stone tombs, large in scale with rich grave goods, important physical materials for studying Han-dynasty society.
代表建筑 / See Also
狮子山楚王陵、龟山汉墓、天山汉墓
Chapter 19

近代建筑

Modern Architecture
新古典主义
Neoclassicism
18-19世纪西方建筑风格，复兴古希腊罗马建筑形式，采用柱式、山花、檐口等古典元素，上海外滩建筑群多采用此风格。
A Western architectural style of the 18th-19th centuries, reviving ancient Greek and Roman architectural forms, using classical elements such as columns, pediments and cornices; many buildings in the Shanghai Bund adopt this style.
代表建筑 / See Also
汇丰银行大楼、上海总会、亚细亚大楼
装饰艺术
Art Deco
20世纪20-30年代流行的建筑风格，强调几何图案、竖向线条、阶梯状收分和金属装饰，上海是世界上Art Deco建筑最集中的城市之一。
An architectural style popular in the 1920s-30s, emphasizing geometric patterns, vertical lines, stepped setbacks and metal decoration; Shanghai is one of the cities with the highest concentration of Art Deco buildings in the world.
代表建筑 / See Also
沙逊大厦、国际饭店、百老汇大厦、中国银行大楼
折衷主义
Eclecticism
19世纪西方建筑风格，任意模仿历史上各种风格并自由组合，不追求固定的法式，上海跑马总会等建筑采用此风格。
A 19th-century Western architectural style that freely imitates and combines various historical styles without pursuing a fixed formula; buildings such as the Shanghai Race Club adopt this style.
代表建筑 / See Also
跑马总会、江海关大楼
外廊式
Veranda Style
近代殖民建筑风格，建筑外围设连续外廊，适应热带亚热带气候，是上海早期租界建筑的常见形式。
A modern colonial architectural style with continuous verandas around the building, adapted to tropical and subtropical climates, a common form of early concession buildings in Shanghai.
代表建筑 / See Also
英国驻沪领事馆、南洋公学中院
哥特复兴
Gothic Revival
19世纪复兴中世纪哥特式建筑的风格，采用尖拱、花窗玻璃、尖塔等元素，常用于教堂建筑。
A 19th-century style reviving medieval Gothic architecture, using pointed arches, stained glass windows and spires, commonly used for church buildings.
代表建筑 / See Also
徐家汇天主教堂、沐恩堂
钢框架结构
Steel Frame Structure
近代高层建筑的结构形式，用钢材制作梁柱框架，墙体只起围护作用，使建筑可以向高空发展，上海20世纪30年代高层建筑多采用此结构。
A structural form of modern high-rise buildings, using steel for beam-column frames, with walls only serving as enclosure, allowing buildings to develop upward; many Shanghai high-rises of the 1930s adopt this structure.
代表建筑 / See Also
沙逊大厦、国际饭店、中国银行大楼
Chapter 20

防御建筑

Defensive Architecture
城墙
City Wall (Chengqiang)
中国古代城市的防御设施，由墙体、城门、城楼、角楼、瓮城、护城河等组成，是城市的重要标志。
Defensive facilities of ancient Chinese cities, consisting of walls, gates, gate towers, corner towers, barbicans and moats, an important symbol of the city.
代表建筑 / See Also
南京城墙、上海古城墙、高邮城墙
瓮城
Barbican (Wengcheng)
中国古代城门外的防御设施，为半圆形或方形的小城，与主城墙相连，可对攻入之敌形成瓮中捉鳖之势。
Defensive facilities outside ancient Chinese city gates, small semicircular or square towns connected to the main city wall, allowing the enemy who breaks in to be caught like a turtle in a jar.
代表建筑 / See Also
南京城墙、中华门
护城河
Moat (Huchenghe)
中国古代城市城墙外的人工河道，起防御和运输作用，是城市防御体系的重要组成部分。
Artificial waterways outside ancient Chinese city walls, serving defense and transportation functions, an important part of the urban defense system.
代表建筑 / See Also
南京护城河、上海古城墙城壕
炮台
Fort (Paotai)
中国古代和近代在江海要隘设置的火炮防御工事，是海防和江防的重要设施。
Artillery defensive works set at strategic river and sea passes in ancient and modern China, important facilities for coastal and river defense.
代表建筑 / See Also
黄山炮台旧址、江阴要塞
Chapter 21

陵墓建筑

Tomb Architecture
陵墓石刻
Tomb Stone Carvings
古代陵墓前的石人、石兽等石刻，起象征墓主身份和守护陵墓的作用，南朝陵墓石刻是中国石刻艺术的高峰。
Stone figures and animals in front of ancient tombs, serving to symbolize the tomb owner's status and guard the tomb; the Southern Dynasties tomb stone carvings represent a peak of Chinese stone carving art.
代表建筑 / See Also
南京南朝陵墓石刻、丹阳南朝陵墓石刻、明祖陵
