晋中清源城

建筑术语 · Architectural Terms of a Shanxi Vernacular City

"清源曾经是庙宇遍布之地，也是醋都、葡萄之乡、蔬菜基地。
这些术语，记录了一座晋中古城的建筑语言与生活方式。"
屋顶形式
硬山起脊
Gabled Roof with Ridge
中国传统建筑屋顶形式之一，山墙与屋面齐平或略高于屋面，屋顶两端有正脊和垂脊。清源乡土建筑中最常见的屋顶形式，正殿、正房多采用。
A traditional Chinese roof form where the gable wall is flush with or slightly above the roof surface, with a main ridge and hip rafters at both ends. The most common roof form in Qingyuan vernacular architecture, used for main halls and houses.
屋顶形式
硬山卷棚
Gabled Roof without Ridge (Juanshan)
硬山顶的变体，屋面两坡相交处不做正脊，呈弧形曲面，又称元宝顶。清源城隍庙后院正殿、西关关帝庙厢房采用此形式。
A variant of the gabled roof where the two slopes meet without a main ridge, forming a curved surface, also called ingot roof. Used in the rear main hall of Qingyuan City God Temple and side halls of Xiguan Guan Yu Temple.
屋顶形式
歇山顶
Hip-and-Gable Roof (Xieshan)
中国传统建筑高等级屋顶形式，上半部为悬山，下半部为庑殿，有一条正脊、四条垂脊和四条戗脊。清源文庙大成殿、武庙大门采用单檐歇山顶。
A high-ranking traditional Chinese roof form, upper half is overhanging gable, lower half is hip roof, with one main ridge, four hip rafters, and four diagonal ridges. Qingyuan Confucian Temple Dacheng Hall and Martial Temple gate use single-eave hip-and-gable roofs.
屋顶形式
悬山顶
Overhanging Gable Roof (Xuanshan)
屋顶两端山墙退到屋面之下，屋面挑出山墙之外。清源西关龙王庙厢房采用悬山起脊单坡顶，北营村关帝庙戏台采用悬山顶。
Roof form where the gable walls recede below the roof surface, which overhangs beyond the walls. Xiguan Dragon King Temple side halls use overhanging gable single-slope roofs; Beiying Village Guan Yu Temple stage uses overhanging gable roof.
屋顶形式
攒尖顶
Pyramidal Roof (Zanjian)
屋顶坡面集中于顶部一点，无正脊，常用于楼阁、亭、塔。西关市楼为三重檐攒尖顶楼阁，通高22.4米。
Roof form where slopes converge at a single top point, no main ridge, commonly used for pavilions, towers. Xiguan market tower is a three-eave pyramidal-roof pavilion, total height 22.4 meters.
屋顶形式
十字歇山顶
Cross Hip-and-Gable Roof
两个歇山顶垂直相交形成的屋顶形式，平面呈十字形。西关关帝庙钟鼓楼采用单檐十字歇山顶，四柱承重。
Roof form formed by two hip-and-gable roofs intersecting perpendicularly, cross-shaped plan. Xiguan Guan Yu Temple bell and drum towers use single-eave cross hip-and-gable roofs with four load-bearing columns.
木构构件
五踩斗拱
Five-Step Bracket Set (Wucai Dougong)
斗拱出跳数为五踩（两跳华拱加两跳昂），是清代建筑中较高等级的斗拱。武庙大门檐下施五组五踩斗拱，西关市楼一二层檐下施五踩斗拱。
Bracket set with five steps (two hua-gong jumps plus two ang jumps), a relatively high-ranking bracket set in Qing architecture. Martial Temple gate has five sets of five-step brackets under eaves; Xiguan market tower first and second floors have five-step brackets.
木构构件
七踩斗拱
Seven-Step Bracket Set (Qicai Dougong)
斗拱出跳数为七踩（三跳华拱加三跳昂），等级高于五踩。西关市楼三层檐下施七踩斗拱。
Bracket set with seven steps (three hua-gong jumps plus three ang jumps), higher rank than five-step. Xiguan market tower third floor has seven-step brackets under eaves.
木构构件
四铺作斗拱
Four-Tier Bracket Set (Sipuzuo Dougong)
宋式斗拱称谓，出一跳华拱。清源文庙大成殿四面檐下施四铺作斗拱，柱头一攒，补间各两攒，为金代遗构特征。狐突庙后室檐柱间架普拍枋，枋上施四铺作斗拱。
Song-style bracket set term, one hua-gong jump. Qingyuan Confucian Temple Dacheng Hall has four-tier brackets on all four sides—one set at column heads, two between columns—a Jin dynasty surviving feature. Hu Tu Temple rear chamber has pu-pai-fang between eave columns with four-tier brackets above.
木构构件
如意斗拱
Ruyi Bracket Set
拱头雕成如意云纹或象首形状的装饰性斗拱。武庙大门角部的五踩如意斗拱，拱头雕成象首，象征吉祥。西关龙王庙正殿前檐施四组五踩柱头如意斗拱。
Decorative bracket set with arch heads carved as ruyi cloud patterns or elephant heads. Martial Temple gate corner five-step ruyi brackets have elephant-head carvings symbolizing auspiciousness. Xiguan Dragon King Temple main hall front eave has four sets of five-step column-head ruyi brackets.
木构做法
彻上露明造
Open-Frame Construction (Che Shang Lu Ming Zao)
建筑内部不设天花，梁架结构完全暴露可见的做法。清源文庙大成殿梁架采用彻上露明造，用料粗大，结构清晰。
Construction method where no ceiling is installed inside, exposing the entire beam frame structure. Qingyuan Confucian Temple Dacheng Hall uses open-frame construction with substantial timber and clear structure.
木构特征
肥梁瘦柱
Fat Beams, Slender Columns
清源乡土建筑的一大特点，梁的截面高度约为柱径的两倍，梁显得粗壮而柱子相对细瘦。
A distinctive feature of Qingyuan vernacular architecture: beam cross-section height is about twice the column diameter, making beams appear stout and columns relatively slender.
墙体做法
五花山墙
Five-Pattern Gable Wall
山墙顶部随梁架层数呈阶梯状退台的山墙形式，因有五层退台而得名。清源西关龙王庙厢房山墙为五花山墙。
Gable wall form where the top steps back in tiers following the beam frame layers, named for its five tiers. Xiguan Dragon King Temple side hall gable walls are five-pattern gable walls.
砖雕装饰
墀头
Chi Tou (Gable Wall Ornament)
山墙伸出至檐柱之外的部分，通常有砖雕装饰。武庙墀头大样有一进院厢房、二进院厢房、后殿三种不同样式。
The portion of the gable wall extending beyond the eave columns, usually with brick carving decoration. Martial Temple chi tou specimens show three different styles for first-courtyard side hall, second-courtyard side hall, and rear hall.
墙体做法
跑砖
Running Brick Bond
青砖砌法之一，全用平砖顺砌，用于墙裙。清源富裕人家住宅外墙部分用青砖跑砖砌墙裙。
A blue brick laying method using only flat bricks laid lengthwise, used for wall plinths. Wealthy Qingyuan residences used running brick bond for wall plinths.
墙体做法
裱砖
Side Brick Laying (Biao Zhuan)
青砖砌法之一，用侧砖砌法，分一侧一立、一侧两立、一侧三立等。清源富裕人家住宅角部和柱子位置外墙用裱砖。
A blue brick laying method using bricks on edge, categorized as one-side-one-stand, one-side-two-stand, one-side-three-stand. Wealthy Qingyuan residences used biao zhuan at corners and column positions on exterior walls.
建筑小品
影壁
Screen Wall (Yingbi)
设在大门内或门外的屏蔽性墙体，又称照壁。清源衙署巡廨图中有影壁，森泰大街30号院南厢房西山墙正对大门有砖雕影壁。
A shielding wall placed inside or outside the main gate, also called zhaobi. Qingyuan yamen illustration includes a screen wall; Sen Tai Street No.30 courtyard south side hall west gable wall facing the gate has a brick-carved screen wall.
文庙建筑
泮池
Pan Pool (Half-Moon Pond)
文庙大成门前的半圆形水池，象征周天子设立的辟雍。清源文庙现存泮池，泮池上的桥名为状元桥。
The semicircular pond in front of the Confucian temple Dacheng Gate, symbolizing the imperial academy (biyong). Qingyuan Confucian Temple preserves its pan pool; the bridge over it is called the Zhuangyuan (Top Scholar) Bridge.
文庙建筑
棂星门
Lingxing Gate
文庙的第一道大门，象征尊孔如尊天。清源文庙棂星门在20世纪80年代还是完好的，后拆除。
The first gate of a Confucian temple, symbolizing reverence for Confucius equal to reverence for Heaven. Qingyuan Confucian Temple lingxing gate was still intact in the 1980s, later demolished.
商业建筑
市楼
Market Tower (Shi Lou)
位于商业街中心的楼阁式建筑，是商业繁荣的象征。西关市楼通高22.4米，三重檐攒尖顶，基座内设门券通往四条街道，乾隆五十八年1793年刘梦龄新建文昌阁魁星楼于其上。
A pavilion-style building at the center of a commercial street, symbolizing commercial prosperity. Xiguan market tower is 22.4 meters tall with three-eave pyramidal roof; base has arched passages to four streets. In 1793 Liu Mengling built Wenchang and Kuixing pavilions atop it.
防御建筑
碉楼
Watchtower (Diao Lou)
高耸的防御性建筑。普济寺仅剩后院一间平顶房和一座碉楼。筒子楼正房改为高10米左右碉楼，为防御而建。
A tall defensive building. Puji Temple retains only one flat-roofed room and a watchtower in its rear courtyard. The tongzilou (tube building) main hall was converted to a 10-meter watchtower for defense.
住宅类型
筒子楼
Tube Building (Tongzi Lou)
清源特殊住宅类型，专门为防御而建，厢房倒座房与一般住宅无异，正房改为高10米左右碉楼。
A special Qingyuan residential type built specifically for defense; side halls and reverse-side hall are like ordinary residences, but the main hall is converted to a 10-meter watchtower.
屋顶形式
梯儿套檐
Tiered Eave Roof (Tier Tao Yan)
清源大户人家局部坡顶形式，屋顶后三分之二平顶，前三分之一单坡顶带柱廊。
A partial pitched roof form in large Qingyuan residences: rear two-thirds flat roof, front one-third single-slope roof with column porch.
民俗活动
架火
Jia Huo (Stacked Fireworks Tower)
清源正月十六独特活动，用多张长方形桌子做骨架一层一层叠起来竖成高架，爆竹烟花绑高架上由下至上依次燃放。平常年12层闰年13层，总高可达10米左右。
A unique Qingyuan activity on the 16th day of the first lunar month: multiple rectangular tables stacked vertically as a frame, with fireworks tied on and lit from bottom to top. 12 layers in normal years, 13 in leap years, total height up to about 10 meters.
民俗活动
塔塔火
Ta Ta Huo (Coal Stack Fire)
清源正月十六架火配套活动，用煤块堆成约1米高的火堆，一般设十字路口和大商家门口，起照明、取暖和象征红火的作用。
A companion activity to Jia Huo on the 16th day of the first lunar month: coal blocks stacked into a fire about 1 meter high, usually at crossroads and large shop entrances, for lighting, warmth, and symbolizing prosperity.
产业建筑
熏房
Smoke-Drying House (Xun Fang)
利用厢房或倒座房改造的熏制葡萄干建筑，干燥向阳通风，土坯墙平屋顶。东马峪村找到一处生产队时期熏房，有平面立面剖面测绘图。
A building converted from side hall or reverse-side hall for smoke-drying grapes, dry, sunny, ventilated, with adobe walls and flat roof. A production-team-era smoke house was found in Dongmayu Village, with surveyed plan, elevation, and section drawings.
产业建筑
醋坊
Vinegar Workshop (Cu Fang)
酿醋作坊，清源七坊两窑之首。民国时期酿醋字号30余家，实地调查13家醋坊7家保留部分建筑。规模以淋子数量衡量，聚庆诚鼎盛期12个淋子。
Vinegar-making workshop, ranked first among Qingyuan's seven workshops and two kilns. Over 30 vinegar brands in the Republic period; field survey found 13 workshops, 7 with partial buildings surviving. Scale measured by number of linzi (leaching vats); Juqingcheng had 12 at its peak.
酿醋器具
淋子
Lin Zi (Vinegar Leaching Vat)
醋坊规模衡量单位，三个人应付两个淋子效率最高。制醋工艺流程为糖、酒、醋、熏、淋五步。
Unit for measuring vinegar workshop scale; three workers handling two linzi is most efficient. Vinegar-making process has five steps: saccharification, alcohol fermentation, acetic fermentation, smoking, and leaching.
酿醋工艺
夏伏晒冬抽冰
Summer Sunning, Winter Ice Draining
山西老陈醋陈酿工艺，夏天伏天暴晒，冬天结冰后抽出冰块浓缩醋液。400公斤新醋陈酿后剩120-140公斤。
Shanxi mature vinegar aging process:暴晒 in summer dog days, draining ice in winter to concentrate the vinegar. 400 kg of new vinegar yields 120-140 kg after aging.
商业建筑
粮行
Grain Shop (Liang Hang)
清源城同类聚集型工商业中最发达的，牌楼街察院街是粮行集中街道，当地人称粮店街，总长将近400米。十几家粮行每家面积500-800平方米房间30-50间。
The most developed clustered commercial industry in Qingyuan; Pailou Street and Chayuan Street formed the grain shop district, locally called Grain Shop Street, nearly 400 meters long. Over a dozen grain shops, each 500-800 square meters with 30-50 rooms.
商业器具
盒儿
He Er (Grain Measure Box)
粮行门口摆放的斗状木制容器，高30-40厘米上宽约2米下宽约1米，装高粱大麦草麦豌豆小麦小米绿豆广麦等，按斗量出售。
A bucket-shaped wooden container placed at grain shop entrances, 30-40 cm high, about 2 meters wide at top and 1 meter at bottom, holding sorghum, barley, wheat, peas, millet, mung beans, etc., sold by the dou.
商业建筑
当铺
Pawnshop (Dang Pu)
从事典当业的金融机构。清源留存完整当铺建筑4处，建筑最大特点是封闭性和防御性，墙高墙厚庭院宽，院墙4米左右外墙厚80余厘米。
Financial institution for pawning. Four complete pawnshop buildings survive in Qingyuan. Their greatest architectural feature is enclosure and defensiveness: tall thick walls, wide courtyards, courtyard walls about 4 meters high, exterior walls over 80 cm thick.
防御设施
天网
Heaven Net (Tian Wang)
当铺庭院上方安装的铁丝编成的网，下挂铃铛，一触即响，用于防盗贼抢劫。
Iron wire net installed above pawnshop courtyards, with hanging bells that ring on contact, used to prevent robbery.
旅店类型
车马店
Carriage Inn (Che Ma Dian)
招待赶车运货客人的旅店，以南关小南门外和西关关帝庙附近最集中。同和车马店占地约1300平方米院子停马车最多90辆。
Inn for carriage-driving freight guests, most concentrated outside Nanguan Small South Gate and near Xiguan Guan Yu Temple. Tonghe Carriage Inn covers about 1,300 square meters, courtyard parking up to 90 carriages.
旅店类型
驴驴店
Donkey Inn (Lü Lü Dian)
专门招待古交娄烦山客的旅店，山客养驴比马骡子普遍。有棚舍养驴，住房设大通铺炕，炕边有炉，山客带炒面在炉上烤烤下肚。
Inn specifically for mountain guests from Gujiao and Loufan, who commonly raise donkeys rather than horses or mules. Has donkey sheds and large shared kang beds with stoves; guests roast their own fried noodles on the stove.
旅店类型
骆驼店
Camel Inn (Luo Tuo Dian)
招待骆驼队的旅店，清源2家：南关西门坡外苏黑面槐树店，西关市楼西街西头关帝庙南侧永茂店。长途外运西面吕梁山区北面雁北山路崎岖倚仗骆驼。
Inn for camel caravans, two in Qingyuan: Huaishu Inn outside Nanguan West Gate Slope, and Yongmao Inn south of Guan Yu Temple at west end of Xiguan Shilou West Street. Long-distance transport to Lüliang Mountains and Yanbei relied on camels due to rough roads.
煤窑类型
坡道窑
Slope Mine (Po Dao Yao)
煤窑类型之一，从山坡壁打斜井再打水平巷洞。郭家沟坡道窑只有两口：沙圪咀窑和老平窑。
A type of coal mine: an inclined shaft dug from the hillside, then horizontal tunnels. Only two slope mines in Guojiagou: Shaguzui Mine and Laoping Mine.
煤窑类型
筒子窑
Shaft Mine (Tong Zi Yao)
煤窑类型之一，先挖竖井从井底挖水平巷洞，竖井深度十几丈称作一码。郭家沟其余均筒子窑。
A type of coal mine: a vertical shaft dug first, then horizontal tunnels from the bottom; shaft depth of over ten zhang is called one code. The remaining Guojiagou mines are all shaft mines.
煤窑工种
窑黑子
Yao Heizi (Mine Worker)
煤窑工人的俗称，砍煤拖煤摇滑车三种工种中，砍煤拖煤在地下整天接触煤从头到脚黑黑的。
Colloquial term for coal mine workers. Of the three trades—coal cutting, coal hauling, and pulley operation—cutters and haulers work underground in constant contact with coal, black from head to toe.
手工业
土盐
Earth Salt (Tu Yan)
即碱盐，从盐碱地取土煮制而成，味苦质劣，氯化钠含量低，钡氟硫酸镁含量高，长期食用危害健康。民国十六年1927年熬制土盐长期经营者30多家年产约100万公斤。
Also called alkaline salt, made by boiling soil from saline-alkali land; bitter taste, poor quality, low sodium chloride, high barium/fluorine/magnesium sulfate, harmful with long-term consumption. In 1927, over 30 long-term operators produced about 1 million kg annually.
手工业产品
火硝
Saltpeter (Huo Xiao)
熬制土盐的副产品，盐分高土利于得到，卖给火药坊做烟花爆竹炸药，脱硝盐口感更好价格约一般土盐两倍。东湖西岸熬盐硝户每户每天火硝100来斤超土盐产量。
Byproduct of earth salt boiling, obtained from high-salt soil; sold to gunpowder workshops for fireworks and explosives. Desalted salt tastes better and costs about twice ordinary earth salt. At East Lake west bank, each saltpeter household produced over 100 jin of saltpeter daily, exceeding earth salt output.
手工业产品
圪卤
Ge Lu (Bittern)
熬制土盐剩下的液体，冷却沉到底的块状物，不是废料，可用作农业肥料和点豆腐凝结剂（含氯化镁），后成工业用品太原钢铁厂机车厂大量需要。
Liquid remaining after earth salt boiling, cooled to form solid blocks at the bottom. Not waste: used as agricultural fertilizer and tofu coagulant (contains magnesium chloride), later became industrial material in high demand by Taiyuan Steel and locomotive factories.
手工业
火药坊
Gunpowder Workshop (Huo Yao Fang)
制作烟花爆竹炸药的作坊，清源是少数能生产火药的地方之一。产品三类：炸药、火枪药、烟花爆竹，烟花爆竹是主产品。主要分布南关永定街阁儿、小南门、北门一带。
Workshop making fireworks, firecrackers, and explosives. Qingyuan was one of the few places producing gunpowder. Three product types: explosives, gunpowder for muskets, and fireworks/firecrackers (main product). Mainly distributed in Nanguan Yongding Street Ge'er, Small South Gate, and North Gate areas.
手工业工具
炮车
Cannon Cart (Pao Che)
专门卷炮筒工具，燃放效果取决于火药爆炸威力和纸质炮筒密实程度，凭双手无法卷出足够密实炮筒。大炮车图像钟摆和板凳组合，小炮车用倒放小板凳代替。
Special tool for rolling firecracker tubes. Effect depends on gunpowder power and paper tube density; bare hands cannot roll sufficiently dense tubes. Large pao che resembles a pendulum and bench combination; small one uses an inverted small bench.
行会组织
炒米社
Fried Rice Guild (Chao Mi She)
西关炒米业的行会组织，设在西关龙王庙内，龙王庙实为炒米业之会馆。规定每年开始炒米日期、出售价格、限制各户炒米数量、征收巡斗费等。
The guild organization of Xiguan's fried rice industry, located inside Xiguan Dragon King Temple, which effectively served as the industry's guild hall. It regulated annual start date, selling prices, production quotas per household, and collected inspection fees.
行会制度
巡斗
Xun Dou (Inspection Measure)
炒米社内公造量器，不得私造，炒米论斗卖不论斤卖。征收巡斗费，鼓励技术好工人（米粒炒得膨胀不破碎得到更多斗数）。
A standard measuring vessel publicly made by the fried rice guild; private making prohibited. Fried rice sold by the dou, not by jin. Inspection fees collected; skilled workers (whose rice puffs without breaking) earned more dou.
葡萄种植
软式大联棚架
Soft Large Connected Trellis
传统葡萄架形式，架面不到1米高，现代约1.3米。种葡萄一人最多管3亩，种粮食一人管5亩。
Traditional grape trellis form, trellis surface less than 1 meter high (modern about 1.3 meters). One person manages at most 3 mu of grapes vs 5 mu of grain.
农产品加工
熏葡萄
Smoked Grapes (Xun Pu Tao)
即葡萄干，只有黑鸡心红鸡心零蛋马奶适于做熏葡萄以黑鸡心为主。熏制1斤熏葡萄需5斤鲜葡萄，价格约鲜葡萄七八倍。清末民国销往东北内蒙大宗商品，1970年以来新疆葡萄干取代。
即 raisins; only Black Chicken Heart, Red Chicken Heart, Lingdan, and Horse Milk varieties suitable, mainly Black Chicken Heart. 1 jin smoked grapes requires 5 jin fresh grapes, price about 7-8 times fresh grapes. A major commodity sold to Northeast China and Inner Mongolia in late Qing/Republic; replaced by Xinjiang raisins since the 1970s.
农产品加工
浆葡萄
Pulped Grapes (Jiang Pu Tao)
龙眼葡萄冬天储存通风不良散落，来年立春收未腐烂的，含糖量更高，售价仅葡萄十分之二三。
Longan grapes stored in winter with poor ventilation become scattered; those not rotten by the following spring's Start of Spring are collected, with higher sugar content, sold at only 20-30% of fresh grape price.
交通设施
柴桥
Firewood Bridge (Chai Qiao)
用柳树干做桥桩高粱秆铺桥面的临时桥梁，一般秋收前搭好春天冰融化前拆除。清源乡志记载七座柴桥，一直使用到90年代初才完全淘汰。
Temporary bridge using willow trunks as piles and sorghum stalks as decking, usually built before autumn harvest and removed before spring ice melt. Gazetteer records seven firewood bridges, used until the early 1990s.
水利设施
白石堰
Baishi Weir
明洪武二十四年1391年筑，东西长二里，用于治理白石河洪水。清源人开凿27条引水渠，大多百姓自发开凿维护。
Built in 1391 (Hongwu 24), two li east-west, for controlling Baishi River floods. Qingyuan people dug 27 irrigation canals, mostly自发 built and maintained by common people.
自然景观
东湖
East Lake
清源城内湖泊，占地525亩南北长710米东西宽520米，推测形成于公元1605年前后。1967年挖通1400米引河将白石河引入汾河。
Lake inside Qingyuan city, covering 525 mu, 710 meters north-south, 520 meters east-west, estimated to have formed around 1605. In 1967, a 1,400-meter diversion canal was dug to channel Baishi River into Fen River.
历史地名
梗阳
Gengyang
清源古称，春秋时晋大夫祁氏之邑。南关即故梗阳城，有四个城门五个出口五条主要街道。梗阳书院以此命名。
Ancient name of Qingyuan, a fief of Jin official Qi clan in Spring and Autumn period. Nanguan was the old Gengyang city with four gates, five exits, and five main streets. Gengyang Academy was named after it.
历史人物
狐突
Hu Tu
春秋时期晋国大夫，坚持教子忠臣不事二主遭晋怀王杀害，被神化为祈雨之神。西马峪村狐突庙为国家级文物保护单位，存18通元清石碑和两幅大型壁画。
Grand master of Jin state in Spring and Autumn period, killed by Duke Huai of Jin for teaching sons that a loyal minister does not serve two masters; deified as a rain-prayer deity. Ximayu Village Hu Tu Temple is a National Cultural Heritage Protection Unit with 18 Yuan-Qing steles and two large murals.
庙宇建筑
献殿
Offering Hall (Xian Dian)
祭祀活动时用来陈列供品的地方，又称膳庭。狐突庙献殿面阔七间进深四间，硬山顶琉璃剪边，两山墙绘布雨图和回宫图。
Hall for displaying offerings during rituals, also called meal hall. Hu Tu Temple offering hall has seven bays width, four bays depth, gabled roof with glazed tile trim, and murals of Rain Distribution and Returning to Palace on both gable walls.
庙宇建筑
无梁殿
Beamless Hall (Wu Liang Dian)
不用木梁而用砖拱券承重的殿堂。香岩寺三座主体建筑东殿中殿西殿都是无梁殿，寺之俗名也叫无梁殿。
Hall using brick arches instead of timber beams for load-bearing. Xiangyan Temple's three main buildings (east, central, west halls) are all beamless halls, hence the temple's common name Beamless Hall Temple.
庙宇建筑
乐楼
Music Tower (Le Lou)
庙宇中的戏台。北营村关帝庙道光七年1827年重修乐楼至今仍在，三开间悬山顶，前台三面观开敞，后台封闭保暖。
Opera stage in a temple. Beiying Village Guan Yu Temple's 1827 music tower still survives, three bays, overhanging gable roof, front stage open on three sides, backstage enclosed for warmth.
庙宇建筑
钟鼓楼
Bell and Drum Towers
庙宇中悬挂钟和鼓的楼阁，通常对称分布于大门两侧。武庙大门两侧原先是钟鼓楼（十字歇山顶），西关关帝庙倒座房两侧各为钟楼和鼓楼。
Towers housing bell and drum in temples, usually symmetrically placed on both sides of the gate. Martial Temple gate originally had bell/drum towers (cross hip-and-gable roof); Xiguan Guan Yu Temple reverse-side hall has bell tower (north) and drum tower (south).
衙署建筑
寅宾馆
Guest Lodge (Yin Bin Guan)
衙署中用于接待来往官员的宾馆。清源衙署大门内东为寅宾馆。
Lodge in the county yamen for receiving visiting officials. Qingyuan yamen had the guest lodge east of the main gate.
衙署建筑
申明亭旌善亭
Shenming and Jingshan Pavilions
衙署大门外的两座旌表性建筑，左申明右旌善，具有较强的景观意义和旌表功能。清源衙署大门外建二亭，申明左，旌善右。
Two commendation pavilions outside the yamen gate—Shenming (left) and Jingshan (right)—with strong landscape and commendation functions. Qingyuan yamen had two pavilions outside the gate: Shenming left, Jingshan right.
衙署建筑
戒石
Warning Stone (Jie Shi)
衙署甬道中立的石碑，刻有戒石铭尔俸尔禄民膏民脂下民易虐上天难欺。清源衙署甬道中立戒石，戒石之北为大堂。
Stone stele in the yamen path, inscribed with the warning: Your salary and stipend come from the people's flesh and fat; the lower people are easy to oppress, but Heaven is hard to deceive. Qingyuan yamen had a warning stone in the path, north of it the Great Hall.
衙署庙宇
侯庙
Marquis Temple (Hou Miao)
衙署中祭祀萧何的庙宇，侯是萧何的封号，他辅佐刘邦夺得天下又制订汉朝律令，是天下官臣的榜样。乾隆二十六年1761年知县吴龙光建。
Temple in the yamen dedicated to Xiao He, whose title was Marquis; he assisted Liu Bang in conquering the empire and formulated Han dynasty laws, serving as a model for all officials. Built in 1761 by Magistrate Wu Longguang.
书院制度
山长
Mountain Head (Shan Zhang)
书院的主讲，除主讲外也总理院务，由地方绅士公议从进士或举人中选定。执掌梗阳书院者不乏名士如清末民初刘文炳。
Chief lecturer of an academy, who also managed general affairs; chosen by local gentry consensus from jinshi or juren degree holders. Notable scholars led Gengyang Academy, such as late Qing/early Republic Liu Wenbing.
教育制度
社学
Community School (She Xue)
比较正规的具有官方背景的学塾，教学内容除四书五经和八股制文外还包括各种礼节。政府支持有限，办学经费主要来自民间。清源西关关帝庙清代时就是一处社学。
Relatively formal, officially backed elementary school; curriculum included Four Books and Five Classics, eight-legged essays, and various rituals. Government support was limited; funding mainly from the people. Xiguan Guan Yu Temple served as a community school in the Qing dynasty.
教育制度
义学
Charity School (Yi Xue)
民间自办的初级学校，很少见于方志记载。清徐县志提到桃园义学在西马峪村，宿儒牛瑞云于清末捐资兴办。
Privately run elementary school, rarely recorded in gazetteers. Qingxu County Gazetteer mentions Taoyuan Charity School in Ximayu Village, founded by scholar Niu Ruiyun in the late Qing.
民间信仰
文昌
Wenchang (God of Literature)
主文运的神灵，俗称文曲星。清源城原有一处文昌宫和多处文昌阁。西关市楼乾隆五十八年1793年新建文昌阁魁星楼，供文昌和魁星。
Deity governing literary fortune, commonly called Wenqu Star. Qingyuan originally had one Wenchang Palace and multiple Wenchang Pavilions. Xiguan market tower had Wenchang and Kuixing pavilions newly built in 1793.
民间信仰
魁星
Kuixing (God of Examinations)
主宰文章兴衰的神，与文昌同供于市楼。乾隆五十八年1793年刘梦龄新建文昌阁魁星楼。
Deity governing literary success, enshrined with Wenchang in the market tower. In 1793 Liu Mengling built the new Wenchang Pavilion and Kuixing Tower.
民间信仰
五道庙
Five-Path Temple (Wu Dao Miao)
村口常见的小型庙宇，供奉五道将军。平泉村有三座五道庙，王亮老先生幼年时见过。
Small temple commonly found at village entrances, dedicated to the Five-Path General. Pingquan Village had three five-path temples, seen by elderly Wang Liang in his childhood.
民间信仰
土地庙
Earth God Temple (Tu Di Miao)
最小的庙宇建筑，供奉土地神。永定街23号院王有德宅照壁上有土地庙，两侧对联为土能生万物地可出黄金。
The smallest temple building, dedicated to the Earth God. The screen wall of Wang Youde's residence at No.23 Yongding Street has an Earth God Temple with couplet: Earth can produce all things, earth can yield gold.
民俗活动
狐突庙会
Hu Tu Temple Fair
每年七月十五日举行，唱戏三天，为所有来上香的信徒提供一顿免费的面汤。戏班利用普照寺后院作临时住房和厨房。
Held annually on the 15th day of the 7th lunar month, with three days of opera and a free noodle soup meal for all worshippers. Opera troupes used the rear courtyard of Puzhao Temple as temporary housing and kitchen.
民俗活动
葡萄庙会
Grape Temple Fair
平泉北营七月初七，东西马峪七月二十九与香岩寺庙会同期，演戏三天六场，戏资东马峪村负责。
Pingquan Beiying on 7th day of 7th lunar month; Dongmayu/Ximayu on 29th day of 7th lunar month, concurrent with Xiangyan Temple fair, three days six performances, costs borne by Dongmayu Village.
文化景观
清源八景
Eight Sights of Qingyuan
清源古代八处著名景观，包括西岭香岩、中隐环青、汾河晚渡等。香岩寺西岭香岩和清泉寺中隐环青均为八景之一。
Eight famous ancient scenic spots of Qingyuan, including Western Ridge Xiangyan, Central Hidden Mountain Encircled in Green, Fen River Evening Crossing, etc. Xiangyan Temple's Western Ridge Xiangyan and Qingquan Temple's Central Hidden Mountain Encircled in Green are both among the Eight Sights.
商帮
晋商
Shanxi Merchants (Jin Shang)
山西商人集团，清源商业发达与晋商密切相关。乔生福生于1925年最后一代晋商；孙铁牛父亲晋商曾和天津老板合办葡萄酒厂；务本生醋坊主人乔万选为汪伪政府司法部次长。
Shanxi merchant group; Qingyuan's commercial prosperity was closely tied to Shanxi merchants. Qiao Shengfu (born 1925) was the last generation; Sun Tieniu's father was a Shanxi merchant who co-founded a winery with a Tianjin boss; Wu Bensheng vinegar workshop owner Qiao Wanxuan became Vice Minister of Justice under Wang Jingwei regime.
金融
钱帖子
Money Note (Qian Tie Zi)
民国初年清源钱庄当铺粮行发行的钱票，可当货币使用。民国十九年1930年晋钞贬值钱庄倒闭甚多。
Money notes issued by Qingyuan banks, pawnshops, and grain shops in the early Republic period, usable as currency. In 1930, Shanxi banknotes depreciated and many banks collapsed.
金融制度
身股
Personal Share (Shen Gu)
当铺高级雇员的技术入股，加入当铺时谈好银股身股比例，三年为期到期结算利润按比例分，身股收入远大于固定工资。
Technology-based equity for senior pawnshop employees; silver-share and personal-share ratios agreed upon joining, three-year term, profits divided proportionally at settlement; personal-share income far exceeded fixed wages.
金融制度
带东掌柜
Partner Manager (Dai Dong Zhang Gui)
东家即掌柜本人，持身股者可不领现银投入银股成带东雇员。
Where the owner is also the manager; personal-share holders could invest unpaid wages into silver shares to become partner employees.
典当业
下架货
Unredeemed Goods (Xia Jia Huo)
过期不赎的抵押物，可直接出售，占抵押物大部分。收抵押物时价格压得很低，利润相当高。当铺收入主要来自出售下架货其次赎当时收利息。
Overdue unredeemed collateral, sold directly, comprising most collateral. Prices kept very low at acceptance, yielding high profits. Pawnshop income mainly from selling unredeemed goods,其次 interest on redemption.
典当业
当票
Pawn Ticket (Dang Piao)
麻纸蓝印分正副两联，写抵押物名称当价，两联间盖各家特有骑缝蓝印，当铺和抵押人各持一联，期满凭票赎当。
Hemp paper with blue printing, in two copies (original and duplicate), recording collateral name and pawn price; unique blue seal across the perforation between copies, one held by pawnshop and one by pawner; redemption by ticket after term expires.
典当业
柜头
Counter Head (Gui Tou)
当铺中收取抵押物评估价值的高级雇员，收抵押物价格压得低多为原物价值三成或更低，不管成色当票描述一律以破旧二字打头。
Senior pawnshop employee who accepts collateral and assesses value; prices kept low, often 30% or less of original value; regardless of condition, pawn ticket descriptions always begin with worn and old.
商业
彩帛行
Fabric Shop (Cai Bo Hang)
即布庄，晚清西方工业化布匹大量涌入价格比农民自织便宜，家庭妇女普遍放弃纺织，布庄成商业城镇重要商店类型。清源南关丰裕庆著名。
即 cloth shops; in late Qing, Western industrially produced cloth flooded in at lower prices than homespun, women abandoned weaving, cloth shops became important commercial stores. Nanguan Fengyuqing was famous in Qingyuan.
手工业
皮坊
Leather Workshop (Pi Fang)
把生羊皮加工成熟羊皮的作坊，三道工序刮沤磨。清源产皮硝是重要原因，交城制皮业最发达带动清源发展。
Workshop processing raw sheepskin into tanned leather, three steps: scraping, soaking, polishing. Qingyuan's production of leather saltpeter was important; Jiaocheng's most developed leather industry spurred Qingyuan's development.
皮革原料
滩羊皮
Ningxia Tan Sheepskin
宁夏滩羊毛长柔软两寸长，经黄河船运至临县碛口镇沿湫水河谷驼运至晋中，比山西本地羊皮质地更柔软更舒服。旧时说法农民穿老羊皮中上等人穿滩羊皮富贵人家穿狐皮。
Ningxia Tan sheep wool is long and soft (two cun), shipped by Yellow River boat to Linxian Qikou, then camel transport along Qiushui River valley to central Shanxi; softer and more comfortable than local Shanxi sheepskin. Old saying: peasants wear old sheepskin, middle-upper class wear Tan sheepskin, wealthy wear fox fur.
手工业
毡帽行
Felt Hat Shop (Zhan Mao Hang)
熟羊皮做毡帽的作坊，40年代清源城两家，全盛号南关永定街三甲前店后厂。毡帽部分清源本地出售更多贴上河北宣化某毡帽行商标运到那销售。
Workshop making felt hats from tanned sheepskin; two in 1940s Qingyuan, Quansheng Hao at Nanguan Yongding Street Sanjia with front shop rear factory. Some hats sold locally, more affixed with a Hebei Xuanhua felt hat brand label and sold there.
手工业
翻砂厂
Foundry (Fan Sha Chang)
传统粗铁铸造作坊，和盐坊关系密切，盐坊熬盐大铁锅放燃料煤炉条都是翻砂厂制作。集中水桥以北旧地名胡家湾，四和砂园为代表。
Traditional cast-iron foundry, closely related to salt workshops—salt workshop's large iron boiling pots and fuel furnace grates were made by foundries. Concentrated north of Shuiqiao, old place name Hujiawan; Sihe Sha Yuan was representative.
手工业
木匠业
Carpentry (Mu Jiang Ye)
分大木小木，大木匠管建造房屋不需要店铺带队伍上门盖房，小木匠制木制用品有固定店铺分柜铺棺材铺车铺小推车铺。
Divided into large and small carpentry: large carpenters build houses without shops, leading teams on-site; small carpenters make wooden products in fixed shops, including cabinet shops, coffin shops, cart shops, and wheelbarrow shops.
手工业
柜家铺
Cabinet Shop (Gui Jia Pu)
做家具箱柜顶柜大柜坑柜太师椅八仙桌等，好木材梨木核桃木榆木，一般柳木杨木。硬木家具不上漆手工反复推光先用粗布擦最后用手推极费人工。
Shop making furniture—chests, cabinets, top cabinets, large cabinets, kang cabinets, taishi chairs, eight-immortal tables. Fine woods: pear, walnut, elm; ordinary: willow, poplar. Hardwood furniture not lacquered but hand-polished repeatedly—first coarse cloth, finally hand rubbing—very labor-intensive.
商业
同德义糕点铺
Tongdeyi Pastry Shop
民国清源城规模最大名气最响的糕点铺，猪市巷南侧今小西门街18号，前后两进院占地约565平方米。东家刘万长身兼大掌柜二掌柜账房先生。
The largest and most famous pastry shop in Republic-era Qingyuan, south of Zhushi Alley (today No.18 Xiaoximen Street), two courtyards, about 565 square meters. Owner Liu Wanchang served as both head manager, second manager, and accountant.
商业
广德堂
Guangde Tang Pharmacy
40年代末清源城6家中药店中规模最大，南关大街东侧靠近南门。另有聚和堂崇德堂协生泰万助成春生广等。
The largest of six Chinese medicine shops in late 1940s Qingyuan, east side of Nanguan Main Street near South Gate. Others included Juhe Tang, Chongde Tang, Xiesheng Tai, Wanzhu Cheng, Chunsheng Guang.
医疗机构
梗阳医院
Gengyang Hospital
清源南门里第一家现代医院，郭鹤仙太谷明贤学校毕业生教会学校自小受西式教育终生笃信西医，七七事变后开，据说警察局长郝兰亭为老板。
The first modern hospital in Qingyuan, inside South Gate, founded by Guo Hexian (graduate of Taigu Mingxian School, a missionary school, raised with Western education, lifelong believer in Western medicine) after the Marco Polo Bridge Incident; police chief Hao Lanting was reportedly the owner.
宗教建筑
基督教堂
Christian Church
清源是天主教和基督教信徒较多之地，西关市楼西街中段以北现有一座建于1994年的基督教堂，前身是民国初年基督教太谷支会康保罗牧师来清源传教时修建的，同期修建的还有一座医院。
Qingyuan had many Catholic and Protestant believers. North of the middle section of Xiguan Shilou West Street stands a Christian church built in 1994. Its predecessor was built in the early Republic by Pastor Kang Baoluo of the Taigu branch of the Christian Church when he came to Qingyuan to preach; a hospital was built in the same period.

建筑结构 · Structure

窑洞

Cave Dwelling (Yaodong)

窑洞是中国西北黄土高原特有的传统民居，利用黄土直立性在山坡或平地挖掘拱形洞穴。书中记载陕西窑洞有靠崖窑、地坑院（下沉式）和锢窑（独立式）三种类型。陕北窑洞平面呈L形，底层为回廊，廊下墁砖，上下层均有排水设施，是适应黄土高原干旱气候的智慧结晶。

Cave dwellings are traditional residences unique to the Loess Plateau, using loess vertical stability to excavate arched caves. The book records three types: cliff-side, sunken courtyard, and free-standing stone caves. Northern Shaanxi caves have L-shaped plans with ground-floor corridors paved with brick and drainage on both levels—wisdom adapted to the arid plateau climate.

实例: 米脂杨家沟扶风寨、延安窑洞、三原柏社村地坑院 | 另见: 地坑院 · 锢窑 · 黄土高原

地坑院

Sunken Courtyard (Dikengyuan)

地坑院又称下沉式窑洞，在平坦黄土地面向下挖掘方形深坑，再在坑壁四周挖掘窑洞形成地下院落。书中记载三原柏社村保留有完整的地坑院群落，被誉为'地平线下古村落，民居史上活化石'。

Sunken courtyards are underground dwellings formed by excavating a square pit on flat loess ground, then digging caves around the pit walls. The book records that Sanyuan Baishe Village preserves a complete cluster, known as 'ancient villages below the horizon, living fossils in residential history.'

实例: 三原柏社村 | 另见: 窑洞 · 锢窑 · 黄土高原

抬梁式

Beam-Lifting Frame (Tailiangshi)

抬梁式是中国古建筑主要木构架形式，柱上抬梁，梁上安短柱，短柱上再抬梁，层层叠叠形成屋架。书中记载三原城隍庙大殿为'彻上明造，抬梁式构架，五架梁上用瓜柱、角背'，西安钟楼、鼓楼均采用抬梁式结构，可获得较大室内空间。

The beam-lifting frame is a main timber framing form with beams on columns, short columns on beams, layered to form roof trusses. The book records Sanyuan City God Temple's main hall as 'exposed construction, beam-lifting frame with five-rafter beams using瓜柱 and角背.' Xi'an Bell and Drum Towers use this frame for large interior spaces.

实例: 三原城隍庙大殿、西安钟楼、西安鼓楼 | 另见: 穿斗式 · 斗拱 · 彻上明造

斗拱

Dougong (Bracket Set)

斗拱是中国古建筑特有构件，由方形斗、升和弓形拱、昂组成，位于柱与梁枋之间。书中记载西安钟楼'下檐斗拱为三踩单昂，上檐斗拱为五踩双昂'，榆林万佛楼'外檐斗拱布置疏朗，升棋做法正规'，韩城城隍庙戏楼'如意斗拱'是明代建筑特征。

Dougong are unique bracket sets consisting of square blocks and bow-shaped arms between columns and beams. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower's 'lower eaves with three-step single ang, upper eaves with five-step double ang,' Yulin Wanfo Tower's 'sparse outer-eave dougong with regular sheng-qi method,' and Hancheng City God Temple's 'ruyi dougong' as Ming features.

实例: 西安钟楼、榆林万佛楼、韩城城隍庙戏楼 | 另见: 昂 · 华拱 · 坐斗

歇山顶

Hip-and-Gable Roof (Xieshanding)

歇山顶由一条正脊、四条垂脊和四条戗脊组成，又称九脊顶，有单檐和重檐之分。书中记载西安鼓楼为'重檐三滴水歇山顶的阁楼式建筑'，三原城隍庙寝殿'重檐歇山顶，高17.25米'，勉县武侯墓山门'硬山式建筑，抬梁式三架梁'。

The hip-and-gable roof has one main ridge, four vertical ridges, and four diagonal ridges (nine ridges total), with single and double eave variants. The book records Xi'an Drum Tower as a 'double-eave three-water-drop hip-and-gable tower,' Sanyuan City God Temple's bedroom hall as 'double-eave hip-and-gable, 17.25m tall.'

实例: 西安鼓楼、三原城隍庙寝殿、韩城城隍庙广荐殿 | 另见: 庑殿顶 · 攒尖顶 · 硬山顶

庑殿顶

Hip Roof (Wudianding)

庑殿顶是中国古建筑最高等级屋顶，由一条正脊和四条垂脊组成，又称四阿顶。书中记载华阴西岳庙灏灵殿为重檐庑殿顶，体现西岳庙作为祭祀西岳华山的皇家庙宇的崇高等级。

The hip roof is the highest-ranking ancient Chinese roof, with one main and four vertical ridges (four-slope roof). The book records Huayin Xiyue Temple's Haoling Hall as having a double-eave hip roof, reflecting the temple's lofty status as a royal temple for sacrificing to Mount Hua.

实例: 华阴西岳庙灏灵殿 | 另见: 歇山顶 · 重檐 · 琉璃瓦

攒尖顶

Pyramidal Roof (Cuanjianding)

攒尖顶屋面在顶部交汇于一点，上置宝顶，有三角、四角、六角、八角、圆形等形式。书中记载西安钟楼为'三重檐四角攒尖顶，屋面为琉璃瓦，置鎏金宝瓶刹'，城固钟楼'屋顶为六角，攒尖盔顶，宝顶为铁铸宝珠'。

Pyramidal roofs converge at a top point with a finial, in triangular, square, hexagonal, octagonal, and circular forms. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower as 'triple-eave square pyramidal with glazed tiles and gilded bottle finial,' and Chenggu Bell Tower as 'hexagonal pyramidal helmet roof with cast-iron jewel finial.'

实例: 西安钟楼、城固钟楼、户县钟楼 | 另见: 宝顶 · 塔刹 · 楼阁式塔

楼阁式塔

Tower-Style Pagoda (Lougeshi Ta)

楼阁式塔源于中国传统楼阁，塔身分层，每层有塔檐、平座、门窗，可登临。书中记载大慈恩寺大雁塔为唐代楼阁式砖塔代表，塔身用砖，仿木结构，每层有砖砌柱、枋、斗拱，是西安的标志性建筑。

Tower-style pagodas derive from traditional Chinese towers, with layered bodies, each with eaves, balconies, doors, and windows for climbing. The book records the Great Wild Goose Pagoda at Dacien Temple as a representative Tang brick pagoda, using brick to imitate timber structure with brick columns, tie beams, and dougong on each layer—a Xi'an landmark.

实例: 大雁塔、富县柏山寺塔 | 另见: 密檐式塔 · 塔刹 · 平座

密檐式塔

Multi-Eaved Pagoda (Miyanshi Ta)

密檐式塔第一层较高，以上各层塔檐紧密重叠，多为实心不可登临。书中记载荐福寺小雁塔为唐代密檐式砖塔代表，原有15层，现存13层，塔身砖砌，每层叠涩出檐，是唐代密檐塔的杰作。

Multi-eaved pagodas have a tall first story with closely overlapping eaves above, mostly solid and not climbable. The book records Jianfu Temple's Small Wild Goose Pagoda as a representative Tang multi-eaved brick pagoda, originally 15 stories, now 13, with brick body and corbelled eaves on each layer—a Tang masterpiece.

实例: 小雁塔、香积寺善导塔 | 另见: 楼阁式塔 · 塔刹 · 叠涩

塔刹

Pagoda Finial (Tasha)

塔刹是佛塔顶部的装饰和收束构件，由基座、覆钵、相轮、宝盖、宝珠等组成。书中记载泾阳崇文宝塔塔刹为铜制鎏金，高8.52米，是中国现存最高的塔刹之一；城固钟楼宝顶为铁铸宝珠，各层老角梁下原有风铃。

The pagoda finial is the decorative terminal component at a pagoda's top, consisting of base, inverted bowl, phase wheels, canopy, and jewel. The book records Jingyang Chongwen Pagoda's finial as gilded bronze, 8.52m tall—one of China's tallest surviving finials; Chenggu Bell Tower's finial is cast iron with wind bells under old corner beams.

实例: 泾阳崇文宝塔、城固钟楼 | 另见: 相轮 · 覆钵 · 宝顶

摩崖造像

Cliff Carving (Moya Zaoxiang)

摩崖造像是在山崖壁面雕刻的佛教造像。书中记载彬县大佛寺石窟始凿于唐贞观二年（628年），大佛高20米，是陕西最大的摩崖造像；慈善寺石窟、富县石泓寺石窟、米脂万佛洞均有精美摩崖造像。

Cliff carvings are Buddhist statues carved on cliff faces. The book records Bin County Great Buddha Temple Grottoes, first carved in 628 CE (Tang Zhenguan 2), with a 20m Great Buddha—the largest in Shaanxi. Cishansi, Shihongsi, and Mizhi Wanfo Cave also have exquisite cliff carvings.

实例: 彬县大佛寺石窟、慈善寺石窟、米脂万佛洞 | 另见: 石窟 · 佛塔 · 佛教建筑

地宫

Underground Palace (Digong)

地宫是佛塔基下埋藏舍利、佛经和宝物的地下空间。书中记载扶风法门寺地宫于1987年发掘，出土佛指舍利和大量唐代金银器、瓷器、丝织品，是中国迄今发现的最大、等级最高的佛塔地宫。

The underground palace is the subterranean space beneath a pagoda base for burying relics, scriptures, and treasures. The book records Famen Temple's underground palace, excavated in 1987, yielding a Buddha finger relic and大量 Tang gold/silver vessels, porcelain, and textiles—the largest and highest-ranking pagoda underground palace discovered in China.

实例: 扶风法门寺地宫 | 另见: 佛塔 · 舍利 · 塔基

建筑类型 · Building Type

帝陵

Imperial Mausoleum (Diling)

帝陵是古代帝王陵墓，由封土、陵园、寝殿、陪葬墓等组成。书中记载陕西是中国帝陵最集中地区，有黄帝陵、秦始皇陵、西汉十一陵、唐十八陵。秦始皇陵封土高达64米，是中国古代最大的坟丘；唐昭陵、乾陵为因山为陵。

Imperial mausoleums consist of mounds, enclosures, sacrifice halls, and satellite tombs. The book records Shaanxi as China's most concentrated region of imperial mausoleums, including Yellow Emperor, Qin Shi Huang, eleven Western Han, and eighteen Tang mausoleums. Qin Shi Huang's mound reaches 64m—the largest ancient Chinese tumulus; Tang Zhao and Qian Mausoleums are mountain-carved.

实例: 秦始皇陵、汉茂陵、唐昭陵、唐乾陵 | 另见: 因山为陵 · 封土 · 陵园

因山为陵

Mountain-Carved Mausoleum (Yinshan Weiling)

因山为陵是唐代帝陵主要形制，将墓室开凿在自然山体中，以山为封土。书中记载唐昭陵（唐太宗）是第一座因山为陵的帝陵，位于礼泉九嵕山；唐乾陵（唐高宗与武则天合葬）位于乾县梁山，是唐十八陵中保存最完整的一座，陵园有石狮、石人、述圣纪碑、无字碑等。

Mountain-carved mausoleums are the main Tang imperial form, with chambers excavated into natural mountains. The book records Zhao Mausoleum (Emperor Taizong) as the first, at Jiuzong Mountain in Liquan; Qian Mausoleum (joint burial of Gaozong and Wu Zetian) at Liang Mountain in Qian County—the best-preserved of eighteen Tang mausoleums, with stone lions, figures, and steles.

实例: 唐昭陵、唐乾陵、唐泰陵 | 另见: 帝陵 · 封土 · 陵园

清真寺

Mosque (Qingzhensi)

清真寺是伊斯兰教宗教建筑。书中记载西安化觉巷清真寺始建于唐天宝元年（742年），是中国四大清真寺之一，采用中国传统建筑形式，有照壁、牌楼、礼拜殿、省心楼、沐浴室等；大学习巷清真寺（西大寺）坐西朝东，二进院落，礼拜殿可容500多人同时礼拜。

Mosques are Islamic religious buildings. The book records Xi'an Huajue Lane Mosque, founded in 742 CE (Tang Tianbao 1), one of China's four great mosques, using traditional Chinese forms with screen walls, archways, prayer halls, minarets, and ablution rooms. Daxuexi Lane Mosque faces east with two courtyards, its prayer hall holding over 500 worshippers.

实例: 西安化觉巷清真寺、大学习巷清真寺、西乡鹿龄寺 | 另见: 礼拜殿 · 省心楼 · 照壁

文庙

Confucian Temple (Wenmiao)

文庙是祭祀孔子的祠庙。书中记载韩城文庙始建于明洪武四年（1371年），是文庙现存年代较早的建筑，有棂星门、泮池、大成殿、明伦堂、尊经阁等；西安府文庙（今碑林博物馆）始建于北宋，是陕西最早的文庙。

Confucian temples are shrines for sacrificing to Confucius. The book records Hancheng Confucian Temple, founded in 1371 CE (Ming Hongwu 4), one of the earliest surviving, with lattice star gate, pan pond, Dacheng Hall, Minglun Hall, and scripture tower. Xi'an Fu Confucian Temple (now Beilin Museum) was founded in the Northern Song, Shaanxi's earliest.

实例: 韩城文庙、西安府文庙、咸阳文庙 | 另见: 棂星门 · 大成殿 · 泮池

城隍庙

City God Temple (Chenghuangmiao)

城隍庙是祭祀城隍神的祠庙。书中记载三原城隍庙始建于明洪武八年（1375年），中轴线从南到北依次布置照壁、牌坊门、山门、木牌坊、石牌坊、戏楼、拜殿、寝殿，是陕西保存最完整的明代城隍庙建筑群；西安都城隍庙为府级城隍庙。

City God temples sacrifice to the City God. The book records Sanyuan City God Temple, founded in 1375 CE (Ming Hongwu 8), with a central axis from south to north: screen wall, archway gate, mountain gate, wooden archway, stone archway, theater stage, worship hall, and bedroom hall—the best-preserved Ming City God temple complex in Shaanxi.

实例: 三原城隍庙、西安都城隍庙、韩城城隍庙 | 另见: 戏楼 · 拜殿 · 牌坊

会馆

Guild Hall (Huiguan)

会馆是明清同乡或同业在异地建立的聚会场所。书中记载丹凤船帮会馆（明王宫）戏楼最为著名，入口为砖砌三间五楼式牌坊门，额刻'明王宫'，乐楼为戏台，高15米，两侧有楼可供戏班换装；山阳骡帮会馆有北方雄伟粗犷和南方俊丽清秀的建筑风格。

Guild halls were gathering places for same-hometown or same-trade people in the Ming-Qing. The book records Danfeng Boatmen's Guild Hall (Mingwang Palace) with its famous theater stage: entrance is a brick three-bay five-story archway gate inscribed 'Mingwang Palace,' the performance tower is 15m tall with side towers for costume changes. Shanyang Mule-Team Guild Hall blends northern grandeur and southern delicacy.

实例: 丹凤船帮会馆、山阳骡帮会馆、紫阳北五省会馆 | 另见: 戏楼 · 牌坊 · 砖雕

书院

Academy (Shuyuan)

书院是中国古代教育机构。书中记载关中书院始建于明万历三十七年（1609年），是明清陕西最高学府，为西北四大书院之首，总体布局严格遵循儒家礼制思想，采用中轴对称模式，中轴线上有五重院落；眉县横渠书院为纪念张载而建。

Academies were ancient Chinese educational institutions. The book records Guanzhong Academy, founded in 1609 CE (Ming Wanli 37), the highest institution of Ming-Qing Shaanxi and head of the four northwestern academies. Its layout strictly follows Confucian ritual with central axis symmetry and five courtyard layers. Meixian Hengqu Academy was built to commemorate Zhang Zai.

实例: 关中书院、眉县横渠书院 | 另见: 考院 · 大成殿 · 泮池

钟鼓楼

Bell and Drum Tower (Zhonggulou)

钟鼓楼是古代城市报时建筑。书中记载西安钟楼始建于明洪武十七年（1384年），通高36米，基座每边长35.5米，是中国现存规模最大、保存最完整的钟楼；西安鼓楼始建于明洪武十三年（1380年），通高33米，是国内现存最大的鼓楼建筑。

Bell and drum towers were ancient city timekeeping buildings. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower, founded in 1384 CE (Ming Hongwu 17), 36m total height with 35.5m square base—the largest and best-preserved surviving bell tower in China. Xi'an Drum Tower, founded in 1380 CE, 33m tall—the largest surviving drum tower in China.

实例: 西安钟楼、西安鼓楼、城固钟楼 | 另见: 古城墙 · 攒尖顶 · 歇山顶

古城墙

Ancient City Wall (Guchengqiang)

古城墙是古代城市防御建筑。书中记载西安古城墙始建于明洪武三年（1370年），在唐长安城皇城基础上扩建，周长13.74公里，墙高12米，底宽18米，顶宽15米，是中国现存最完整的古代州府级城墙；府谷府州城山河襟带，平面呈曲尺形，周长2320米。

Ancient city walls are defensive structures. The book records Xi'an Ancient City Wall, founded in 1370 CE (Ming Hongwu 3), expanded on the Tang Chang'an imperial city, 13.74km circumference, 12m tall, 18m base width, 15m top width—the most complete surviving ancient prefectural-level city wall in China. Fugu Fuzhou City follows rivers and mountains with a carpenter's-square plan, 2320m circumference.

实例: 西安古城墙、府谷府州城、吴堡石城 | 另见: 瓮城 · 马面 · 垛口

瓮城

Barbican Entrance (Wengcheng)

瓮城是城门外的护门小城，敌人攻入后可关闭城门形成'瓮中捉鳖'。书中记载西安古城墙四座城门外均有瓮城，四城门楼内左侧各有一处登城'马道'，沿城墙设6处登城马道，是中国古代城防建筑的杰作。

A barbican entrance is a protective small city outside a gate; after enemies enter, gates can be closed to 'catch turtles in a jar.' The book records all four gates of Xi'an Ancient City Wall have barbican entrances, with 'horse ramps' for climbing inside each gate tower and six ramps along the wall—masterpieces of ancient Chinese city defense.

实例: 西安古城墙永宁门瓮城 | 另见: 古城墙 · 马面 · 城门楼

佛塔

Buddhist Pagoda (Fota)

佛塔是佛教建筑重要类型，源于印度窣堵坡。书中记载陕西佛塔数量众多，有楼阁式、密檐式、覆钵式等，大雁塔、小雁塔是唐代佛塔代表；泾阳崇文宝塔高87米，是中国现存最高的砖塔；法门寺塔因地宫出土佛指舍利而闻名。

Buddhist pagodas are important Buddhist architecture derived from Indian stupas. The book records Shaanxi's numerous pagodas in tower-style, multi-eaved, and stupa forms. The Great and Small Wild Goose Pagodas are Tang representatives; Jingyang Chongwen Pagoda at 87m is China's tallest surviving brick pagoda; Famen Temple Pagoda is famous for the Buddha finger relic from its underground palace.

实例: 大雁塔、小雁塔、泾阳崇文宝塔、法门寺塔 | 另见: 楼阁式塔 · 密檐式塔 · 塔刹

石窟

Grotto (Shiku)

石窟是在山崖壁面开凿的佛教建筑。书中记载陕西石窟以晚期石窟为主，共发现北魏至明清石窟350余处，彬县大佛寺石窟最为重要，始凿于唐贞观二年（628年），大佛高20米；此外有慈善寺石窟、富县石泓寺石窟、米脂万佛洞等。

Grottoes are Buddhist buildings excavated into cliff faces. The book records Shaanxi grottoes as mainly late-period, with over 350 sites from Northern Wei to Ming-Qing. Bin County Great Buddha Temple Grottoes are most important, first carved in 628 CE with a 20m Great Buddha; others include Cishansi, Shihongsi in Fu County, and Wanfo Cave in Mizhi.

实例: 彬县大佛寺石窟、慈善寺石窟、富县石泓寺石窟 | 另见: 摩崖造像 · 佛塔 · 佛教建筑

建筑装饰 · Decoration

砖雕

Brick Carving (Zhuandiao)

砖雕是在青砖上雕刻图案的装饰艺术。书中记载旬邑唐家宅院砖雕精美，有'凤凰牡丹'、'海水朝阳'等图案；丹凤船帮会馆戏楼砖雕精美；韩城党家村门楼、照壁砖雕是关中民居砖雕的代表，内容包括人物故事、花鸟瑞兽。

Brick carving is decorative art on blue bricks. The book records Xunyi Tang Family Residence with exquisite brick carvings including 'phoenix and peony' and 'sea and sunrise'; Danfeng Boatmen's Guild Hall theater stage has fine brick carving; Hancheng Dangjia Village gate towers and screen walls represent Guanzhong residential brick carving with figure stories, flowers, birds, and auspicious animals.

实例: 旬邑唐家宅院、丹凤船帮会馆、韩城党家村 | 另见: 木雕 · 石雕 · 照壁

木雕

Wood Carving (Mudiao)

木雕是在木材上雕刻图案的装饰艺术。书中记载西安化觉巷清真寺木雕精美，采用浮雕、透雕技法；山阳骡帮会馆戏楼'梁柱、门窗雕工精致，主题涉及高山河谷、野渡江帆、亭台楼阁、车马仪仗、鸟兽虫鱼、树木花草，尤以人物雕刻而闻名，因此当地人们称之为花戏楼'。

Wood carving is decorative art on wood. The book records Xi'an Huajue Lane Mosque with exquisite relief and openwork wood carving; Shanyang Mule-Team Guild Hall theater stage has 'exquisitely carved beams, columns, doors, and windows with themes of mountains, rivers, boats, pavilions, processions, birds, beasts, and flowers—especially famous for figure carving, hence locally called the Flower Theater.'

实例: 西安化觉巷清真寺、山阳骡帮会馆戏楼 | 另见: 砖雕 · 石雕 · 雀替

石雕

Stone Carving (Shidiao)

石雕是在石材上雕刻图案的装饰艺术。书中记载唐乾陵石狮、石人、述圣纪碑、无字碑是唐代石雕艺术的巅峰；韩城司马迁祠、勉县武侯祠的碑刻和石狮最为著名；旬邑唐家宅院柱础石雕有'凤凰牡丹'等精美图案。

Stone carving is decorative art on stone. The book records Tang Qian Mausoleum's stone lions, figures, and steles as the peak of Tang stone carving; Hancheng Sima Qian Shrine and Mianxian Wuhou Shrine are famous for steles and stone lions; Xunyi Tang Family Residence column bases have exquisite 'phoenix and peony' stone carvings.

实例: 唐乾陵石刻、韩城司马迁祠、旬邑唐家宅院 | 另见: 砖雕 · 木雕 · 柱础

琉璃瓦

Glazed Tile (Liuliwa)

琉璃瓦是表面施釉的陶瓦，有黄、绿、蓝等颜色，是高级屋面材料。书中记载西安钟楼'屋面为琉璃瓦，置鎏金宝瓶刹'；三原城隍庙寝殿'屋顶布琉璃筒瓦'；韩城城隍庙广荐殿'布琉璃筒瓦，脊吻，次间脊上增饰楼阁'。

Glazed tiles are glazed ceramic tiles in yellow, green, and blue, premium roofing material. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower's 'glazed tile roof with gilded bottle finial'; Sanyuan City God Temple bedroom hall's 'roof covered with glazed tubular tiles'; Hancheng City God Temple's Guangjian Hall 'glazed tubular tiles with ridge ornaments and added pavilions on secondary ridges.'

实例: 西安钟楼、三原城隍庙、韩城城隍庙 | 另见: 筒瓦 · 板瓦 · 正吻

彩画

Painted Decoration (Caihua)

彩画是古建筑木构件表面的绘画装饰。书中记载西安东岳庙大殿东西两壁、后壁棋盘门两侧之上满布大幅彩色道教壁画，面积达158平方米，绘制于清康熙五十四年（1715年），是陕西境内现存宫观壁画中单体面积最大的，内容主要为山水、楼阁、人物、花卉。

Painted decorations are painted ornaments on wooden components. The book records Xi'an Dongyue Temple's main hall with large Taoist murals on east/west walls and above the back paneled doors, totaling 158 sq m, painted in 1715 CE (Qing Kangxi 54)—the largest single-area surviving temple mural in Shaanxi, mainly depicting landscapes, pavilions, figures, and flowers.

实例: 西安东岳庙大殿壁画 | 另见: 和玺彩画 · 旋子彩画 · 藻井

照壁

Screen Wall (Zhaobi)

照壁是大门内或外的屏蔽建筑。书中记载大学习巷清真寺大照壁在寺东侧，砖砌高10米，长15米，照壁中心有三大幅圆形砖雕图案，上部有著名的'四马砖雕'；三原城隍庙中轴线最南端为照壁，水磨青砖砌筑。

Screen walls are shielding buildings inside or outside gates. The book records Daxuexi Lane Mosque's large screen wall on the east side, 10m tall and 15m long brick wall with three large circular brick-carved patterns and famous 'four-horse brick carving' on top; Sanyuan City God Temple's southernmost axis point is a screen wall of polished blue brick.

实例: 大学习巷清真寺照壁、三原城隍庙照壁 | 另见: 砖雕 · 门楼 · 四合院

雀替

Spandrel (Queti)

雀替是梁枋与柱交接处的装饰构件。书中记载勉县武侯墓山门'前檐梁下皆施有牛腿装饰，柱间施花板，枋上施如意斗拱'；西安化觉巷清真寺雀替雕刻精美，是清真寺建筑装饰的重要组成部分。

Spandrels are decorative components at beam-column junctions. The book records Mianxian Wuhou Tomb's mountain gate with 'bracket-like decorations under front eaves, patterned panels between columns, and ruyi dougong on tie beams'; Xi'an Huajue Lane Mosque has exquisite spandrel carvings, an important part of mosque decoration.

实例: 勉县武侯墓山门、西安化觉巷清真寺 | 另见: 木雕 · 梁枋 · 斗拱

藻井

Caisson Ceiling (Zaojing)

藻井是古建筑天花板上的凹入装饰。书中记载三原城隍庙大殿'殿内设有平棊天花，直接安放在檐檩之上，绘制有花鸟等图案'；西安东岳庙大殿保留有精美的明代彩画和藻井，是陕西古建筑彩画艺术的重要实例。

Caisson ceilings are sunken ceiling decorations. The book records Sanyuan City God Temple's main hall with 'flat coffered ceiling placed directly on eaves purlins, painted with flowers and birds'; Xi'an Dongyue Temple main hall preserves exquisite Ming painted decorations and caisson ceilings, an important example of Shaanxi architectural painting art.

实例: 三原城隍庙大殿、西安东岳庙 | 另见: 彩画 · 斗拱 · 殿堂

正吻

Main Ridge Ornament (Zhengwen)

正吻是正脊两端的装饰构件，多为龙形或兽形。书中记载韩城城隍庙广荐殿'布琉璃筒瓦，脊吻，次间脊上增饰楼阁'；三原城隍庙戏楼'屋顶为庑殿顶，戏台内中顶装八边八层藻井'，正吻是古建筑等级的重要标志。

Main ridge ornaments are decorative components at both ends of the main ridge, mostly dragon or beast forms. The book records Hancheng City God Temple's Guangjian Hall with 'glazed tubular tiles, ridge ornaments, and added pavilions on secondary ridges'; Sanyuan City God Temple's theater stage has a 'hip roof with octagonal eight-layer caisson at the interior top'—ridge ornaments are important rank indicators.

实例: 韩城城隍庙、三原城隍庙 | 另见: 正脊 · 垂兽 · 走兽

柱础

Column Base (Zhuchu)

柱础是柱下的石质基座，起防潮、承重和装饰作用。书中记载西安东岳庙大殿'前檐8根柱子柱础刻有精美的二龙戏珠浮雕图案，其他柱石皆雕花卉'；旬邑唐家宅院柱础石雕精美，是关中民居建筑装饰的代表。

Column bases are stone pedestals under columns for moisture protection, load bearing, and decoration. The book records Xi'an Dongyue Temple main hall's '8 front-eave column bases carved with exquisite 'two dragons playing with pearl' relief, other column stones carved with flowers'; Xunyi Tang Family Residence column bases are fine examples of Guanzhong residential decoration.

实例: 西安东岳庙大殿、旬邑唐家宅院 | 另见: 石雕 · 台基 · 柱子

建筑材料 · Materials

青砖

Blue Brick (Qingzhuan)

青砖是古建筑主要墙体材料。书中记载西安古城墙'明隆庆二年（1568年）对城墙外壁包砌青砖'，墙内夯土，外墙砌以砖石，上设垛堞；府谷府州城'城墙内夯黄土，外以石砌'；陕北锢窑用石块旋垒砌而成。

Blue bricks are the main wall material. The book records Xi'an Ancient City Wall's 'outer wall faced with blue brick in 1568 CE (Ming Longqing 2),' with rammed earth inside and brick/stone outside with battlements; Fugu Fuzhou City's 'walls rammed with yellow loess inside, stone outside'; northern Shaanxi stone caves built with stone vaulting.

实例: 西安古城墙、府谷府州城、陕北锢窑 | 另见: 小青瓦 · 石材 · 夯土

小青瓦

Small Gray Tile (Xiaoqingwa)

小青瓦是古建筑传统屋面材料。书中记载韩城党家村民居屋面多为小灰瓦，硬山式建筑；勉县武侯墓山门'屋面筒瓦，镂雕行龙纹脊'；西乡鹿龄寺'屋顶覆盖灰色筒瓦，屋脊设有精美砖雕，中央设圆形塔式脊刹'。

Small gray tiles are traditional roofing material. The book records Hancheng Dangjia Village residences mostly using small gray tiles with gable roofs; Mianxian Wuhou Tomb mountain gate has 'tubular tiles with openwork dragon-pattern ridge'; Xixiang Luling Temple's 'roof covered with gray tubular tiles, exquisite brick-carved ridge with central circular pagoda-style ridge finial.'

实例: 韩城党家村、西乡鹿龄寺 | 另见: 青砖 · 琉璃瓦 · 筒瓦

黄土

Loess (Huangtu)

黄土是西北黄土高原主要土壤，有直立性，适合挖掘窑洞。书中记载陕西是中国黄土分布最广的省份之一，陕北和关中窑洞民居利用黄土直立性建造；秦咸阳城'城墙基宽约5.5-7.6米，最厚4.6米'，为夯土筑成；秦始皇陵封土为夯土筑成，高达64米。

Loess is the main soil of the northwest Loess Plateau with vertical stability, suitable for cave excavation. The book records Shaanxi as one of China's provinces with widest loess distribution; northern and central Shaanxi cave dwellings use loess vertical stability; Qin Xianyang City walls '5.5-7.6m base width, 4.6m thickest' of rammed earth; Qin Shi Huang's mound is rammed earth, 64m tall.

实例: 陕北窑洞、秦咸阳城、秦始皇陵封土 | 另见: 窑洞 · 地坑院 · 夯土

石材

Stone (Shicai)

石材是古建筑重要材料，用于台基、柱础、栏杆、碑碣、造像等。书中记载唐乾陵石狮、石人是唐代石雕巅峰；彬县大佛寺石窟大佛高20米，为石刻造像；府谷府州城'城墙内夯黄土，外以石砌'；吴堡石城全部用石头砌筑。

Stone is an important building material for platforms, column bases, railings, steles, and statues. The book records Tang Qian Mausoleum stone lions and figures as the peak of Tang stone carving; Bin County Great Buddha Temple's 20m Great Buddha is stone carving; Fugu Fuzhou City walls 'rammed loess inside, stone outside'; Wubao Stone City is entirely built of stone.

实例: 唐乾陵石刻、彬县大佛寺、吴堡石城 | 另见: 石雕 · 柱础 · 台基

木材

Timber (Mucai)

木材是古建筑主要结构材料。书中记载西安钟楼'二层结构用通柱，攒尖顶构架采用抹角梁和井口枋'；榆林万佛楼'基座上建有二层木结构楼阁，14根廊柱环宇'；三原城隍庙大殿'梁架为彻上明造，抬梁式构架，五架梁上用瓜柱、角背'。

Timber is the main structural material. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower's 'second story using continuous columns, pyramidal frame using mitered beams and well-frame tie beams'; Yulin Wanfo Tower's 'two-story wooden pavilion on base with 14 surrounding columns'; Sanyuan City God Temple main hall's 'exposed beam-lifting frame with five-rafter beams using瓜柱 and角背.'

实例: 西安钟楼、榆林万佛楼、三原城隍庙 | 另见: 抬梁式 · 斗拱 · 彻上明造

文化背景 · Cultural Context

周秦汉唐

Zhou-Qin-Han-Tang Culture

陕西是周、秦、汉、唐四个强盛王朝建都之地，13个王朝在此建都，历时1100多年。书中前言记载'从公元前11世纪开始，陕西就是当时中国社会、文化发展的核心区域'，西周的都城丰镐、秦都咸阳、西汉长安、隋唐长安都是当时中国政治、经济、文化的中心。

Shaanxi was the capital of four powerful dynasties—Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang—with 13 dynasties establishing capitals here over 1,100 years. The book's preface records 'from the 11th century BCE, Shaanxi was the core region of Chinese social and cultural development,' with Western Zhou Fenghao, Qin Xianyang, Western Han Chang'an, and Sui-Tang Chang'an all serving as political, economic, and cultural centers.

实例: 丰镐遗址、秦咸阳城、汉长安城、唐长安城 | 另见: 帝陵 · 古城墙 · 丝绸之路

丝绸之路

Silk Road

丝绸之路起点为长安（今西安）。书中记载唐代长安是当时世界贸易的中心和'丝绸之路'的出发地，佛教沿丝绸之路传入中国，大慈恩寺是玄奘翻译佛经的场所，大雁塔为存放玄奘取回的佛经而建。2014年丝绸之路'长安-天山廊道'被列入世界文化遗产。

The Silk Road started from Chang'an (today's Xi'an). The book records Tang Chang'an as the world trade center and departure point of the Silk Road; Buddhism entered China along it; Dacien Temple was where Xuanzang translated scriptures, and the Great Wild Goose Pagoda was built to store them. In 2014, the Silk Road 'Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor' was listed as UNESCO World Heritage.

实例: 大雁塔、大慈恩寺、兴教寺 | 另见: 佛教建筑 · 佛塔 · 石窟

佛教文化

Buddhist Culture

佛教自汉代沿丝绸之路传入中国，陕西是佛教中国化的重要地区。书中记载唐代长安是全国佛教中心，有大慈恩寺、大兴善寺、荐福寺、香积寺等著名寺院，玄奘在大慈恩寺翻译佛经；陕西现存佛教寺塔280余座，其中著名的有唐代风格大雁塔、小雁塔。

Buddhism entered China along the Silk Road from the Han, and Shaanxi was an important region for its sinicization. The book records Tang Chang'an as the national Buddhist center with Dacien, Daxingshan, Jianfu, and Xiangji Temples; Xuanzang translated scriptures at Dacien Temple. Shaanxi preserves over 280 Buddhist pagodas, including the famous Tang-style Great and Small Wild Goose Pagodas.

实例: 大慈恩寺、大雁塔、大兴善寺、法门寺 | 另见: 佛塔 · 石窟 · 摩崖造像

道教文化

Taoist Culture

道教是中国本土宗教，陕西是道教重要发源地。书中记载周至楼观台是道教最早的宫观之一，相传老子在此讲经；西安八仙庵、华阴玉泉院、佳县白云观、宝鸡金台观等都是著名道教建筑。金台观始建于元朝末年，因明代道士张三丰在此修道而闻名。

Taoism is China's indigenous religion, and Shaanxi is an important birthplace. The book records Zhouzhi Louguan Terrace as one of the earliest Taoist palaces, where Laozi is said to have lectured; Xi'an Baxian Temple, Huayin Yuquan Courtyard, Jiaxian Baiyun Temple, and Baoji Jintai Temple are famous Taoist buildings. Jintai Temple was founded in the late Yuan, famous for Ming Taoist Zhang Sanfeng's cultivation here.

实例: 周至楼观台、西安八仙庵、宝鸡金台观 | 另见: 道教宫观 · 佛教建筑 · 祠庙

伊斯兰文化

Islamic Culture

伊斯兰教自唐代沿丝绸之路传入中国，陕西是伊斯兰教传播的重要地区。书中记载西安化觉巷清真寺是中国四大清真寺之一，始建于唐天宝元年（742年）；大学习巷清真寺在唐中宗时已赐名'清教寺'，唐玄宗朝复改唐明寺，元中统年间又赐名回回万善寺。

Islam entered China along the Silk Road from the Tang, and Shaanxi was an important region for its spread. The book records Xi'an Huajue Lane Mosque as one of China's four great mosques, founded in 742 CE (Tang Tianbao 1); Daxuexi Lane Mosque was already named 'Qingjiao Temple' in Emperor Zhongzong's reign, renamed Tangming Temple in Xuanzong's reign, and Huihui Wanshan Temple in the Yuan Zhongtong era.

实例: 西安化觉巷清真寺、大学习巷清真寺 | 另见: 清真寺 · 礼拜殿 · 丝绸之路

儒家文化

Confucian Culture

儒家文化是中国传统文化核心，陕西文庙和书院是其重要载体。书中记载西安府文庙（今碑林博物馆）始建于北宋，是陕西最早的文庙；韩城文庙始建于明洪武四年（1371年），是文庙现存年代较早的建筑；关中书院是明清陕西最高学府，为西北四大书院之首。

Confucian culture is the core of traditional Chinese culture, and Shaanxi Confucian temples and academies are its important carriers. The book records Xi'an Fu Confucian Temple (now Beilin Museum) founded in the Northern Song, Shaanxi's earliest; Hancheng Confucian Temple founded in 1371 CE, one of the earliest surviving; Guanzhong Academy was the highest Ming-Qing Shaanxi institution and head of the four northwestern academies.

实例: 西安府文庙、韩城文庙、关中书院 | 另见: 文庙 · 书院 · 大成殿

世界文化遗产

World Cultural Heritage

陕西有多处世界文化遗产。书中涉及的秦始皇陵及兵马俑坑于1987年列入；丝绸之路'长安-天山廊道'于2014年列入，含大雁塔、小雁塔、兴教寺塔、大明宫遗址等。这些遗产是陕西古建筑的精华，也是全人类共同的文化财富。

Shaanxi has multiple UNESCO World Heritage sites. The book covers Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum and Terracotta Army (listed 1987); the Silk Road 'Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor' (listed 2014), including Great Wild Goose Pagoda, Small Wild Goose Pagoda, Xingjiao Temple Pagoda, and Daming Palace ruins. These are the essence of Shaanxi ancient architecture and shared cultural wealth of all humanity.

实例: 秦始皇陵、大雁塔、小雁塔、兴教寺塔 | 另见: 帝陵 · 佛塔 · 丝绸之路

黄土高原

Loess Plateau

黄土高原横跨陕西、山西、甘肃等省，是中华文明发源地之一。书中记载陕北和关中位于黄土高原，独特的黄土地貌孕育了窑洞、地坑院等独特民居形式；陕北建筑以窑洞、古城、古寨为特色，榆林卫城、吴堡石城、高家堡古城是陕北古城的代表。

The Loess Plateau spans Shaanxi, Shanxi, and Gansu, one of the birthplaces of Chinese civilization. The book records northern and central Shaanxi on the Loess Plateau, whose unique landforms nurtured cave dwellings and sunken courtyards; northern Shaanxi architecture features caves, ancient cities, and fortresses, with Yulin Garrison City, Wubao Stone City, and Gaojiabao as representatives.

实例: 陕北窑洞、榆林卫城、米脂姜氏庄园 | 另见: 窑洞 · 地坑院 · 黄土

关中平原

Guanzhong Plain

关中平原位于陕西中部，是渭河冲积平原，有'八百里秦川'之称。书中记载关中是周秦汉唐建都之地，西安、咸阳等城市保留大量古建筑；关中民居以四合院、砖木结构为特色，韩城党家村是关中民居的代表，有'民居瑰宝'之誉。

The Guanzhong Plain in central Shaanxi is a Wei River alluvial plain known as '800 li of Qinchuan.' The book records Guanzhong as the capital region of Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang, with Xi'an and Xianyang preserving大量 ancient buildings; Guanzhong residences feature courtyard houses and brick-wood structures, with Hancheng Dangjia Village as a representative known as 'residential treasure.'

实例: 西安古城、韩城党家村、三原城隍庙 | 另见: 四合院 · 砖木结构 · 周秦汉唐

陕北高原

Northern Shaanxi Plateau

陕北高原是黄土高原核心区域，包括榆林、延安等地。书中记载陕北建筑以窑洞、古城、古寨为特色，榆林卫城为明长城九边重镇之一，吴堡石城全部用石头砌筑，米脂姜氏庄园是陕北民居的精华，杨家沟扶风古寨有新院和马宅，融合了中西建筑风格。

The Northern Shaanxi Plateau is the core of the Loess Plateau, including Yulin and Yan'an. The book records northern Shaanxi architecture featuring caves, ancient cities, and fortresses; Yulin Garrison City was one of the nine strategic towns of the Ming Great Wall; Wubuo Stone City is entirely stone-built; Mizhi Jiang's Manor is the essence of northern Shaanxi residences; Yangjiagou Fufeng Ancient Fortress has new and horse courtyards blending Chinese and Western styles.

实例: 榆林卫城、吴堡石城、米脂姜氏庄园 | 另见: 窑洞 · 古城墙 · 黄土高原

陕南地区

Southern Shaanxi Region

陕南地区包括汉中、安康、商洛，北依秦岭，南靠大巴山，气候湿润，建筑风格融合关中、巴蜀和荆楚文化。书中记载陕南古建筑以会馆、书院、古镇为特色，宁强青木川古镇回龙场老街是陕甘川三省交界最繁荣的商业文化交流场所，丹凤船帮会馆、紫阳北五省会馆是陕南会馆的代表。

Southern Shaanxi includes Hanzhong, Ankang, and Shangluo, with Qinling to the north and Daba Mountains to the south, humid climate, blending Guanzhong, Ba-Shu, and Jing-Chu cultures. The book records southern Shaanxi architecture featuring guild halls, academies, and ancient towns; Ningqiang Qingmuchuan's Huilong Old Street was the most prosperous commercial and cultural exchange hub at the Shaanxi-Gansu-Sichuan border; Danfeng Boatmen's and Ziyang Five Northern Provinces Guild Halls are representatives.

实例: 宁强青木川古镇、丹凤船帮会馆、紫阳北五省会馆 | 另见: 会馆 · 古镇 · 四合院
