ENCYCLOPAEDIA BRITANNICA STYLE 陕西古建筑 | Ancient Architecture of Shaanxi

陕西古建筑术语百科

Encyclopedia of Ancient Architecture of Shaanxi

本百科收录《陕西古建筑》一书中的90个核心专业术语，涵盖建筑类型、构件、形制、工艺、文化等34个分类。每条术语均附中英文释义。

楼阁式塔

Multi-story Pagoda (Ge-style) 佛塔类型

中国古塔主要类型之一，模仿中国传统楼阁建筑形式，每层间距较大，设有门窗、平座、栏杆，可登临眺望。代表：西安大雁塔、兴教寺玄奘塔。

One of the main types of Chinese ancient pagodas, imitating traditional Chinese multi-story architecture, with large spacing between stories, doors and windows, flat seats, and railings, allowing climbing and viewing. Representatives: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, Xuanzang Pagoda at Xingjiao Temple.

密檐式塔

Multi-eave Pagoda (Miyan-style) 佛塔类型

中国古塔主要类型之一，第一层高大，以上各层高度骤减，塔檐紧密重叠，多为实心，不可登临。代表：西安小雁塔、富县柏山寺塔。

One of the main types of Chinese ancient pagodas, with a tall first story and rapidly decreasing heights above, with tightly overlapping eaves, mostly solid and not climbable. Representatives: Small Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an, Baishan Temple Pagoda in Fuxian County.

喇嘛式塔

Lama-style Pagoda 佛塔类型

藏传佛教佛塔形式，特征为高大的须弥座、覆钵式塔身、粗壮的十三相轮、华盖、塔刹。陕西现存喇嘛式塔多为明代所修。

Tibetan Buddhist pagoda form, characterized by a tall xumizuo (Sumeru pedestal), overturned-bowl pagoda body, sturdy thirteen-phase wheels, canopy, and pagoda finial. Most existing Lama-style pagodas in Shaanxi were built in the Ming dynasty.

经幢式塔

Jingchuang-style Pagoda (Pillar-style) 佛塔类型

模仿佛教经幢形式的佛塔，多为须弥座、单层六边形塔身、八边形宝盖式塔顶。主要分布于陕北和陕南。

Buddhist pagodas imitating Buddhist jingchuang (pillar) forms, mostly with xumizuo, single-story hexagonal pagoda body, and octagonal baogai (treasure canopy) style pagoda top. Mainly distributed in northern and southern Shaanxi.

造像塔

Statue Pagoda 佛塔类型

塔身布满佛教造像的佛塔，陕西造像塔以明代为主，现存最早的造像塔是耀州区药王山上的三座北魏小型造像塔。

Buddhist pagodas whose bodies are covered with Buddhist statues. Shaanxi statue pagodas are mainly from the Ming dynasty; the earliest existing statue pagodas are three small Northern Wei statue pagodas on Medicine King Mountain in Yaozhou District.

覆斗形封土

Inverted-bowl-shaped Mound 陵墓形制

中国古代帝陵封土形式之一，平面呈方形，顶部收分，形似倒置的斗。陕西西汉帝陵多为此种形式。

One of the mound forms of ancient Chinese imperial mausoleums, with a square plane and收分 top, shaped like an inverted dou (measuring vessel). Most Western Han imperial mausoleums in Shaanxi adopt this form.

因山为陵

Mountain-based Mausoleum 陵墓形制

以自然山体作为陵体，于山南开凿墓室，不另起封土。唐太宗昭陵首创此制，唐代帝陵多采用。

Using the natural mountain body as the mausoleum, carving the tomb chamber on the southern slope without raising a separate mound. Emperor Taizong's Zhaoling pioneered this system, and most Tang imperial mausoleums adopted it.

黄肠题凑

Huangchang Ticou (Yellow Cypress Frame) 陵墓葬具

中国古代最高等级的葬具，用柏木枋堆垒成框形结构。秦公1号大墓出土的是我国古代最早的一套黄肠题凑葬具。

The highest-grade burial equipment in ancient China, using cypress wood timbers stacked into a frame structure. The one unearthed from Qin Duke Tomb No. 1 is the earliest set of huangchang ticou burial equipment in ancient China.

三出阙

Triple Gate Tower (San Chu Que) 建筑构件

中国古代最高等级的阙制，由大小依次递减的三个长方形组成，为帝王专用。汉景帝阳陵南阙门遗址为三出阙。

The highest-grade gate tower system in ancient China, composed of three rectangles decreasing in size sequentially, exclusively for emperors. The south gate tower site of Emperor Jing's Yangling is a triple gate tower.

叠涩出檐

Corbelled Eaves 建筑构件

用砖或石逐层向外挑出形成屋檐的做法，是砖塔最常见的出檐方式。陕西唐塔多采用叠涩出檐。

The practice of using bricks or stones to project outward layer by layer to form eaves, the most common eave method for brick pagodas. Most Tang pagodas in Shaanxi use corbelled eaves.

菱角牙子

Diamond-shaped Tooth Bricks 建筑构件

叠涩出檐中使用的一种装饰性砖层，砖的一端被砍成斜面，层层叠出，形似菱角，增强檐口线。

A decorative brick layer used in corbelled eaves, with one end of the brick cut into a bevel, stacked layer by layer, shaped like a water chestnut (菱角), strengthening the eave line.

须弥座

Xumizuo (Sumeru Pedestal) 建筑构件

源自佛教须弥山的台基形式，由上下枋、束腰、莲瓣等组成，常用于佛塔、佛像、建筑台基。

A pedestal form derived from Buddhist Mount Sumeru, composed of upper and lower architraves, a waist, and lotus petals, commonly used for pagodas, Buddha statues, and building pedestals.

斗栱

Dougong (Bracket Set) 建筑构件

中国古建筑特有的承重构件，由斗、栱、昂、枋等组成，位于柱梁之间，传递荷载并装饰建筑。

A unique load-bearing component of ancient Chinese architecture, composed of dou (cap blocks), gong (arms), ang (levers), and fang (beams), located between columns and beams, transferring loads and decorating the building.

五铺作

Five-puzuo Bracket Set 建筑构件

宋代斗栱等级之一，出两跳，为较高等级的斗栱形制。富县柏山寺塔斗栱为宋式五铺作制式。

One of the Song dynasty bracket set grades, with two jumps, a relatively high-grade bracket set form. The bracket sets of the Baishan Temple Pagoda in Fuxian County are in Song-style five-puzuo format.

偷心造

Touxin-zao (Hidden-heart Construction) 建筑构件

斗栱构造做法之一，跳头上不置横栱，结构简洁。富县柏山寺塔补间铺作采用五铺作偷心造。

One of the bracket set construction methods, with no horizontal gong on the jump head, simple in structure. The inter-column bracket sets of the Baishan Temple Pagoda in Fuxian County use five-puzuo touxin-zao.

计心造

Jixin-zao (Calculated-heart Construction) 建筑构件

斗栱构造做法之一，跳头上置横栱，结构较偷心造复杂，装饰性更强。

One of the bracket set construction methods, with horizontal gong on the jump head, more complex than touxin-zao and more decorative.

永定柱

Yongding Column 建筑构件

从地面直通平座的通柱，用于楼阁式建筑的平座结构。中王堡木塔二、三层出檐由平座永定柱支承。

A through column extending from the ground directly to the flat seat, used in the flat seat structure of multi-story buildings. The eaves of the second and third stories of the Zhongwangbao Wooden Pagoda are supported by flat-seat yongding columns.

抱头梁

Baotou Beam (Head-holding Beam) 建筑构件

一端插入柱中、一端承托檩条的梁，常用于小式建筑。中王堡木塔上层柱脚落在下层柱脚抱头梁上。

A beam with one end inserted into a column and the other end supporting a purlin, commonly used in small-style buildings. The upper-story column feet of the Zhongwangbao Wooden Pagoda rest on the baotou beams of the lower-story column feet.

抹角梁

Mitered Beam (Mojiao Beam) 建筑构件

呈45度斜置的梁，用于攒尖顶建筑的转角处，承托雷公柱。中王堡木塔塔顶构架由数层抹角梁叠架而成。

A beam placed at a 45-degree angle, used at the corners of pyramidal-roof buildings to support the leigong column. The pagoda top framework of the Zhongwangbao Wooden Pagoda is formed by stacking several layers of mitered beams.

雷公柱

Leigong Column 建筑构件

攒尖顶建筑中央的短柱，承托宝顶。中王堡木塔雷公柱落在太平梁上，如亭阁式做法。

A short column in the center of a pyramidal-roof building, supporting the finial. The leigong column of the Zhongwangbao Wooden Pagoda rests on the taiping beam, like a pavilion-style construction.

攒尖顶

Pyramidal Roof (Cuanjian Top) 屋顶形式

中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，屋顶各面交汇于顶部一点，上置宝顶。常用于亭、阁、塔等建筑。

One of the roof forms of ancient Chinese architecture, where all roof surfaces meet at a single point at the top, with a finial placed on it. Commonly used for pavilions, towers, and pagodas.

歇山顶

Hip-and-gable Roof (Xieshan Top) 屋顶形式

中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，由庑殿顶和悬山顶结合而成，有九条脊，等级仅次于庑殿顶。

One of the roof forms of ancient Chinese architecture, combining the hip roof and overhanging gable roof, with nine ridges, ranking second only to the hip roof in grade.

硬山顶

Flush Gable Roof (Yingshan Top) 屋顶形式

中国古建筑屋顶形式之一，两侧山墙与屋面齐平，不伸出，是最低等级的屋顶形式，常用于民居。

One of the roof forms of ancient Chinese architecture, with both gable walls flush with the roof surface, not projecting, the lowest-grade roof form, commonly used for residences.

马头墙

Horse-head Wall (Matou Wall) 建筑构件

高于屋顶的山墙，形似马头，具有防火、防风功能。陕西会馆建筑中常见马头墙。

A gable wall higher than the roof, shaped like a horse's head, with fire-prevention and wind-prevention functions. Horse-head walls are commonly seen in Shaanxi guild hall buildings.

四水归堂

Four Waters Returning to the Hall 建筑布局

南方民居天井式布局，四面屋顶的雨水都汇入天井，寓意聚财。山阳骡帮会馆各院落皆设天井，属典型南方四水归明堂式。

A southern Chinese residence skylight (tianjing) layout, where rainwater from all four roof surfaces flows into the skylight, symbolizing wealth accumulation. Each courtyard of the Shanyang Mule-Team Guild Hall has a skylight, belonging to the typical southern 'four waters returning to the bright hall' style.

天井

Tianjing (Skylight Courtyard) 建筑布局

建筑内部露天的小庭院，用于采光、通风、排水。陕南会馆、民居中常见天井。

A small open-air courtyard inside a building, used for lighting, ventilation, and drainage. Tianjing are commonly seen in southern Shaanxi guild halls and residences.

窑洞

Cave Dwelling (Yaodong) 民居类型

黄土高原地区特有的民居形式，在黄土崖壁上开挖拱形洞穴，冬暖夏凉。陕北是窑洞分布最集中的地区。

A unique residential form in the Loess Plateau region, with arched caves excavated in loess cliff walls, warm in winter and cool in summer. Northern Shaanxi is the region with the most concentrated distribution of cave dwellings.

地坑院

Sunken Courtyard (Dikengyuan) 民居类型

下沉式窑洞，在平地上向下开挖方形大坑，四壁开挖窑洞，又称天井窑院。三原柏社村有大量地坑院。

Sunken cave dwellings, where a square large pit is excavated downward on flat ground, with caves excavated on the four walls, also called skylight courtyard. There are many sunken courtyards in Baishe Village, Sanyuan County.

靠崖窑

Cliff-side Cave (Kaoya Cave) 民居类型

在天然黄土崖壁上开挖的窑洞，是最常见的窑洞形式。陕北黄土高原广泛分布。

Caves excavated in natural loess cliff walls, the most common cave dwelling form. Widely distributed in the Loess Plateau of northern Shaanxi.

锢窑

Arched Brick Cave (Guyao) 民居类型

用砖或石在平地上砌筑的拱形窑洞，不依赖黄土崖壁，又称独立式窑洞。

Arched caves built with bricks or stones on flat ground, not relying on loess cliff walls, also called independent cave dwellings.

四合院

Siheyuan (Courtyard House) 民居类型

中国传统院落式住宅，四面房屋围合中间庭院。陕西关中、陕北均有四合院分布。

Traditional Chinese courtyard residence, with houses on four sides enclosing a central courtyard. Siheyuan are distributed in both Guanzhong and northern Shaanxi.

石胎泥塑

Stone-core Clay Statue 造像工艺

先在岩石上凿出佛像大体轮廓，再用泥塑细部的造像工艺。彬县大佛寺石窟大佛为石胎泥塑。

A statue-making process where the rough outline of a Buddha statue is first chiseled in rock, then details are modeled with clay. The Great Buddha at the Bin County Great Buddha Temple Grottoes is a stone-core clay statue.

石窟

Grotto 建筑类型

在山崖上开凿的佛教建筑，内有佛像、壁画。陕西是我国石窟发展比较发达的地区之一，以晚期石窟为主。

Buddhist buildings carved into cliffs, containing Buddha statues and murals. Shaanxi is one of the regions with relatively developed grotto development in China, mainly featuring late-period grottoes.

摩崖造像

Cliff Statue (Moya Statue) 造像类型

在天然崖壁上直接雕刻的佛像，不开凿洞窟。慈善寺石窟南崖有9个摩崖造像龛。

Buddha statues directly carved on natural cliff faces, without excavating caves. The south cliff of the Cishan Temple Grottoes has 9 cliff statue niches.

经变画

Sutra Illustration Painting (Jingbian Painting) 壁画类型

将佛教经文内容绘制成图画的壁画形式。大佛寺石窟罗汉洞第三窟内壁有浮雕经变故事60余幅。

A mural form that depicts the content of Buddhist scriptures as paintings. The inner wall of the third cave of the Arhat Cave at the Great Buddha Temple Grottoes has more than 60 relief-carved sutra illustration stories.

飞天

Flying Apsara (Feitian) 造像题材

佛教中能在空中飞舞的天神，常作散花、奏乐姿态。大佛寺大佛背光边沿浮雕22躯飞天伎乐。

Buddhist deities who can fly in the air, often depicted scattering flowers or playing music. The edge of the Great Buddha's halo at the Great Buddha Temple has 22 relief-carved flying apsara musicians.

背光

Halo (Backlight) 造像元素

佛像身后的装饰性光环，象征佛的智慧光明。大佛寺大佛背光边沿浮雕飞天伎乐。

A decorative halo behind a Buddha statue, symbolizing the Buddha's wisdom and light. The edge of the Great Buddha's halo at the Great Buddha Temple has relief-carved flying apsara musicians.

结跏趺坐

Cross-legged Sitting (Jiajia Fuzuo) 造像姿态

佛教造像中最常见的坐姿，双足交叉置于大腿上。大佛寺阿弥陀佛依岩结跏趺坐。

The most common sitting posture in Buddhist statues, with both feet crossed and placed on the thighs. The Amitabha Buddha at the Great Buddha Temple sits cross-legged against the rock.

须弥山

Mount Sumeru 佛教概念

佛教宇宙观中的世界中心山，须弥座即由此得名。鸠摩罗什舍利塔塔座浮雕须弥山。

The mountain at the center of the world in Buddhist cosmology, from which the xumizuo (Sumeru pedestal) gets its name. The pagoda base of the Kumarajiva Relic Pagoda has relief carvings of Mount Sumeru.

舍利

Relic (Sarira) 佛教概念

佛陀或高僧火化后留下的结晶体，被视为圣物，建塔供奉。法门寺因佛指舍利而闻名。

Crystals left after the cremation of the Buddha or eminent monks, regarded as sacred objects, enshrined in pagodas. Famen Temple is famous for the Buddha finger relic.

地宫

Underground Palace (Digong) 陵墓/佛塔结构

塔基或陵墓下的地下空间，用于安放舍利或陪葬品。法门寺地宫出土2000多件大唐皇室重宝。

Underground space under a pagoda base or mausoleum, used to place relics or burial goods. More than 2,000 Tang royal treasures were unearthed from the Famen Temple underground palace.

昭穆制度

Zhaomu System 礼制制度

中国古代宗庙和墓葬的排列制度，左昭右穆，长辈居西、晚辈居东。秦始皇陵选址符合昭穆秩序。

The arrangement system for ancestral temples and tombs in ancient China, with zhao on the left and mu on the right, elders in the west and juniors in the east. The site selection of Qin Shi Huang's Mausoleum conforms to the zhaomu order.

陵邑

Mausoleum Town (Lingyi) 陵墓制度

为供奉帝陵而在陵旁设置的县城，迁移豪富居住。汉高祖长陵等五座帝陵均建制陵邑，咸阳塬又称五陵塬。

County towns established beside imperial mausoleums to serve them, with wealthy people relocated to live there. Five imperial mausoleums including Emperor Gaozu's Changling established mausoleum towns, hence the Xianyang Plateau is also called the Five Mausoleum Plateau.

陪葬墓

Companion Tomb (Peizang Tomb) 陵墓制度

帝陵周围的功臣、贵戚墓葬。昭陵陪葬墓有198座，数量为唐朝诸帝陵之冠。

Tombs of meritorious officials and nobles around imperial mausoleums. Zhaoling has 198 companion tombs, the most among all Tang imperial mausoleums.

号墓为陵

Designating a Tomb as a Mausoleum 陵墓制度

将太子、公主的墓葬规格提升为帝陵级别。懿德太子李重润、永泰公主李先蕙墓均号墓为陵。

Elevating the burial规格 of crown princes and princesses to imperial mausoleum level. The tombs of Crown Prince Yide Li Chongrun and Princess Yongtai Li Xianhui were both designated as mausoleums.

神道

Spirit Path (Shendao) 陵墓组成

陵墓前的大道，两侧排列石刻。乾陵神道两侧有石华表、飞马、朱雀、石马、石人等。

The avenue in front of a mausoleum, with stone carvings arranged on both sides. On both sides of the spirit path of Qianling, there are stone huabiao, flying horses, vermilion birds, stone horses, and stone figures.

石像生

Stone Statues (Shixiangsheng) 陵墓石刻

陵墓神道两侧的石人、石兽，象征仪卫。唐陵石像生包括石马、石人、石狮等。

Stone figures and stone beasts on both sides of the mausoleum spirit path, symbolizing ceremonial guards. Tang mausoleum stone statues include stone horses, stone figures, and stone lions.

蕃酋像

Foreign Chief Statue (Fanqiu Statue) 陵墓石刻

陵墓前雕刻的外国或少数民族首领石像。昭陵有十四国蕃君长石像，乾陵有61尊蕃酋像。

Stone statues of foreign or minority ethnic group chiefs carved in front of mausoleums. Zhaoling has stone statues of 14 foreign tribal chiefs, and Qianling has 61 foreign chief statues.

昭陵六骏

Six Steeds of Zhaoling 陵墓石刻

唐太宗昭陵北司马门内的六匹战马石刻，纪念唐太宗征战时骑过的六匹战马。

Six war horse stone carvings inside the North Sima Gate of Emperor Taizong's Zhaoling, commemorating the six war horses ridden by Emperor Taizong during his military campaigns.

城垣

City Wall (Chengyuan) 城防建筑

城市的防御性围墙，多为夯土筑成，外砌砖。西安古城墙是中国现存规模最大、保存最完整的城垣。

Defensive walls of cities, mostly built of rammed earth with brick exterior. The Xi'an Ancient City Wall is the largest and best-preserved city wall existing in China.

瓮城

Wengcheng (Barbican) 城防建筑

城门外的半圆形或方形护门小城，增强城门防御。西安古城墙各门外均有瓮城。

A semicircular or square small protective city outside the city gate, enhancing gate defense. Each gate of the Xi'an Ancient City Wall has a barbican.

马面

Horse-face (Mamian) 城防建筑

城墙上向外突出的墩台，用于侧翼防御。西安古城墙上有马面98座。

Platforms projecting outward from city walls, used for flank defense. The Xi'an Ancient City Wall has 98 horse-face platforms.

角楼

Corner Tower (Jiaolou) 城防建筑

城墙四角上的楼阁，用于瞭望和防御。西安古城墙四角各有一座角楼。

Pavilions at the four corners of city walls, used for observation and defense. Each of the four corners of the Xi'an Ancient City Wall has a corner tower.

钟楼

Bell Tower (Zhonglou) 城市建筑

城市中悬挂大钟的楼阁，用于报时。西安钟楼是中国现存规模最大、形制最完整的钟楼。

Pavilions in cities hanging large bells, used for timekeeping. The Xi'an Bell Tower is the largest and most complete bell tower existing in China.

鼓楼

Drum Tower (Gulou) 城市建筑

城市中放置大鼓的楼阁，与钟楼配合报时。西安鼓楼与钟楼东西相望。

Pavilions in cities placing large drums, cooperating with bell towers for timekeeping. The Xi'an Drum Tower faces the Bell Tower east-west.

会馆

Guild Hall (Huiguan) 公共建筑

明清时期旅居外地的同乡或同业商人建立的聚会场所，多建有戏楼、大殿。陕西会馆建筑融合南北风格。

Gathering places established by fellow townsmen or same-trade merchants living away from home during the Ming and Qing dynasties, often with opera towers and main halls. Shaanxi guild hall buildings integrate northern and southern styles.

戏楼

Opera Tower (Xilou) 公共建筑

会馆、祠庙中用于演戏的楼阁，多为倒座式，面向大殿。陕西会馆多有精美的戏楼。

Pavilions for opera performances in guild halls and temples, mostly in daozuo (reverse seat) style, facing the main hall. Shaanxi guild halls often have exquisite opera towers.

书院

Academy (Shuyuan) 教育建筑

中国古代教育机构，兼具教学、祭祀、藏书功能。陕西关中书院是明清陕西最高学府。

Ancient Chinese educational institutions, combining teaching, sacrifice, and book collection functions. The Guanzhong Academy in Shaanxi was the highest educational institution in Shaanxi during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

考院

Examination Hall (Kaoyuan) 教育建筑

科举考试的场所，有号舍、大堂等建筑。蒲城考院是陕西保存最完整的清代考院。

Places for imperial examinations, with numbered cells (haoshe) and main halls. The Pucheng Examination Hall is the best-preserved Qing dynasty examination hall in Shaanxi.

号舍

Examination Cell (Haoshe) 教育建筑

科举考试中考生答卷的小隔间，每间约1平方米。考院中有大量号舍。

Small compartments for candidates to answer papers in imperial examinations, each about 1 square meter. Examination halls have a large number of examination cells.

文庙

Confucian Temple (Wenmiao) 祠庙建筑

祭祀孔子的祠庙，又称孔庙，多与学宫合建。陕西有西安府文庙、韩城文庙等。

Temples for sacrificing to Confucius, also called Confucian temples, often built together with schools. Shaanxi has the Xi'an Prefecture Confucian Temple, Hancheng Confucian Temple, etc.

城隍庙

City God Temple (Chenghuang Temple) 祠庙建筑

祭祀城隍神的祠庙，城隍为城市守护神。陕西有西安都城隍庙、三原城隍庙等。

Temples for sacrificing to the City God, the guardian deity of cities. Shaanxi has the Xi'an Capital City God Temple, Sanyuan City God Temple, etc.

东岳庙

Eastern Peak Temple (Dongyue Temple) 祠庙建筑

祭祀东岳大帝（泰山神）的祠庙，主司生死。西安东岳庙有精美的壁画。

Temples for sacrificing to the Great Emperor of the Eastern Peak (Mount Tai deity), in charge of life and death. The Xi'an Eastern Peak Temple has exquisite murals.

西岳庙

Western Peak Temple (Xiyue Temple) 祠庙建筑

祭祀西岳大帝（华山神）的祠庙，有陕西小故宫之称。华阴西岳庙规模宏大。

Temples for sacrificing to the Great Emperor of the Western Peak (Mount Hua deity), known as the 'Small Forbidden City of Shaanxi.' The Xiyue Temple in Huayin has a grand scale.

清真寺

Mosque (Qingzhen Temple) 宗教建筑

伊斯兰教礼拜场所，陕西清真寺多采用中国传统建筑形式。西安化觉巷清真寺是中国四大清真寺之一。

Islamic worship places; most mosques in Shaanxi adopt traditional Chinese architectural forms. the Huajue Lane Mosque in Xi'an is one of the four major mosques in China.

邦克楼

Minaret (Bangke Tower) 宗教建筑

清真寺中召唤信徒礼拜的楼阁，又称宣礼塔。陕西清真寺邦克楼多为中国楼阁式。

Towers in mosques calling believers to worship, also called minarets. Most minarets of Shaanxi mosques are in Chinese multi-story style.

道教宫观

Taoist Temple (Gongguan) 宗教建筑

道教祭祀和修行场所，陕西有楼观台、八仙庵、金台观等著名宫观。

Taoist sacrifice and cultivation places; Shaanxi has famous temples such as Louguantai, Baxian'an, and Jintaiguan.

佛教寺庙

Buddhist Temple 宗教建筑

佛教祭祀和修行场所，陕西有大慈恩寺、兴教寺、大兴善寺等著名寺庙。

Buddhist sacrifice and cultivation places; Shaanxi has famous temples such as Great Ci'en Temple, Xingjiao Temple, and Daxingshan Temple.

三教合一

Integration of Three Religions 宗教文化

佛、道、儒三教融合的文化现象。富县石泓寺石窟1号窟和7号窟表现三教合一内容。

The cultural phenomenon of the integration of Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism. Caves 1 and 7 of the Fuxian Shihong Temple Grottoes express the content of the integration of three religions.

丝绸之路

Silk Road 历史文化

古代连接中国与西方的贸易通道，陕西是丝绸之路的起点，佛教沿此路东传。

The ancient trade route connecting China and the West; Shaanxi is the starting point of the Silk Road, along which Buddhism was transmitted eastward.

关中

Guanzhong 地理区域

陕西中部渭河平原，四关之中，土地肥沃，是周秦汉唐等十三个王朝的定都之地。

The Wei River Plain in central Shaanxi, 'within the four passes,' with fertile land, was the capital location of thirteen dynasties including Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang.

陕北

Northern Shaanxi 地理区域

陕西北部黄土高原地区，包括榆林、延安，窑洞、长城、石窟是其建筑特色。

The Loess Plateau region in northern Shaanxi, including Yulin and Yan'an; cave dwellings, the Great Wall, and grottoes are its architectural features.

陕南

Southern Shaanxi 地理区域

陕西南部秦巴山区，包括汉中、安康、商洛，气候湿润，建筑融合南北风格。

The Qinba Mountain region in southern Shaanxi, including Hanzhong, Ankang, and Shangluo, with a humid climate and buildings integrating northern and southern styles.

黄土高原

Loess Plateau 地理区域

中国四大高原之一，覆盖陕北等地，黄土层深厚，是窑洞建筑的天然条件。

One of the four major plateaus in China, covering northern Shaanxi and other areas, with thick loess layers, providing natural conditions for cave dwelling architecture.

夯土

Rammed Earth 建筑材料

用工具逐层夯实的土，是中国古代城墙、台基、陵墓封土的主要材料。

Soil compacted layer by layer with tools, the main material for ancient Chinese city walls, pedestals, and mausoleum mounds.

包砖

Brick Cladding 建筑工艺

在夯土城墙外侧包砌砖层，增强防御和耐久性。西安古城墙为明代包砖城墙。

Laying brick layers on the outside of rammed-earth city walls to enhance defense and durability. The Xi'an Ancient City Wall is a Ming dynasty brick-clad city wall.

琉璃

Glazed Tile 建筑材料

表面施釉的陶质建筑构件，用于屋顶、塔刹等。延安千佛琉璃塔是陕西仅见的琉璃塔。

Glazed ceramic building components used for roofs, pagoda finials, etc. The Yan'an Thousand-Buddha Glazed Pagoda is the only glazed pagoda seen in Shaanxi.

铁铸

Iron Casting 建筑材料

用铁铸造建筑构件或整座建筑。咸阳千佛铁塔是我国现存最高的铁塔。

Casting building components or entire buildings with iron. the Xianyang Thousand-Buddha Iron Pagoda is the tallest existing iron pagoda in China.

鎏金

Gilding 装饰工艺

在金属表面涂金的工艺。泾阳崇文宝塔顶部发现8尊鎏金铜佛像。

The craft of applying gold to metal surfaces. 8 gilded copper Buddha statues were found at the top of the Jingyang Chongwen Pagoda.

砖雕

Brick Carving 装饰工艺

在砖上雕刻图案的工艺，用于墙面、门楼、照壁等。陕西会馆、祠庙中砖雕精美。

The craft of carving patterns on bricks, used for walls, gate towers, screen walls, etc. Brick carvings in Shaanxi guild halls and temples are exquisite.

木雕

Wood Carving 装饰工艺

在木构件上雕刻图案的工艺，用于梁枋、门窗、斗栱等。紫阳北五省会馆木雕蕴涵深厚历史文化。

The craft of carving patterns on wooden components, used for beams, doors and windows, bracket sets, etc. The wood carvings of the Ziyang Five Northern Provinces Guild Hall contain profound historical culture.

石雕

Stone Carving 装饰工艺

在石材上雕刻图案的工艺，用于柱础、栏杆、碑刻等。霍去病墓前石刻是西汉陵墓石刻代表。

The craft of carving patterns on stone, used for column bases, railings, steles, etc. The stone carvings in front of Huo Qubing's tomb are representative of Western Han mausoleum stone carvings.

壁画

Mural 装饰艺术

绘制在墙壁上的图画。紫阳北五省会馆现存110多平方米清代建筑壁画。

Paintings drawn on walls. The Ziyang Five Northern Provinces Guild Hall preserves more than 110 square meters of Qing dynasty architectural murals.

瓦当

Tile End (Wadang) 建筑构件

筒瓦顶端下垂的圆形或半圆形装饰件，有图案或文字。陕西出土大量周秦汉唐瓦当。

Round or semicircular decorative pieces at the lower end of tube tiles, with patterns or inscriptions. A large number of Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang tile ends have been unearthed in Shaanxi.

滴水

Drip Tile (Dishui) 建筑构件

板瓦前端下垂的三角形装饰件，用于引导雨水。与瓦当配合使用。

Triangular decorative pieces at the front end of flat tiles, used to guide rainwater. Used in conjunction with tile ends.

柱础

Column Base (Zhuchu) 建筑构件

柱子底部的石质基座，防潮并传递荷载。山阳禹王宫石柱础造型各异，石雕图案丰富多彩。

Stone pedestals at the bottom of columns, moisture-proof and load-transferring. The stone column bases of the Shanyang Yu the Great Palace have various shapes with rich and colorful stone carving patterns.

阑额

Architrave (Lan'e) 建筑构件

柱与柱之间的横向联系构件，位于柱头之上。大雁塔塔身用砖砌扁柱和阑额。

Horizontal connecting components between columns, located above column heads. The Giant Wild Goose Pagoda body uses brick flat columns and architraves.

普拍枋

Pubanfang (Flat Beam) 建筑构件

位于阑额之上、承托斗栱的横向构件。兴教寺玄奘塔以砖隐出倚柱、阑额及普拍枋。

Horizontal components above the architrave, supporting bracket sets. The Xuanzang Pagoda at Xingjiao Temple uses brick-hidden pilasters, architraves, and pubanfang.

平座

Flat Seat (Pingzuo) 建筑构件

楼阁式建筑中用于登临的平台，有栏杆。大雁塔各层均有木楼板和木扶梯。

Platforms for climbing in multi-story buildings, with railings. Each story of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda has wooden floor slabs and wooden ladders.

塔刹

Pagoda Finial (Tasha) 佛塔构件

佛塔顶部的装饰性构件，由刹座、相轮、华盖、宝珠等组成。泾阳崇文宝塔塔顶安置4.19米高铜质宝瓶式塔刹。

Decorative components at the top of Buddhist pagodas, composed of finial base, phase wheels, canopy, and precious pearl. The top of the Jingyang Chongwen Pagoda is installed with a 4.19-m-high copper treasure-vase-style pagoda finial.

Shaanxi Ancient Architecture Glossary · Dorling Kindersley Style
50
术语 Terms
8
章节 Chapters
108
处建筑 Sites
建筑结构 · Structure (12)
窑洞
Cave Dwelling (Yaodong)

中文：窑洞是中国西北黄土高原特有的传统民居，利用黄土直立性在山坡或平地挖掘拱形洞穴。书中记载陕西窑洞有靠崖窑、地坑院（下沉式）和锢窑（独立式）三种类型。陕北窑洞平面呈L形，底层为回廊，廊下墁砖，上下层均有排水设施，是适应黄土高原干旱气候的智慧结晶。

EN: Cave dwellings are traditional residences unique to the Loess Plateau, using loess vertical stability to excavate arched caves. The book records three types: cliff-side, sunken courtyard, and free-standing stone caves. Northern Shaanxi caves have L-shaped plans with ground-floor corridors paved with brick and drainage on both levels—wisdom adapted to the arid plateau climate.

实例: 米脂杨家沟扶风寨、延安窑洞、三原柏社村地坑院 | 关联: 地坑院, 锢窑, 黄土高原
地坑院
Sunken Courtyard (Dikengyuan)

中文：地坑院又称下沉式窑洞，在平坦黄土地面向下挖掘方形深坑，再在坑壁四周挖掘窑洞形成地下院落。书中记载三原柏社村保留有完整的地坑院群落，被誉为'地平线下古村落，民居史上活化石'。

EN: Sunken courtyards are underground dwellings formed by excavating a square pit on flat loess ground, then digging caves around the pit walls. The book records that Sanyuan Baishe Village preserves a complete cluster, known as 'ancient villages below the horizon, living fossils in residential history.'

实例: 三原柏社村 | 关联: 窑洞, 锢窑, 黄土高原
抬梁式
Beam-Lifting Frame (Tailiangshi)

中文：抬梁式是中国古建筑主要木构架形式，柱上抬梁，梁上安短柱，短柱上再抬梁，层层叠叠形成屋架。书中记载三原城隍庙大殿为'彻上明造，抬梁式构架，五架梁上用瓜柱、角背'，西安钟楼、鼓楼均采用抬梁式结构，可获得较大室内空间。

EN: The beam-lifting frame is a main timber framing form with beams on columns, short columns on beams, layered to form roof trusses. The book records Sanyuan City God Temple's main hall as 'exposed construction, beam-lifting frame with five-rafter beams using瓜柱 and角背.' Xi'an Bell and Drum Towers use this frame for large interior spaces.

实例: 三原城隍庙大殿、西安钟楼、西安鼓楼 | 关联: 穿斗式, 斗拱, 彻上明造
斗拱
Dougong (Bracket Set)

中文：斗拱是中国古建筑特有构件，由方形斗、升和弓形拱、昂组成，位于柱与梁枋之间。书中记载西安钟楼'下檐斗拱为三踩单昂，上檐斗拱为五踩双昂'，榆林万佛楼'外檐斗拱布置疏朗，升棋做法正规'，韩城城隍庙戏楼'如意斗拱'是明代建筑特征。

EN: Dougong are unique bracket sets consisting of square blocks and bow-shaped arms between columns and beams. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower's 'lower eaves with three-step single ang, upper eaves with five-step double ang,' Yulin Wanfo Tower's 'sparse outer-eave dougong with regular sheng-qi method,' and Hancheng City God Temple's 'ruyi dougong' as Ming features.

实例: 西安钟楼、榆林万佛楼、韩城城隍庙戏楼 | 关联: 昂, 华拱, 坐斗
歇山顶
Hip-and-Gable Roof (Xieshanding)

中文：歇山顶由一条正脊、四条垂脊和四条戗脊组成，又称九脊顶，有单檐和重檐之分。书中记载西安鼓楼为'重檐三滴水歇山顶的阁楼式建筑'，三原城隍庙寝殿'重檐歇山顶，高17.25米'，勉县武侯墓山门'硬山式建筑，抬梁式三架梁'。

EN: The hip-and-gable roof has one main ridge, four vertical ridges, and four diagonal ridges (nine ridges total), with single and double eave variants. The book records Xi'an Drum Tower as a 'double-eave three-water-drop hip-and-gable tower,' Sanyuan City God Temple's bedroom hall as 'double-eave hip-and-gable, 17.25m tall.'

实例: 西安鼓楼、三原城隍庙寝殿、韩城城隍庙广荐殿 | 关联: 庑殿顶, 攒尖顶, 硬山顶
庑殿顶
Hip Roof (Wudianding)

中文：庑殿顶是中国古建筑最高等级屋顶，由一条正脊和四条垂脊组成，又称四阿顶。书中记载华阴西岳庙灏灵殿为重檐庑殿顶，体现西岳庙作为祭祀西岳华山的皇家庙宇的崇高等级。

EN: The hip roof is the highest-ranking ancient Chinese roof, with one main and four vertical ridges (four-slope roof). The book records Huayin Xiyue Temple's Haoling Hall as having a double-eave hip roof, reflecting the temple's lofty status as a royal temple for sacrificing to Mount Hua.

实例: 华阴西岳庙灏灵殿 | 关联: 歇山顶, 重檐, 琉璃瓦
攒尖顶
Pyramidal Roof (Cuanjianding)

中文：攒尖顶屋面在顶部交汇于一点，上置宝顶，有三角、四角、六角、八角、圆形等形式。书中记载西安钟楼为'三重檐四角攒尖顶，屋面为琉璃瓦，置鎏金宝瓶刹'，城固钟楼'屋顶为六角，攒尖盔顶，宝顶为铁铸宝珠'。

EN: Pyramidal roofs converge at a top point with a finial, in triangular, square, hexagonal, octagonal, and circular forms. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower as 'triple-eave square pyramidal with glazed tiles and gilded bottle finial,' and Chenggu Bell Tower as 'hexagonal pyramidal helmet roof with cast-iron jewel finial.'

实例: 西安钟楼、城固钟楼、户县钟楼 | 关联: 宝顶, 塔刹, 楼阁式塔
楼阁式塔
Tower-Style Pagoda (Lougeshi Ta)

中文：楼阁式塔源于中国传统楼阁，塔身分层，每层有塔檐、平座、门窗，可登临。书中记载大慈恩寺大雁塔为唐代楼阁式砖塔代表，塔身用砖，仿木结构，每层有砖砌柱、枋、斗拱，是西安的标志性建筑。

EN: Tower-style pagodas derive from traditional Chinese towers, with layered bodies, each with eaves, balconies, doors, and windows for climbing. The book records the Great Wild Goose Pagoda at Dacien Temple as a representative Tang brick pagoda, using brick to imitate timber structure with brick columns, tie beams, and dougong on each layer—a Xi'an landmark.

实例: 大雁塔、富县柏山寺塔 | 关联: 密檐式塔, 塔刹, 平座
密檐式塔
Multi-Eaved Pagoda (Miyanshi Ta)

中文：密檐式塔第一层较高，以上各层塔檐紧密重叠，多为实心不可登临。书中记载荐福寺小雁塔为唐代密檐式砖塔代表，原有15层，现存13层，塔身砖砌，每层叠涩出檐，是唐代密檐塔的杰作。

EN: Multi-eaved pagodas have a tall first story with closely overlapping eaves above, mostly solid and not climbable. The book records Jianfu Temple's Small Wild Goose Pagoda as a representative Tang multi-eaved brick pagoda, originally 15 stories, now 13, with brick body and corbelled eaves on each layer—a Tang masterpiece.

实例: 小雁塔、香积寺善导塔 | 关联: 楼阁式塔, 塔刹, 叠涩
塔刹
Pagoda Finial (Tasha)

中文：塔刹是佛塔顶部的装饰和收束构件，由基座、覆钵、相轮、宝盖、宝珠等组成。书中记载泾阳崇文宝塔塔刹为铜制鎏金，高8.52米，是中国现存最高的塔刹之一；城固钟楼宝顶为铁铸宝珠，各层老角梁下原有风铃。

EN: The pagoda finial is the decorative terminal component at a pagoda's top, consisting of base, inverted bowl, phase wheels, canopy, and jewel. The book records Jingyang Chongwen Pagoda's finial as gilded bronze, 8.52m tall—one of China's tallest surviving finials; Chenggu Bell Tower's finial is cast iron with wind bells under old corner beams.

实例: 泾阳崇文宝塔、城固钟楼 | 关联: 相轮, 覆钵, 宝顶
摩崖造像
Cliff Carving (Moya Zaoxiang)

中文：摩崖造像是在山崖壁面雕刻的佛教造像。书中记载彬县大佛寺石窟始凿于唐贞观二年（628年），大佛高20米，是陕西最大的摩崖造像；慈善寺石窟、富县石泓寺石窟、米脂万佛洞均有精美摩崖造像。

EN: Cliff carvings are Buddhist statues carved on cliff faces. The book records Bin County Great Buddha Temple Grottoes, first carved in 628 CE (Tang Zhenguan 2), with a 20m Great Buddha—the largest in Shaanxi. Cishansi, Shihongsi, and Mizhi Wanfo Cave also have exquisite cliff carvings.

实例: 彬县大佛寺石窟、慈善寺石窟、米脂万佛洞 | 关联: 石窟, 佛塔, 佛教建筑
地宫
Underground Palace (Digong)

中文：地宫是佛塔基下埋藏舍利、佛经和宝物的地下空间。书中记载扶风法门寺地宫于1987年发掘，出土佛指舍利和大量唐代金银器、瓷器、丝织品，是中国迄今发现的最大、等级最高的佛塔地宫。

EN: The underground palace is the subterranean space beneath a pagoda base for burying relics, scriptures, and treasures. The book records Famen Temple's underground palace, excavated in 1987, yielding a Buddha finger relic and大量 Tang gold/silver vessels, porcelain, and textiles—the largest and highest-ranking pagoda underground palace discovered in China.

实例: 扶风法门寺地宫 | 关联: 佛塔, 舍利, 塔基
建筑类型 · Building Type (12)
帝陵
Imperial Mausoleum (Diling)

中文：帝陵是古代帝王陵墓，由封土、陵园、寝殿、陪葬墓等组成。书中记载陕西是中国帝陵最集中地区，有黄帝陵、秦始皇陵、西汉十一陵、唐十八陵。秦始皇陵封土高达64米，是中国古代最大的坟丘；唐昭陵、乾陵为因山为陵。

EN: Imperial mausoleums consist of mounds, enclosures, sacrifice halls, and satellite tombs. The book records Shaanxi as China's most concentrated region of imperial mausoleums, including Yellow Emperor, Qin Shi Huang, eleven Western Han, and eighteen Tang mausoleums. Qin Shi Huang's mound reaches 64m—the largest ancient Chinese tumulus; Tang Zhao and Qian Mausoleums are mountain-carved.

实例: 秦始皇陵、汉茂陵、唐昭陵、唐乾陵 | 关联: 因山为陵, 封土, 陵园
因山为陵
Mountain-Carved Mausoleum (Yinshan Weiling)

中文：因山为陵是唐代帝陵主要形制，将墓室开凿在自然山体中，以山为封土。书中记载唐昭陵（唐太宗）是第一座因山为陵的帝陵，位于礼泉九嵕山；唐乾陵（唐高宗与武则天合葬）位于乾县梁山，是唐十八陵中保存最完整的一座，陵园有石狮、石人、述圣纪碑、无字碑等。

EN: Mountain-carved mausoleums are the main Tang imperial form, with chambers excavated into natural mountains. The book records Zhao Mausoleum (Emperor Taizong) as the first, at Jiuzong Mountain in Liquan; Qian Mausoleum (joint burial of Gaozong and Wu Zetian) at Liang Mountain in Qian County—the best-preserved of eighteen Tang mausoleums, with stone lions, figures, and steles.

实例: 唐昭陵、唐乾陵、唐泰陵 | 关联: 帝陵, 封土, 陵园
清真寺
Mosque (Qingzhensi)

中文：清真寺是伊斯兰教宗教建筑。书中记载西安化觉巷清真寺始建于唐天宝元年（742年），是中国四大清真寺之一，采用中国传统建筑形式，有照壁、牌楼、礼拜殿、省心楼、沐浴室等；大学习巷清真寺（西大寺）坐西朝东，二进院落，礼拜殿可容500多人同时礼拜。

EN: Mosques are Islamic religious buildings. The book records Xi'an Huajue Lane Mosque, founded in 742 CE (Tang Tianbao 1), one of China's four great mosques, using traditional Chinese forms with screen walls, archways, prayer halls, minarets, and ablution rooms. Daxuexi Lane Mosque faces east with two courtyards, its prayer hall holding over 500 worshippers.

实例: 西安化觉巷清真寺、大学习巷清真寺、西乡鹿龄寺 | 关联: 礼拜殿, 省心楼, 照壁
文庙
Confucian Temple (Wenmiao)

中文：文庙是祭祀孔子的祠庙。书中记载韩城文庙始建于明洪武四年（1371年），是文庙现存年代较早的建筑，有棂星门、泮池、大成殿、明伦堂、尊经阁等；西安府文庙（今碑林博物馆）始建于北宋，是陕西最早的文庙。

EN: Confucian temples are shrines for sacrificing to Confucius. The book records Hancheng Confucian Temple, founded in 1371 CE (Ming Hongwu 4), one of the earliest surviving, with lattice star gate, pan pond, Dacheng Hall, Minglun Hall, and scripture tower. Xi'an Fu Confucian Temple (now Beilin Museum) was founded in the Northern Song, Shaanxi's earliest.

实例: 韩城文庙、西安府文庙、咸阳文庙 | 关联: 棂星门, 大成殿, 泮池
城隍庙
City God Temple (Chenghuangmiao)

中文：城隍庙是祭祀城隍神的祠庙。书中记载三原城隍庙始建于明洪武八年（1375年），中轴线从南到北依次布置照壁、牌坊门、山门、木牌坊、石牌坊、戏楼、拜殿、寝殿，是陕西保存最完整的明代城隍庙建筑群；西安都城隍庙为府级城隍庙。

EN: City God temples sacrifice to the City God. The book records Sanyuan City God Temple, founded in 1375 CE (Ming Hongwu 8), with a central axis from south to north: screen wall, archway gate, mountain gate, wooden archway, stone archway, theater stage, worship hall, and bedroom hall—the best-preserved Ming City God temple complex in Shaanxi.

实例: 三原城隍庙、西安都城隍庙、韩城城隍庙 | 关联: 戏楼, 拜殿, 牌坊
会馆
Guild Hall (Huiguan)

中文：会馆是明清同乡或同业在异地建立的聚会场所。书中记载丹凤船帮会馆（明王宫）戏楼最为著名，入口为砖砌三间五楼式牌坊门，额刻'明王宫'，乐楼为戏台，高15米，两侧有楼可供戏班换装；山阳骡帮会馆有北方雄伟粗犷和南方俊丽清秀的建筑风格。

EN: Guild halls were gathering places for same-hometown or same-trade people in the Ming-Qing. The book records Danfeng Boatmen's Guild Hall (Mingwang Palace) with its famous theater stage: entrance is a brick three-bay five-story archway gate inscribed 'Mingwang Palace,' the performance tower is 15m tall with side towers for costume changes. Shanyang Mule-Team Guild Hall blends northern grandeur and southern delicacy.

实例: 丹凤船帮会馆、山阳骡帮会馆、紫阳北五省会馆 | 关联: 戏楼, 牌坊, 砖雕
书院
Academy (Shuyuan)

中文：书院是中国古代教育机构。书中记载关中书院始建于明万历三十七年（1609年），是明清陕西最高学府，为西北四大书院之首，总体布局严格遵循儒家礼制思想，采用中轴对称模式，中轴线上有五重院落；眉县横渠书院为纪念张载而建。

EN: Academies were ancient Chinese educational institutions. The book records Guanzhong Academy, founded in 1609 CE (Ming Wanli 37), the highest institution of Ming-Qing Shaanxi and head of the four northwestern academies. Its layout strictly follows Confucian ritual with central axis symmetry and five courtyard layers. Meixian Hengqu Academy was built to commemorate Zhang Zai.

实例: 关中书院、眉县横渠书院 | 关联: 考院, 大成殿, 泮池
钟鼓楼
Bell and Drum Tower (Zhonggulou)

中文：钟鼓楼是古代城市报时建筑。书中记载西安钟楼始建于明洪武十七年（1384年），通高36米，基座每边长35.5米，是中国现存规模最大、保存最完整的钟楼；西安鼓楼始建于明洪武十三年（1380年），通高33米，是国内现存最大的鼓楼建筑。

EN: Bell and drum towers were ancient city timekeeping buildings. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower, founded in 1384 CE (Ming Hongwu 17), 36m total height with 35.5m square base—the largest and best-preserved surviving bell tower in China. Xi'an Drum Tower, founded in 1380 CE, 33m tall—the largest surviving drum tower in China.

实例: 西安钟楼、西安鼓楼、城固钟楼 | 关联: 古城墙, 攒尖顶, 歇山顶
古城墙
Ancient City Wall (Guchengqiang)

中文：古城墙是古代城市防御建筑。书中记载西安古城墙始建于明洪武三年（1370年），在唐长安城皇城基础上扩建，周长13.74公里，墙高12米，底宽18米，顶宽15米，是中国现存最完整的古代州府级城墙；府谷府州城山河襟带，平面呈曲尺形，周长2320米。

EN: Ancient city walls are defensive structures. The book records Xi'an Ancient City Wall, founded in 1370 CE (Ming Hongwu 3), expanded on the Tang Chang'an imperial city, 13.74km circumference, 12m tall, 18m base width, 15m top width—the most complete surviving ancient prefectural-level city wall in China. Fugu Fuzhou City follows rivers and mountains with a carpenter's-square plan, 2320m circumference.

实例: 西安古城墙、府谷府州城、吴堡石城 | 关联: 瓮城, 马面, 垛口
瓮城
Barbican Entrance (Wengcheng)

中文：瓮城是城门外的护门小城，敌人攻入后可关闭城门形成'瓮中捉鳖'。书中记载西安古城墙四座城门外均有瓮城，四城门楼内左侧各有一处登城'马道'，沿城墙设6处登城马道，是中国古代城防建筑的杰作。

EN: A barbican entrance is a protective small city outside a gate; after enemies enter, gates can be closed to 'catch turtles in a jar.' The book records all four gates of Xi'an Ancient City Wall have barbican entrances, with 'horse ramps' for climbing inside each gate tower and six ramps along the wall—masterpieces of ancient Chinese city defense.

实例: 西安古城墙永宁门瓮城 | 关联: 古城墙, 马面, 城门楼
佛塔
Buddhist Pagoda (Fota)

中文：佛塔是佛教建筑重要类型，源于印度窣堵坡。书中记载陕西佛塔数量众多，有楼阁式、密檐式、覆钵式等，大雁塔、小雁塔是唐代佛塔代表；泾阳崇文宝塔高87米，是中国现存最高的砖塔；法门寺塔因地宫出土佛指舍利而闻名。

EN: Buddhist pagodas are important Buddhist architecture derived from Indian stupas. The book records Shaanxi's numerous pagodas in tower-style, multi-eaved, and stupa forms. The Great and Small Wild Goose Pagodas are Tang representatives; Jingyang Chongwen Pagoda at 87m is China's tallest surviving brick pagoda; Famen Temple Pagoda is famous for the Buddha finger relic from its underground palace.

实例: 大雁塔、小雁塔、泾阳崇文宝塔、法门寺塔 | 关联: 楼阁式塔, 密檐式塔, 塔刹
石窟
Grotto (Shiku)

中文：石窟是在山崖壁面开凿的佛教建筑。书中记载陕西石窟以晚期石窟为主，共发现北魏至明清石窟350余处，彬县大佛寺石窟最为重要，始凿于唐贞观二年（628年），大佛高20米；此外有慈善寺石窟、富县石泓寺石窟、米脂万佛洞等。

EN: Grottoes are Buddhist buildings excavated into cliff faces. The book records Shaanxi grottoes as mainly late-period, with over 350 sites from Northern Wei to Ming-Qing. Bin County Great Buddha Temple Grottoes are most important, first carved in 628 CE with a 20m Great Buddha; others include Cishansi, Shihongsi in Fu County, and Wanfo Cave in Mizhi.

实例: 彬县大佛寺石窟、慈善寺石窟、富县石泓寺石窟 | 关联: 摩崖造像, 佛塔, 佛教建筑
建筑装饰 · Decoration (10)
砖雕
Brick Carving (Zhuandiao)

中文：砖雕是在青砖上雕刻图案的装饰艺术。书中记载旬邑唐家宅院砖雕精美，有'凤凰牡丹'、'海水朝阳'等图案；丹凤船帮会馆戏楼砖雕精美；韩城党家村门楼、照壁砖雕是关中民居砖雕的代表，内容包括人物故事、花鸟瑞兽。

EN: Brick carving is decorative art on blue bricks. The book records Xunyi Tang Family Residence with exquisite brick carvings including 'phoenix and peony' and 'sea and sunrise'; Danfeng Boatmen's Guild Hall theater stage has fine brick carving; Hancheng Dangjia Village gate towers and screen walls represent Guanzhong residential brick carving with figure stories, flowers, birds, and auspicious animals.

实例: 旬邑唐家宅院、丹凤船帮会馆、韩城党家村 | 关联: 木雕, 石雕, 照壁
木雕
Wood Carving (Mudiao)

中文：木雕是在木材上雕刻图案的装饰艺术。书中记载西安化觉巷清真寺木雕精美，采用浮雕、透雕技法；山阳骡帮会馆戏楼'梁柱、门窗雕工精致，主题涉及高山河谷、野渡江帆、亭台楼阁、车马仪仗、鸟兽虫鱼、树木花草，尤以人物雕刻而闻名，因此当地人们称之为花戏楼'。

EN: Wood carving is decorative art on wood. The book records Xi'an Huajue Lane Mosque with exquisite relief and openwork wood carving; Shanyang Mule-Team Guild Hall theater stage has 'exquisitely carved beams, columns, doors, and windows with themes of mountains, rivers, boats, pavilions, processions, birds, beasts, and flowers—especially famous for figure carving, hence locally called the Flower Theater.'

实例: 西安化觉巷清真寺、山阳骡帮会馆戏楼 | 关联: 砖雕, 石雕, 雀替
石雕
Stone Carving (Shidiao)

中文：石雕是在石材上雕刻图案的装饰艺术。书中记载唐乾陵石狮、石人、述圣纪碑、无字碑是唐代石雕艺术的巅峰；韩城司马迁祠、勉县武侯祠的碑刻和石狮最为著名；旬邑唐家宅院柱础石雕有'凤凰牡丹'等精美图案。

EN: Stone carving is decorative art on stone. The book records Tang Qian Mausoleum's stone lions, figures, and steles as the peak of Tang stone carving; Hancheng Sima Qian Shrine and Mianxian Wuhou Shrine are famous for steles and stone lions; Xunyi Tang Family Residence column bases have exquisite 'phoenix and peony' stone carvings.

实例: 唐乾陵石刻、韩城司马迁祠、旬邑唐家宅院 | 关联: 砖雕, 木雕, 柱础
琉璃瓦
Glazed Tile (Liuliwa)

中文：琉璃瓦是表面施釉的陶瓦，有黄、绿、蓝等颜色，是高级屋面材料。书中记载西安钟楼'屋面为琉璃瓦，置鎏金宝瓶刹'；三原城隍庙寝殿'屋顶布琉璃筒瓦'；韩城城隍庙广荐殿'布琉璃筒瓦，脊吻，次间脊上增饰楼阁'。

EN: Glazed tiles are glazed ceramic tiles in yellow, green, and blue, premium roofing material. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower's 'glazed tile roof with gilded bottle finial'; Sanyuan City God Temple bedroom hall's 'roof covered with glazed tubular tiles'; Hancheng City God Temple's Guangjian Hall 'glazed tubular tiles with ridge ornaments and added pavilions on secondary ridges.'

实例: 西安钟楼、三原城隍庙、韩城城隍庙 | 关联: 筒瓦, 板瓦, 正吻
彩画
Painted Decoration (Caihua)

中文：彩画是古建筑木构件表面的绘画装饰。书中记载西安东岳庙大殿东西两壁、后壁棋盘门两侧之上满布大幅彩色道教壁画，面积达158平方米，绘制于清康熙五十四年（1715年），是陕西境内现存宫观壁画中单体面积最大的，内容主要为山水、楼阁、人物、花卉。

EN: Painted decorations are painted ornaments on wooden components. The book records Xi'an Dongyue Temple's main hall with large Taoist murals on east/west walls and above the back paneled doors, totaling 158 sq m, painted in 1715 CE (Qing Kangxi 54)—the largest single-area surviving temple mural in Shaanxi, mainly depicting landscapes, pavilions, figures, and flowers.

实例: 西安东岳庙大殿壁画 | 关联: 和玺彩画, 旋子彩画, 藻井
照壁
Screen Wall (Zhaobi)

中文：照壁是大门内或外的屏蔽建筑。书中记载大学习巷清真寺大照壁在寺东侧，砖砌高10米，长15米，照壁中心有三大幅圆形砖雕图案，上部有著名的'四马砖雕'；三原城隍庙中轴线最南端为照壁，水磨青砖砌筑。

EN: Screen walls are shielding buildings inside or outside gates. The book records Daxuexi Lane Mosque's large screen wall on the east side, 10m tall and 15m long brick wall with three large circular brick-carved patterns and famous 'four-horse brick carving' on top; Sanyuan City God Temple's southernmost axis point is a screen wall of polished blue brick.

实例: 大学习巷清真寺照壁、三原城隍庙照壁 | 关联: 砖雕, 门楼, 四合院
雀替
Spandrel (Queti)

中文：雀替是梁枋与柱交接处的装饰构件。书中记载勉县武侯墓山门'前檐梁下皆施有牛腿装饰，柱间施花板，枋上施如意斗拱'；西安化觉巷清真寺雀替雕刻精美，是清真寺建筑装饰的重要组成部分。

EN: Spandrels are decorative components at beam-column junctions. The book records Mianxian Wuhou Tomb's mountain gate with 'bracket-like decorations under front eaves, patterned panels between columns, and ruyi dougong on tie beams'; Xi'an Huajue Lane Mosque has exquisite spandrel carvings, an important part of mosque decoration.

实例: 勉县武侯墓山门、西安化觉巷清真寺 | 关联: 木雕, 梁枋, 斗拱
藻井
Caisson Ceiling (Zaojing)

中文：藻井是古建筑天花板上的凹入装饰。书中记载三原城隍庙大殿'殿内设有平棊天花，直接安放在檐檩之上，绘制有花鸟等图案'；西安东岳庙大殿保留有精美的明代彩画和藻井，是陕西古建筑彩画艺术的重要实例。

EN: Caisson ceilings are sunken ceiling decorations. The book records Sanyuan City God Temple's main hall with 'flat coffered ceiling placed directly on eaves purlins, painted with flowers and birds'; Xi'an Dongyue Temple main hall preserves exquisite Ming painted decorations and caisson ceilings, an important example of Shaanxi architectural painting art.

实例: 三原城隍庙大殿、西安东岳庙 | 关联: 彩画, 斗拱, 殿堂
正吻
Main Ridge Ornament (Zhengwen)

中文：正吻是正脊两端的装饰构件，多为龙形或兽形。书中记载韩城城隍庙广荐殿'布琉璃筒瓦，脊吻，次间脊上增饰楼阁'；三原城隍庙戏楼'屋顶为庑殿顶，戏台内中顶装八边八层藻井'，正吻是古建筑等级的重要标志。

EN: Main ridge ornaments are decorative components at both ends of the main ridge, mostly dragon or beast forms. The book records Hancheng City God Temple's Guangjian Hall with 'glazed tubular tiles, ridge ornaments, and added pavilions on secondary ridges'; Sanyuan City God Temple's theater stage has a 'hip roof with octagonal eight-layer caisson at the interior top'—ridge ornaments are important rank indicators.

实例: 韩城城隍庙、三原城隍庙 | 关联: 正脊, 垂兽, 走兽
柱础
Column Base (Zhuchu)

中文：柱础是柱下的石质基座，起防潮、承重和装饰作用。书中记载西安东岳庙大殿'前檐8根柱子柱础刻有精美的二龙戏珠浮雕图案，其他柱石皆雕花卉'；旬邑唐家宅院柱础石雕精美，是关中民居建筑装饰的代表。

EN: Column bases are stone pedestals under columns for moisture protection, load bearing, and decoration. The book records Xi'an Dongyue Temple main hall's '8 front-eave column bases carved with exquisite 'two dragons playing with pearl' relief, other column stones carved with flowers'; Xunyi Tang Family Residence column bases are fine examples of Guanzhong residential decoration.

实例: 西安东岳庙大殿、旬邑唐家宅院 | 关联: 石雕, 台基, 柱子
建筑材料 · Materials (5)
青砖
Blue Brick (Qingzhuan)

中文：青砖是古建筑主要墙体材料。书中记载西安古城墙'明隆庆二年（1568年）对城墙外壁包砌青砖'，墙内夯土，外墙砌以砖石，上设垛堞；府谷府州城'城墙内夯黄土，外以石砌'；陕北锢窑用石块旋垒砌而成。

EN: Blue bricks are the main wall material. The book records Xi'an Ancient City Wall's 'outer wall faced with blue brick in 1568 CE (Ming Longqing 2),' with rammed earth inside and brick/stone outside with battlements; Fugu Fuzhou City's 'walls rammed with yellow loess inside, stone outside'; northern Shaanxi stone caves built with stone vaulting.

实例: 西安古城墙、府谷府州城、陕北锢窑 | 关联: 小青瓦, 石材, 夯土
小青瓦
Small Gray Tile (Xiaoqingwa)

中文：小青瓦是古建筑传统屋面材料。书中记载韩城党家村民居屋面多为小灰瓦，硬山式建筑；勉县武侯墓山门'屋面筒瓦，镂雕行龙纹脊'；西乡鹿龄寺'屋顶覆盖灰色筒瓦，屋脊设有精美砖雕，中央设圆形塔式脊刹'。

EN: Small gray tiles are traditional roofing material. The book records Hancheng Dangjia Village residences mostly using small gray tiles with gable roofs; Mianxian Wuhou Tomb mountain gate has 'tubular tiles with openwork dragon-pattern ridge'; Xixiang Luling Temple's 'roof covered with gray tubular tiles, exquisite brick-carved ridge with central circular pagoda-style ridge finial.'

实例: 韩城党家村、西乡鹿龄寺 | 关联: 青砖, 琉璃瓦, 筒瓦
黄土
Loess (Huangtu)

中文：黄土是西北黄土高原主要土壤，有直立性，适合挖掘窑洞。书中记载陕西是中国黄土分布最广的省份之一，陕北和关中窑洞民居利用黄土直立性建造；秦咸阳城'城墙基宽约5.5-7.6米，最厚4.6米'，为夯土筑成；秦始皇陵封土为夯土筑成，高达64米。

EN: Loess is the main soil of the northwest Loess Plateau with vertical stability, suitable for cave excavation. The book records Shaanxi as one of China's provinces with widest loess distribution; northern and central Shaanxi cave dwellings use loess vertical stability; Qin Xianyang City walls '5.5-7.6m base width, 4.6m thickest' of rammed earth; Qin Shi Huang's mound is rammed earth, 64m tall.

实例: 陕北窑洞、秦咸阳城、秦始皇陵封土 | 关联: 窑洞, 地坑院, 夯土
石材
Stone (Shicai)

中文：石材是古建筑重要材料，用于台基、柱础、栏杆、碑碣、造像等。书中记载唐乾陵石狮、石人是唐代石雕巅峰；彬县大佛寺石窟大佛高20米，为石刻造像；府谷府州城'城墙内夯黄土，外以石砌'；吴堡石城全部用石头砌筑。

EN: Stone is an important building material for platforms, column bases, railings, steles, and statues. The book records Tang Qian Mausoleum stone lions and figures as the peak of Tang stone carving; Bin County Great Buddha Temple's 20m Great Buddha is stone carving; Fugu Fuzhou City walls 'rammed loess inside, stone outside'; Wubao Stone City is entirely built of stone.

实例: 唐乾陵石刻、彬县大佛寺、吴堡石城 | 关联: 石雕, 柱础, 台基
木材
Timber (Mucai)

中文：木材是古建筑主要结构材料。书中记载西安钟楼'二层结构用通柱，攒尖顶构架采用抹角梁和井口枋'；榆林万佛楼'基座上建有二层木结构楼阁，14根廊柱环宇'；三原城隍庙大殿'梁架为彻上明造，抬梁式构架，五架梁上用瓜柱、角背'。

EN: Timber is the main structural material. The book records Xi'an Bell Tower's 'second story using continuous columns, pyramidal frame using mitered beams and well-frame tie beams'; Yulin Wanfo Tower's 'two-story wooden pavilion on base with 14 surrounding columns'; Sanyuan City God Temple main hall's 'exposed beam-lifting frame with five-rafter beams using瓜柱 and角背.'

实例: 西安钟楼、榆林万佛楼、三原城隍庙 | 关联: 抬梁式, 斗拱, 彻上明造
文化背景 · Cultural Context (11)
周秦汉唐
Zhou-Qin-Han-Tang Culture

中文：陕西是周、秦、汉、唐四个强盛王朝建都之地，13个王朝在此建都，历时1100多年。书中前言记载'从公元前11世纪开始，陕西就是当时中国社会、文化发展的核心区域'，西周的都城丰镐、秦都咸阳、西汉长安、隋唐长安都是当时中国政治、经济、文化的中心。

EN: Shaanxi was the capital of four powerful dynasties—Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang—with 13 dynasties establishing capitals here over 1,100 years. The book's preface records 'from the 11th century BCE, Shaanxi was the core region of Chinese social and cultural development,' with Western Zhou Fenghao, Qin Xianyang, Western Han Chang'an, and Sui-Tang Chang'an all serving as political, economic, and cultural centers.

实例: 丰镐遗址、秦咸阳城、汉长安城、唐长安城 | 关联: 帝陵, 古城墙, 丝绸之路
丝绸之路
Silk Road

中文：丝绸之路起点为长安（今西安）。书中记载唐代长安是当时世界贸易的中心和'丝绸之路'的出发地，佛教沿丝绸之路传入中国，大慈恩寺是玄奘翻译佛经的场所，大雁塔为存放玄奘取回的佛经而建。2014年丝绸之路'长安-天山廊道'被列入世界文化遗产。

EN: The Silk Road started from Chang'an (today's Xi'an). The book records Tang Chang'an as the world trade center and departure point of the Silk Road; Buddhism entered China along it; Dacien Temple was where Xuanzang translated scriptures, and the Great Wild Goose Pagoda was built to store them. In 2014, the Silk Road 'Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor' was listed as UNESCO World Heritage.

实例: 大雁塔、大慈恩寺、兴教寺 | 关联: 佛教建筑, 佛塔, 石窟
佛教文化
Buddhist Culture

中文：佛教自汉代沿丝绸之路传入中国，陕西是佛教中国化的重要地区。书中记载唐代长安是全国佛教中心，有大慈恩寺、大兴善寺、荐福寺、香积寺等著名寺院，玄奘在大慈恩寺翻译佛经；陕西现存佛教寺塔280余座，其中著名的有唐代风格大雁塔、小雁塔。

EN: Buddhism entered China along the Silk Road from the Han, and Shaanxi was an important region for its sinicization. The book records Tang Chang'an as the national Buddhist center with Dacien, Daxingshan, Jianfu, and Xiangji Temples; Xuanzang translated scriptures at Dacien Temple. Shaanxi preserves over 280 Buddhist pagodas, including the famous Tang-style Great and Small Wild Goose Pagodas.

实例: 大慈恩寺、大雁塔、大兴善寺、法门寺 | 关联: 佛塔, 石窟, 摩崖造像
道教文化
Taoist Culture

中文：道教是中国本土宗教，陕西是道教重要发源地。书中记载周至楼观台是道教最早的宫观之一，相传老子在此讲经；西安八仙庵、华阴玉泉院、佳县白云观、宝鸡金台观等都是著名道教建筑。金台观始建于元朝末年，因明代道士张三丰在此修道而闻名。

EN: Taoism is China's indigenous religion, and Shaanxi is an important birthplace. The book records Zhouzhi Louguan Terrace as one of the earliest Taoist palaces, where Laozi is said to have lectured; Xi'an Baxian Temple, Huayin Yuquan Courtyard, Jiaxian Baiyun Temple, and Baoji Jintai Temple are famous Taoist buildings. Jintai Temple was founded in the late Yuan, famous for Ming Taoist Zhang Sanfeng's cultivation here.

实例: 周至楼观台、西安八仙庵、宝鸡金台观 | 关联: 道教宫观, 佛教建筑, 祠庙
伊斯兰文化
Islamic Culture

中文：伊斯兰教自唐代沿丝绸之路传入中国，陕西是伊斯兰教传播的重要地区。书中记载西安化觉巷清真寺是中国四大清真寺之一，始建于唐天宝元年（742年）；大学习巷清真寺在唐中宗时已赐名'清教寺'，唐玄宗朝复改唐明寺，元中统年间又赐名回回万善寺。

EN: Islam entered China along the Silk Road from the Tang, and Shaanxi was an important region for its spread. The book records Xi'an Huajue Lane Mosque as one of China's four great mosques, founded in 742 CE (Tang Tianbao 1); Daxuexi Lane Mosque was already named 'Qingjiao Temple' in Emperor Zhongzong's reign, renamed Tangming Temple in Xuanzong's reign, and Huihui Wanshan Temple in the Yuan Zhongtong era.

实例: 西安化觉巷清真寺、大学习巷清真寺 | 关联: 清真寺, 礼拜殿, 丝绸之路
儒家文化
Confucian Culture

中文：儒家文化是中国传统文化核心，陕西文庙和书院是其重要载体。书中记载西安府文庙（今碑林博物馆）始建于北宋，是陕西最早的文庙；韩城文庙始建于明洪武四年（1371年），是文庙现存年代较早的建筑；关中书院是明清陕西最高学府，为西北四大书院之首。

EN: Confucian culture is the core of traditional Chinese culture, and Shaanxi Confucian temples and academies are its important carriers. The book records Xi'an Fu Confucian Temple (now Beilin Museum) founded in the Northern Song, Shaanxi's earliest; Hancheng Confucian Temple founded in 1371 CE, one of the earliest surviving; Guanzhong Academy was the highest Ming-Qing Shaanxi institution and head of the four northwestern academies.

实例: 西安府文庙、韩城文庙、关中书院 | 关联: 文庙, 书院, 大成殿
世界文化遗产
World Cultural Heritage

中文：陕西有多处世界文化遗产。书中涉及的秦始皇陵及兵马俑坑于1987年列入；丝绸之路'长安-天山廊道'于2014年列入，含大雁塔、小雁塔、兴教寺塔、大明宫遗址等。这些遗产是陕西古建筑的精华，也是全人类共同的文化财富。

EN: Shaanxi has multiple UNESCO World Heritage sites. The book covers Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum and Terracotta Army (listed 1987); the Silk Road 'Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor' (listed 2014), including Great Wild Goose Pagoda, Small Wild Goose Pagoda, Xingjiao Temple Pagoda, and Daming Palace ruins. These are the essence of Shaanxi ancient architecture and shared cultural wealth of all humanity.

实例: 秦始皇陵、大雁塔、小雁塔、兴教寺塔 | 关联: 帝陵, 佛塔, 丝绸之路
黄土高原
Loess Plateau

中文：黄土高原横跨陕西、山西、甘肃等省，是中华文明发源地之一。书中记载陕北和关中位于黄土高原，独特的黄土地貌孕育了窑洞、地坑院等独特民居形式；陕北建筑以窑洞、古城、古寨为特色，榆林卫城、吴堡石城、高家堡古城是陕北古城的代表。

EN: The Loess Plateau spans Shaanxi, Shanxi, and Gansu, one of the birthplaces of Chinese civilization. The book records northern and central Shaanxi on the Loess Plateau, whose unique landforms nurtured cave dwellings and sunken courtyards; northern Shaanxi architecture features caves, ancient cities, and fortresses, with Yulin Garrison City, Wubao Stone City, and Gaojiabao as representatives.

实例: 陕北窑洞、榆林卫城、米脂姜氏庄园 | 关联: 窑洞, 地坑院, 黄土
关中平原
Guanzhong Plain

中文：关中平原位于陕西中部，是渭河冲积平原，有'八百里秦川'之称。书中记载关中是周秦汉唐建都之地，西安、咸阳等城市保留大量古建筑；关中民居以四合院、砖木结构为特色，韩城党家村是关中民居的代表，有'民居瑰宝'之誉。

EN: The Guanzhong Plain in central Shaanxi is a Wei River alluvial plain known as '800 li of Qinchuan.' The book records Guanzhong as the capital region of Zhou, Qin, Han, and Tang, with Xi'an and Xianyang preserving大量 ancient buildings; Guanzhong residences feature courtyard houses and brick-wood structures, with Hancheng Dangjia Village as a representative known as 'residential treasure.'

实例: 西安古城、韩城党家村、三原城隍庙 | 关联: 四合院, 砖木结构, 周秦汉唐
陕北高原
Northern Shaanxi Plateau

中文：陕北高原是黄土高原核心区域，包括榆林、延安等地。书中记载陕北建筑以窑洞、古城、古寨为特色，榆林卫城为明长城九边重镇之一，吴堡石城全部用石头砌筑，米脂姜氏庄园是陕北民居的精华，杨家沟扶风古寨有新院和马宅，融合了中西建筑风格。

EN: The Northern Shaanxi Plateau is the core of the Loess Plateau, including Yulin and Yan'an. The book records northern Shaanxi architecture featuring caves, ancient cities, and fortresses; Yulin Garrison City was one of the nine strategic towns of the Ming Great Wall; Wubuo Stone City is entirely stone-built; Mizhi Jiang's Manor is the essence of northern Shaanxi residences; Yangjiagou Fufeng Ancient Fortress has new and horse courtyards blending Chinese and Western styles.

实例: 榆林卫城、吴堡石城、米脂姜氏庄园 | 关联: 窑洞, 古城墙, 黄土高原
陕南地区
Southern Shaanxi Region

中文：陕南地区包括汉中、安康、商洛，北依秦岭，南靠大巴山，气候湿润，建筑风格融合关中、巴蜀和荆楚文化。书中记载陕南古建筑以会馆、书院、古镇为特色，宁强青木川古镇回龙场老街是陕甘川三省交界最繁荣的商业文化交流场所，丹凤船帮会馆、紫阳北五省会馆是陕南会馆的代表。

EN: Southern Shaanxi includes Hanzhong, Ankang, and Shangluo, with Qinling to the north and Daba Mountains to the south, humid climate, blending Guanzhong, Ba-Shu, and Jing-Chu cultures. The book records southern Shaanxi architecture featuring guild halls, academies, and ancient towns; Ningqiang Qingmuchuan's Huilong Old Street was the most prosperous commercial and cultural exchange hub at the Shaanxi-Gansu-Sichuan border; Danfeng Boatmen's and Ziyang Five Northern Provinces Guild Halls are representatives.

实例: 宁强青木川古镇、丹凤船帮会馆、紫阳北五省会馆 | 关联: 会馆, 古镇, 四合院
